items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出一种残差学习框架，以减轻训练远超以往深度的网络的难度：将网络层显式地表述为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数。实验证据表明，残差网络更易优化，并能随深度大幅增加而提升精度。在 ImageNet 上我们评估了深达152层的残差网络，比 VGG 深8倍但复杂度更低；其集成模型在测试集上错误率为3.57%，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一。我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了100层与1000层的网络。表示的深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要，仅凭极深的表示，我们在 COCO 目标检测上获得28%的相对提升。深度残差网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛的基础，并在 ImageNet 检测、定位与 COCO 检测、分割任务中均获第一。
items.highlight_zh: 残差学习让超深网络更易训练，ImageNet夺冠
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：深度学习理论上层数越多表达能力越强，但实际上网络越深越难训练，出现退化——训练误差反而上升，这并非过拟合造成。

方法：作者提出「残差学习」：不让网络直接学目标映射，而是学「输入与输出之差」（残差），并把输入通过捷径连接直接加到输出上。这样若最优解接近恒等映射，网络只需把残差学成接近零，优化会容易得多；捷径连接也不增加参数与计算量。

结果：在 ImageNet 上训练了18至152层不等的网络，152层版本比 VGG 深8倍却复杂度更低；单模型与集成模型均取得当时最佳成绩，集成错误率3.57%，获 ILSVRC 2015 分类第一。CIFAR-10 上甚至成功训练了1000层网络。把该骨干网络迁移到 COCO 检测任务，仅因表示更深就带来28%的相对提升；同一框架还在 ImageNet 检测/定位与 COCO 检测/分割中夺冠。

为何重要：它证明了「深度」本身可以被有效利用，残差连接成为此后几乎所有深层网络的标配结构，深刻影响了计算机视觉乃至整个深度学习领域。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质是生命的基础，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。经大量实验努力，约10万个独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只占已知数十亿蛋白质序列的极小部分——测定单个结构往往需要数月到数年的艰苦工作，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈。仅依据氨基酸序列预测蛋白质将折叠成的三维结构，即「蛋白质折叠问题」中的结构预测部分，是50多年来重要的开放难题。尽管近年有进展，现有方法远未达到原子级精度，在无同源结构时尤甚。本文给出首个即使在无相似结构可参考时也能常规性做出原子级精度预测的计算方法。我们在极具挑战的第14届蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）中验证了完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅超越其他方法。其核心是一种新的机器学习方法，把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识、尤其是多序列比对信息，融入深度学习算法设计。
items.highlight_zh: 无同源模板也能原子级精度预测蛋白结构
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：蛋白质的功能由其三维结构决定，但用实验（如X射线晶体学、冷冻电镜）测定一个结构往往要数月到数年。已知序列有数十亿条，已解析结构仅约10万个。仅凭氨基酸序列算出结构，是悬置50多年的「蛋白质折叠问题」。

方法：DeepMind 完全重新设计了神经网络模型 AlphaFold，关键是把关于蛋白质的物理与生物学先验知识写进算法：利用多序列比对（MSA）寻找进化上共变动的残基对作为空间接触线索，并用注意力机制在残基之间传递信息；同时预测多个结构并给出每个残基的置信度。

结果：在 CASP14 盲测中，AlphaFold 在多数目标上达到可与实验结构相比的原子级精度，远超其他参赛方法，尤其在以往最困难的、没有同源模板的序列上也表现优异。多数预测的骨架误差接近实验测定的不确定度。

为何重要：它把结构生物学从「一个蛋白一个蛋白地解」推进到可大规模计算预测，为理解生命机制、药物设计乃至未知蛋白功能研究提供了基础设施；同时展示了深度学习与科学先验结合的巨大威力。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 基于衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学的衍射深度神经网络（D²NN）架构：经深度学习设计的一组无源衍射层协同工作，即可学会实现多种功能。我们用3D打印的 D²NN 在太赫兹波段实验演示了该框架，成功学会手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有的丰富3D打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，将在全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类中获得应用，并能催生可学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 用3D打印衍射层以光速完成神经网络计算
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：主流神经网络依赖电子计算机逐层做乘加运算，速度与能耗受硬件限制。能否让「计算」直接由光在传播中完成，从而以光速、几乎不耗电地做推断？

方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D²NN）。它由若干片无源衍射层沿光轴堆叠构成，每个像素对入射光产生一个可调的相位与振幅调制，光在层间自由传播时即完成类似全连接层的线性组合与干涉。层上的参数用深度学习中的误差反传在计算机上训练，训练完成后这些层就是固定的「硬件权重」，实际运算只靠光穿过它们。

结果：团队3D打印出太赫兹波段的器件，实测其能对手写数字图像分类，还能充当成像透镜把物体聚焦到探测器上——相当于一个「学会任务的光学元件」。验证了设计即训练、制造即部署的流程可行。

为何重要：这一框架把机器学习模型变成一块被动光学元件，推断时无需供电、几乎零延迟，适合高速、低功耗的视觉前端处理，也为可按需训练的相机与光学系统开辟了新思路。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，众多数据科学家用它取得许多机器学习竞赛的最优结果。我们提出一种新的稀疏感知算法以处理稀疏数据，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们总结了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。综合这些设计，XGBoost 能以远少于现有系统的资源扩展到数十亿级样本。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知与缓存优化让树提升扩展到十亿级数据
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：梯度提升树（GBDT）精度高、通用性强，但当数据规模达到上亿甚至数十亿样本、特征高度稀疏时，传统实现训练慢、内存吃紧，难以实用。如何做一个既快又省资源的通用树提升系统？

方法：XGBoost 从算法与系统工程两方面入手。算法上，采用带正则项的二阶（牛顿）近似目标函数，使分裂增益计算更精确；提出稀疏感知的分裂查找算法，为缺失值自动学习默认分支方向；用加权分位数草图在大数据上做近似分裂点搜索。系统上，按特征列预先排序并以块结构存储，使分裂查找可并行；设计能感知缓存访问模式的预取方案；支持数据压缩与分片（sharding），从而在多机、外存场景下也能训练。

结果：作者报告该实现在单机与分布式环境下都能以远少于同期系统的资源，扩展到数十亿级样本，训练速度显著提升，并在大量机器学习竞赛与工业任务中取得领先成绩。

为何重要：它把统计学习算法与底层系统优化结合，成为表格数据建模的事实标准工具之一，也启发了后续大量可扩展机器学习系统的设计。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：面向语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即来自 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期语言表示模型不同，BERT 在所有层中同时以左右两侧上下文为条件，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练好的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层即可微调，就能为问答、语言推断等大量任务构建当前最优模型，而无需对任务特定架构做实质修改。BERT 概念简单、实证强大，在十一个自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果：GLUE 分数提至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率提至 86.7%（提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 提至 93.2（提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 提至 83.1（提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 深度双向预训练＋单层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：此前的语言表示模型（如 ELMo、GPT）要么只能单向阅读，要么把左右两个单向模型简单拼接，导致每个词无法同时利用左右两侧上下文，预训练表示的表达能力受限。
- 方法：BERT 使用多层 Transformer 编码器，在无标注文本上做“掩码语言模型”（随机遮住部分词再预测）与“下一句预测”两个预训练任务，关键在于每一层都同时融合左右上下文，从而得到真正的深度双向表示；下游任务只需在顶部加一个输出层做微调。
- 结果：在问答、语言推断等 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新纪录，GLUE 达 80.5%（+7.7 个百分点）、MultiNLI 86.7%（+4.6）、SQuAD v1.1 测试 F1 93.2、SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 83.1。
- 为何重要：它确立了“大规模无标注预训练＋轻量任务微调”的通用范式，把 NLP 从每个任务单独设计架构，转向共享一个通用语言底座，成为后续大规模语言模型时代的重要起点。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的精确开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个用单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机，并支持针孔与鱼眼镜头模型，同时完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一项创新是基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计，使其能在室内外大、小环境中实时鲁棒运行，精度比此前方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二项创新是多地图系统，它依赖召回率更高的新地点识别方法：当视觉信息长期较差而跟丢时，系统会新建地图，并在重访已建图区域时无缝合并。与只用最近数秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 首次在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息，使时间上相隔很远或来自先前建图会话的共视关键帧也能参与 bundle adjustment，提供高视差观测以提升精度。实验显示，在所有传感器配置下，其鲁棒性与文献最佳系统相当且显著更精确；双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机上平均精度 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 手持快速运动场景下达 9 mm。代码已开源。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉/视觉惯性/多地图 SLAM，精度高 2–5 倍
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：机器人、无人机与 AR/VR 需要在多种相机（单目、双目、RGB-D，针孔或鱼眼）以及有/无 IMU 的条件下实时定位与建图，而视觉信息一旦短暂变差就容易跟丢，传统系统丢失后往往只能从头重来。
- 方法：其一是把视觉特征与 IMU 紧耦合，整个流程（含 IMU 初始化）统一在最大后验（MAP）估计框架下求解；其二是用召回率更高的地点识别支撑多地图机制——跟丢时开启新地图，重访旧区域时自动无缝合并；并在 bundle adjustment 中复用全部历史共视关键帧，即便这些关键帧在时间上相隔很远。
- 结果：在所有传感器配置下，鲁棒性与文献最佳系统相当且明显更准，精度比此前方法高 2–5 倍；双目＋IMU 在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 手持快速运动场景达 9 mm。
- 为何重要：它首次在开源系统中把视觉、视觉惯性与多地图统一起来，将“只用最近几秒信息”的里程计升级为可长期复用历史信息的 SLAM，对机器人导航与 AR/VR 有直接应用价值。

items.title_en: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
items.title_zh: HiUni：在共享视觉空间中统一理解与生成
items.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper, we present HiUni, which revisits this design choice and explores whether a pretrained vision language model can be directly extended into a unified model with extensive parameter sharing. Specifically, HiUni reuses the same language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone for both capabilities, while confining task-specific computation to the output side. Yet such a design introduces two key challenges. Generation in pixel space is difficult to optimize, and semantic abstraction in pretrained ViT discards fine spatial details required for synthesis. To address these challenges, HiUni introduces a \emph{Pixel Diffusion Head} tailored to direct pixel-space optimization and a lightweight \emph{HiGate} pathway that provides fine-grained spatial details near the output stage. Extensive experiments show that HiUni achieves a similar average understanding score to the pretrained VLM while attaining competitive performance on image generation and editing. Controlled comparisons and analyses further demonstrate that a single dense backbone can effectively support both capabilities without task-specific backbone computation, highlighting a simpler path toward unified multimodal modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 统一多模态模型希望在同一框架内同时支持视觉理解与生成，但现有方法常为两类任务分离视觉表示或主干计算，限制了统一程度。本文提出 HiUni，重新审视这一设计选择，探索能否将预训练视觉语言模型直接扩展为高度共享参数的统一模型。HiUni 让两种能力复用同一个语言对齐的 ViT 与稠密 Transformer 主干，仅将任务特定计算限制在输出端。该设计带来两个挑战：像素空间生成难以优化，预训练 ViT 的语义抽象又丢弃了合成所需的细粒度空间细节。为此，HiUni 引入面向直接像素空间优化的 Pixel Diffusion Head，以及轻量 HiGate 通路，在输出阶段附近提供细粒度空间细节。实验表明，HiUni 的平均理解得分接近预训练 VLM，并在图像生成与编辑上具有竞争力；对照分析进一步显示，单一稠密主干无需任务特定的主干计算即可有效支撑两种能力。
items.highlight_zh: 单一稠密主干共享参数，统一视觉理解与生成
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：统一多模态模型想把“看懂图”和“生成图”放进同一个模型，但多数做法为两类任务配置不同的视觉表示或不同主干，参数共享有限，模型臃肿、统一程度不高。
- 方法：HiUni 走极简路线——理解与生成共用同一个语言对齐的 ViT 和稠密 Transformer 主干，只在输出端做任务特定处理。为克服两个难题（像素空间生成难优化、ViT 的语义抽象丢失细节），它设计了 Pixel Diffusion Head 直接在像素空间优化，并用轻量 HiGate 通路在输出附近补回细粒度空间信息。
- 结果：平均理解得分接近原始预训练 VLM，同时在图像生成与编辑上表现有竞争力；对照实验说明单一大主干足以支撑两类任务，无需任务专属的主干计算。
- 为何重要：它证明“少拆分、多共享”同样能统一理解与生成，为更简洁的多模态统一建模提供可行路径，有助于降低模型复杂度与训练成本。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF
items.title_zh: 超越最终答案：从H&E与mIF出发的可解释肿瘤免疫微环境推理
items.abstract_en: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could automate these readouts with an explanation, but two gaps remain. Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. Same-section H&E and mIF provide what both gaps lack: mIF measures every cell without manual annotation, which gives cell-level ground truth for each step that clinical guidelines prescribe, from delineating a tissue compartment to counting and normalizing the marker-positive cells within it. We therefore present HERMES (H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision), an R1-style MLLM that reasons jointly over paired H&E and mIF in guideline steps and is trained with a process reward that checks every stated quantity against this truth. Across four field-level TIME tasks in colorectal cancer, HERMES (4B) reaches an average accuracy of 84.5%, compared with 74.7% for the strongest of twelve proprietary, general, medical and pathology MLLMs, and a higher share of its intermediate quantities is correct than for the strongest open-weight baseline. Without the process reward, reinforcement learning barely improves on supervised fine-tuning (80.0% vs. 78.8%) and fewer stated quantities are correct; editing a decisive stated quantity changes the answer as implied in all 885 test questions. Without retraining, it keeps the highest average accuracy on an external cohort imaged with CODEX (76.4% vs. 67.3%) and on head and neck cancer, a cancer type absent from training (76.7% vs. 72.5%).
items.abstract_zh: 肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）的判读指标（如CD8+ T细胞密度、上皮内浸润、Ki67指数）需要把H&E的组织结构与多重免疫荧光（mIF）的细胞表型结合起来。现有病理多模态大模型（MLLM）只读H&E，缺少mIF提供的细胞表型；且其推理没有步骤级真值可核验，R1式强化学习只奖励最终答案。同切片的H&E与mIF恰好互补：mIF无需人工标注即可测量每个细胞，为临床指南规定的每一步（勾画组织分区、计数并归一化该区内阳性细胞）提供细胞级真值。作者提出HERMES，一个按指南步骤在配对H&E与mIF上联合推理、并以过程奖励逐项核验所报数量的R1式MLLM。在结直肠癌四项视野级TIME任务上，4B的HERMES平均准确率达84.5%，高于十二个专有、通用、医学与病理MLLM中最强者（74.7%）；去掉过程奖励后强化学习相对监督微调几无提升（80.0% vs 78.8%）。
items.highlight_zh: 用mIF细胞级真值做过程奖励，实现可核验的TIME推理
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：病理报告里常看的肿瘤免疫微环境指标（CD8+ T细胞多密、是否钻进上皮层、Ki67增殖指数），本质上要同时用到H&E染色的组织结构和多重免疫荧光(mIF)标出的细胞身份。多模态大模型看似可以自动出报告并解释，但两类模型各有硬伤：病理大模型基本只看H&E，看不到mIF的细胞表型；而它们的推理链没有逐句可核对的标准答案，R1式强化学习只给最终答案打分，中间步骤对不对没人管。
2）方法：作者抓住一个关键便利——同一张切片既做H&E又做mIF，mIF能把每个细胞都测出来，不用人工勾画，于是从“圈出组织分区”到“数出区内阳性细胞并做归一化”这每一步，都能自动得到细胞级的标准答案。HERMES 就据此训练：它按临床指南的步骤在H&E与mIF上联合推理，并用一个过程奖励去逐步核对它报出的每个数量是否与真值一致。
3）结果：在结直肠癌四个视野级任务上，只有40亿参数的HERMES平均准确率84.5%，明显超过十二个专有/通用/医学/病理大模型中最强的74.7%；中间量正确的比例也更高。消融显示，去掉过程奖励，强化学习相比监督微调几乎没长进（80.0% vs 78.8%）。更关键的是，人为改动推理中某个关键数量，答案会跟着按逻辑改变——885道测试题全部如此，说明模型是真在“用”这些中间量，而非事后编理由。不重新训练，在外部队列上仍保持最高平均准确率。
4）为什么重要：它把“可解释”从口头承诺变成了可检验的约束，让病理AI给出的每个数字都能被追溯到细胞级证据，这对临床采信至关重要。

items.title_en: Generating grain boundary structures at a specified energy with a symmetry-constrained diffusion model
items.title_zh: 用对称约束扩散模型生成指定能量的晶界结构
items.abstract_en: Grain boundaries (GBs) govern many properties of polycrystalline materials, and inverse design would make the GB structure itself a design variable. Crystal generative models such as MatterGen operate on periodic cells, which contain two GBs. The cell energy defines a single GB only when the two are equivalent, but existing models do not enforce this equivalence. Building on MatterGen, we developed a symmetry-constrained diffusion model in which the two GBs are related by a symmetry operation: atoms near one GB are generated, and those near the other are reconstructed through a symmetry projection applied at every denoising step. We applied it to the $Σ5(210)[001]$ symmetric tilt GB in Al, conditioning generation on the GB energy from a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). All 350 generated structures kept a geometrically equivalent GB pair after relaxation. Given a target GB energy, the model generated structures at that energy: for the three in-range targets with many nearby training structures, 44% to 70% fell within $\pm 0.1$ J/m$^2$ of the target. Tracking weakened at higher energies and failed outside the training range. Of the 91 near-target structures, 90 matched no training structure under the adopted geometric criterion, indicating that the model can propose configurations near the target energy that are distinct from the training structures, a capability that could help identify unknown metastable GB structures observed in experiments. Building GB-pair equivalence into generation thus makes GB properties well-defined design targets, enabling inverse design of GB structures.
items.abstract_zh: 晶界（GB）主导多晶材料的诸多性质，若能做到逆向设计，晶界结构本身就可成为设计变量。MatterGen等晶体生成模型作用于周期性晶胞，而一个晶胞含两条晶界；只有当两条晶界等价时，晶胞能量才唯一对应单条晶界能量，现有模型却不强制这一等价性。作者在MatterGen基础上构建对称约束扩散模型：两条晶界由对称操作相联系，仅生成一侧晶界附近的原子，另一侧在每个去噪步通过对称投影重建。将其用于Al的Σ5(210)[001]对称倾斜晶界，以机器学习原子间势（MLIP）给出的晶界能量为条件。350个生成结构弛豫后全部保持几何等价的晶界对；对三个处于训练范围且邻近训练结构较多的目标能量，44%–70%的结构落在±0.1 J/m²内，高能区跟踪变弱、超出范围则失效。91个近目标结构中有90个不匹配任何训练结构，表明模型能提出与训练集不同的近目标构型。
items.highlight_zh: 强制晶界对等价，使晶界能量成为可逆设计的明确目标
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：多晶材料里，晶界（相邻晶粒之间的界面）在很大程度上决定材料强不强、韧不韧、耐不耐腐蚀。如果能“反向设计”——先定下想要的晶界能量，再让模型生成对应的原子结构——晶界结构就能像合金成分一样成为设计参数。但现有晶体生成模型（如MatterGen）处理的是一个周期性晶胞，里面必然包含两条晶界；只有当两条晶界结构完全等价时，这个晶胞的能量才能代表单条晶界的能量，而现有模型并不保证这一点，于是能量这个设计目标就变得含混。
2）方法：作者在MatterGen上加了一个对称约束：让两条晶界由一个对称操作互相联系，只生成一侧晶界附近的原子，另一侧在每个去噪步通过对称投影“镜像”重建。这样生成出的胞天然满足双晶界等价。他们把模型用在铝的Σ5(210)[001]对称倾斜晶界上，把机器学习原子间势(MLIP)算出的晶界能量作为条件输入。
3）结果：350个生成结构经过结构弛豫后全部保持了几何等价的晶界对，说明约束在分子动力学弛豫下是稳的。给定目标能量时，对于三个落在训练能量范围内、且附近有较多训练样本的目标，有44%到70%的生成结构落在目标±0.1 J/m²之内；能量更高时跟踪变差，超出训练范围则失效——这如实说明了模型的适用边界。更值得注意的是，91个接近目标的生成结构里有90个在所用几何判据下与任何训练结构都不相同，意味着模型不是简单“记答案”，而是能提出新的、能量接近目标的构型。
4）为什么重要：它把“双晶界等价”这一物理约束直接写进生成过程，让晶界性质第一次成为良定义、可优化的设计目标，也为实验中观察到却结构未知的亚稳晶界提供了候选结构。

items.title_en: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
items.title_zh: TuringSpace：用交互式 CAPTCHA 在行动中锚定空间智能
items.abstract_en: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.
items.abstract_zh: 人类通过在二维视图中推断三维布局、预测动作后果并在看到结果后自我纠正来在视觉世界中行动，多模态大模型能否做到同样的事？作者提出 TuringSpace：一个包含 125 个交互式 CAPTCHA 的合成网页环境，覆盖五种空间能力，必须通过屏幕点击与拖拽完成。每个任务都是可生成新实例、配有检查器与标准答案的程序，因而也构成可扩展的训练场。人类解决 94.1%，最强模型 GPT-6 Astra 仍失败 25.9%，最佳开源模型 Kimi K3 失败 68.0%。分析表明，多数失败源于误读截图，模型推理很少纠正错误信念，反而幻觉证据为其辩护。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上微调使成功率从 1.6% 升至 33.1%，超过 Kimi K3，并在七个分布外基准上全面改善，真实室内视频 VSI-Bench 提升 9.9 点。
items.highlight_zh: 交互式空间 CAPTCHA 暴露多模态模型知行脱节
items.digest_zh:
问题：多模态大模型能否像人一样，从一张二维截图推断场景的三维结构、预测点击或拖拽的后果、再依据反馈纠错？现有 CAPTCHA 基准大多已被模型攻克且缺乏空间性，而空间基准又很少要求真正动手操作。
方法：作者构建 TuringSpace，一个合成网页环境，含 125 个交互式 CAPTCHA，覆盖五种空间能力，全部需在屏幕上点击、拖拽完成。每个任务都是能生成新实例的程序，自带检查器与参考答案，因此既是测试集，也是可扩展的训练场。
结果：人类解决率 94.1%；最强模型 GPT-6 Astra 仍失败 25.9%，最强开源模型 Kimi K3 失败 68.0%。错误分析显示多数失败来自误读截图，且模型在推理中很少纠正错误判断，反而编造证据支持它。用该训练场微调 Qwen3.5-9B 后，成功率从 1.6% 升到 33.1%，超过 Kimi K3，并在七个分布外基准上全部提升，其中真实室内视频 VSI-Bench 提升 9.9 点。
意义：把空间智能放到屏幕动作上检验，能暴露模型真正缺少什么，也提供了可规模化的训练方式，且学到的东西能迁移到真实场景。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: What Helps Language-Model Agents Review Violent Video? A Controlled Comparison with a Human Evidence Reference
items.title_zh: 什么帮助语言模型智能体审核暴力视频？与人类证据参照的受控比较
items.abstract_en: Systems that flag violent video for a human operator can now be built from language models without training, by combining perception models and letting a language model decide. We ask how the observations of the perception models should reach the decision, and which evidence matters. On the XD-Violence test set (799 clips) we fix one set of perception agents (video description, object detection, sound tagging, speech recognition and speech tagging) and one reasoning model, and compare three interfaces: messages between agents, a typed evidence graph explored with tools, and flat text read in one pass; and a single audio-visual model given the raw clip. Two annotators provide a human reference that records the decision, the incident segments and whether they relied on sight, sound or speech. Flat text matches the single model (F1 0.967 against 0.968), while the graph agent and message passing are less accurate; a variant of the graph agent developed on a separate set did not close the gap, and both graph summaries and multi-turn tool use lowered accuracy. These results hold with reworded prompts and with a larger reasoning model, except that the larger model weakens message passing enough for the graph agent to beat it. Sound events improve F1 by +0.012 [+0.004, +0.021], in line with the annotators, who used sound or speech on most violent clips. Citations of stored observations are faithful, changing about half of the decisions when removed, but no more so with the graph than with flat text, and the agent pipeline costs about 3 times the GPU time of the single model. We also report two artefacts of vision-language describers that mislead pipelines built on them.
items.abstract_zh: 如今可以不做训练，仅靠组合多个感知模型、让语言模型做决策，就搭建出向人工操作员提示暴力视频的系统。本文追问：感知模型的观测应以何种形式送达决策环节，哪些证据真正有用。在XD-Violence测试集（799段）上，固定同一组感知智能体（视频描述、目标检测、声音标签、语音识别、语音标注）和同一推理模型，比较三种接口：智能体间消息传递、借助工具探索的类型化证据图、一次读入的扁平文本；另设一个直接读取原始片段的单一音视频模型作为对照。两名标注者提供人工参考，记录决策、事件片段以及依据的是画面、声音还是语音。扁平文本与单一模型相当（F1 0.967 vs 0.968），证据图智能体与消息传递反而更差；换用更大的推理模型后结论大体成立。声音事件带来+0.012的F1增益，与标注者多依赖声音或语音相符。对存储观测的引用是忠实的，移除后约半数决策改变，但证据图并不比扁平文本更强，且智能体流水线的GPU耗时约为单一模型的3倍。
items.highlight_zh: 扁平文本输入不输单模型，复杂证据图与消息传递反而更差
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：给人工审核员提示暴力视频的系统，现在可以“零训练”搭起来——把视频描述、目标检测、声音识别等现成感知模型串起来，再让一个语言模型读它们的输出做判断。但工程上有个关键选择：这些感知结果该怎么喂给语言模型？是彼此发消息、组织成可查询的结构化证据图，还是干脆拼成一段文本一次读完？多花的复杂度到底换来什么，此前没有受控比较。
2）方法：作者在XD-Violence测试集（799段视频）上做了严格对比：感知智能体和推理模型全部固定不变，只改接口形式——(a)智能体之间互发消息；(b)类型化的证据图，用工具逐步查询；(c)扁平文本，一次读入。另设一个直接看原始片段的单一音视频大模型作为参照。同时请两名标注员给出人工参考，不仅记录是否暴力，还记录事件发生在哪一段、判断依据是画面、声音还是语音。
3）结果：最朴素的做法反而最好——扁平文本与单一音视频模型打平（F1 0.967 对 0.968），证据图和多轮工具调用都拉低了准确率，在另一个数据集上专门改进的图智能体版本也没能补上差距。重写提示词、换成更大的推理模型后结论基本不变（唯一例外是大模型让消息传递变得足够差，从而被图智能体反超）。声音事件确实有用，F1提升+0.012，与标注员在多数暴力片段上依赖声音或语音相吻合。模型引用已存储的观测是忠实的——删掉这些观测约一半决策会变，但证据图并不比扁平文本更依赖它们；而整套智能体流水线的GPU时间约为单一模型的3倍。文中还报告了视觉语言描述器的两类系统性偏差会如何误导下游流水线。
4）为什么重要：它提醒做智能体系统的人，堆叠编排结构未必带来收益，反而增加成本与出错面；同时给出了“以人为参照”评估多模态审核管线的可复用范式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对目标尺度、遮挡与实时延迟；公开数据集成绩不能直接等同实际场景效果。 这是综述或观点文献，应与可运行实现区分。

items.title_en: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: Mind2Act World：机器人操作中“心智、物理动作与心-动组合”的诊断基准
items.abstract_en: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.
items.abstract_zh: 具身智能要求机器人具备三类互补能力：基于历史的认知推理、精确及时的动作执行，以及借助环境反馈把两者组合起来。现有基准要么在同一任务中评估推理与执行，要么分开评估却不考察其组合，难以判断失败来自推理、执行还是组合。作者提出 Mind2Act World，包含来自五个真实应用领域的 30 个仿真操作任务，每个任务有三个难度和两种场景设置（Clean 与 Random），共 180 种配置，构成 Mind、Act、Mind2Act 三个视图。诊断工具还能把失败片段归因于心智、动作或其组合，并生成系统画像。评测多模态智能体、视觉-语言-动作模型与“世界-动作”模型显示：单一视图的能力无法迁移到组合任务，最强智能体在 Mind 上成功 52.7%、Act 上 39.0%，但在 Mind2Act 上仅 12.0%。
items.highlight_zh: 单项能力过关不等于会组合，最强智能体组合任务仅 12%
items.digest_zh:
问题：机器人完成复杂物理任务，既要会“想”（依据过去观察做决策），也要会“做”（精确及时的动作），还要能通过环境反馈把两者串成闭环。现有基准要么把推理与执行混在同一任务里，要么分开测，因而难以诊断失败究竟出在推理、执行还是两者的组合。
方法：作者提出 Mind2Act World，包含来自五个真实应用领域的 30 个仿真操作任务，每个任务三种难度、两种场景（洁净与随机），共 180 种配置，并组织成 Mind（基于过去观察做决策）、Act（精确及时执行）、Mind2Act（闭环组合）三个视图；还配有诊断工具，把失败回合归因于心智、动作或组合，并生成每个系统的能力画像。
结果：评测多模态智能体、视觉-语言-动作模型与世界-动作模型后发现，单一视图上的能力并不能迁移到组合任务。最强智能体在 Mind 上成功 52.7%、Act 上 39.0%，但在 Mind2Act 上只有 12.0%。它虽能保持任务状态，却难以维持持续接触；端到端策略能执行熟练动作，却几乎不保留任务状态。
意义：该基准把“缺少某种能力”与“有这些能力却不会组合”区分开来，为具身智能的下一步改进指明了方向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
items.title_zh: StereoVLM：面向度量三维空间推理的双目视觉语言模型
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($δ_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）语义理解能力强，但在物理世界的度量三维空间推理上仍受限。现有VLM通常在没有已知相机标定或跨视角几何约束的情况下从单张或多张图像推断三维结构，使度量三维推断本质上存在歧义，也难以判断其空间预测究竟基于视觉证据还是语义先验。相比之下，标定双目提供明确的跨视角几何，可消解这种歧义。作者提出StereoVLM——首个几何感知的双目VLM，用于度量三维空间推理，采用从跨视角对应、视差估计，到标定条件下的度量深度感知与语义空间推理的层级学习范式，并发现视差监督在未见环境上的泛化显著优于直接的双目深度监督。为评估这些能力，作者构建了Stereo3D-Bench，覆盖从点级几何到物体级空间推理的三个层级。StereoVLM-8B在基准上取得95.17%的深度准确率（δ1）与66.98的物体级平均分；干预实验表明其表现得益于有效的跨视角几何，而非更多视觉token或语义先验。
items.highlight_zh: 用标定双目的视差监督，让VLM获得可泛化的度量三维理解
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：如今的视觉语言模型能说会道，但被问“那个杯子离摄像头有多远”“桌上的箱子在椅子左边多少厘米”时，答案往往靠语义猜测而非真正的几何推理。原因是它们通常在没有相机标定、也没有跨视角几何约束的条件下从图片推测三维，这在数学上本身就是病态的——同一个平面投影可以对应无穷多种三维场景。于是很难判断模型到底在“看几何”，还是在根据常识编答案。
2）方法：作者改用一个物理上更强的输入：标定好的双目相机。两个相机之间的已知基线和位姿，使跨视角对应关系明确，歧义随之消失。基于此提出StereoVLM，采用层级式学习：先学跨视角对应，再学视差估计，然后学标定条件下的度量深度感知，最后做语义空间推理。一个重要发现是：用视差（disparity）做监督，比直接用双目深度做监督，在没见过的环境里泛化好得多。作者还构建了Stereo3D-Bench基准，分三个层级评估——从点级几何，到物体级空间关系推理。
3）结果：StereoVLM-8B在基准上深度准确率δ1达95.17%，物体级任务平均分66.98。为避免“只是多喂了视觉token或靠语义先验”的质疑，作者做了干预实验：一旦跨视角几何被破坏（如用错误标定或不匹配的视图），性能随之下降，说明模型的判断确实建立在有效几何之上。层级式几何监督还在多个任务上带来约3.5分的平均提升。
4）为什么重要：它把“可标定的双目几何”作为归纳偏置引入VLM，使度量级三维理解变得可验证、可泛化，对机器人、自动驾驶等需要在真实尺度上做空间决策的具身应用尤其关键。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Deciphering the limitations of immortalized hepatocyte cell lines for the study of liver cis-regulatory elements
items.title_zh: 解析永生化肝细胞系在肝脏顺式调控元件研究中的局限性
items.abstract_en: Background: Immortalized cell lines are widely used to study transcriptional regulation. However, previous studies have shown that immortalization and prolonged culture can alter their regulatory landscapes, potentially compromising their ability to model native cis-regulatory element (CRE) activity. Hepatocyte-like cell lines (HLCs), particularly HepG2, are frequently used to study liver CREs, but whether non-cancer-derived HLCs, such as AML12, better recapitulate native regulatory landscapes remains unclear. Furthermore, cell culture conditions have been shown to influence gene expression and CRE activity, raising the possibility that optimizing culture conditions could improve HLC gene regulatory similarities to primary liver tissue. Together, these questions highlight the importance of characterizing the transcriptional regulatory landscapes of HLCs and evaluating the effects of culture conditions when using these cell lines to study native liver CRE activity. Results: We systematically characterized the molecular features and transcriptional regulatory landscapes of four HLCs and compared them with those of liver tissue. We examined AML12 cells using RT-qPCR and flow cytometry and found that they express some hepatocyte markers but lack key characteristics of mature hepatocytes. We then used ATAC-seq to characterize the chromatin accessibility landscape of AML12. Through transcription factor motif enrichment, functional enrichment, and machine learning analyses, we found substantial differences in the cis-regulatory landscapes of AML12 and primary mouse liver. Modifying AML12 culture conditions altered some regulatory features but did not substantially improve their similarity to primary liver tissue. We then extended these analyses to three additional HLCs and found similar differences between their regulatory landscapes and that of primary liver tissue. Notably, HepG2 recapitulated native liver regulatory landscapes better than the tested non-cancer-derived cell lines. Conclusion: Our findings reveal substantial differences in transcriptional regulatory landscapes between immortalized HLCs and native liver tissue that persist despite modifications to culture conditions. These results highlight the limitations of HLCs in modeling native liver transcriptional regulation and emphasize the importance of evaluating their regulatory landscapes before using them to investigate CRE function. Keywords: Hepatocyte-like cell lines; Cis-regulatory elements; Liver; Cell culture conditions; ATAC-seq
items.abstract_zh: 背景：永生化细胞系被广泛用于转录调控研究，但既往研究表明永生化与长期培养会改变其调控景观，可能削弱其模拟天然顺式调控元件（CRE）活性的能力。类肝细胞系（HLCs），尤其是 HepG2，常用于研究肝脏 CRE，但非癌来源的 HLCs（如 AML12）是否更能重现天然调控景观尚不清楚；培养条件也会影响基因表达与 CRE 活性，提示优化培养或可提升其与原代肝组织的相似性。结果：作者系统刻画了四种 HLCs 的分子特征与转录调控景观并与肝组织比较。RT-qPCR 与流式分析显示 AML12 表达部分肝细胞标志物，但缺乏成熟肝细胞的关键特征；ATAC-seq 刻画其染色质可及性后，通过转录因子基序富集、功能富集与机器学习分析发现 AML12 与原代小鼠肝脏的顺式调控景观存在显著差异。改变培养条件仅调整了部分调控特征，并未实质提升其与原代肝组织的相似性；随后作者将分析扩展至另外三种 HLCs。
items.highlight_zh: 永生化肝细胞系难以真实再现原代肝脏的顺式调控景观
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：肝脏的基因表达由大量顺式调控元件（CRE，如增强子）控制，研究者常拿永生化肝细胞系当“替身”来研究这些元件。但这类细胞在永生化过程和长期培养中可能已经“走样”，它们到底能不能代表真实肝脏，此前缺乏系统评估。尤其是常用的 HepG2 是癌细胞来源，那么非癌来源的 AML12 是否更接近真实肝脏？换一种培养条件能否让它更像肝脏？
2. 用了什么方法：作者先用 RT-qPCR 和流式细胞术检查 AML12 是否真的像肝细胞；再用 ATAC-seq 测定其染色质“开放”区域（即哪些 DNA 区域处于活跃状态），并通过转录因子结合基序富集、功能富集和机器学习，把这些开放区域与原代小鼠肝脏逐一比对。之后又尝试改变培养条件，并把同样的分析扩展到另外几种肝细胞系。
3. 有什么结果：AML12 只表达部分肝细胞标志物，缺少成熟肝细胞的关键特性；其染色质开放景观与原代肝脏差异明显，说明它并不是肝脏调控图谱的忠实“复印件”。调整培养条件只能改变一部分特征，并未让整体相似度显著提升。
4. 为何重要：这提醒研究者，用永生化肝细胞系推断肝脏 CRE 功能时必须谨慎，结论需要通过原代组织或其他证据验证；同时也为评估细胞模型的可信度提供了一套可复用的分析思路。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Composite Dielectric-Loaded Metallic Metagratings for Dual-Polarized Transmissive Beam Manipulation
items.title_zh: 复合介质加载金属超光栅用于双极化透射式波束调控
items.abstract_en: We present and experimentally demonstrate a comprehensive analytical suite for the design of transmissive metal-based metagratings (MGs) for dual-polarized anomalous refraction. Considering a composite configuration of perforated metallic slabs with controlled dielectric loading, we develop a rigorous mode-matching formulation tying the various MG degrees of freedom to the various reflected and transmitted Floquet-Bloch modes, enabling efficient beam deflection for both transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) polarizations. Inherently versatile, the analytical framework accurately models single-layer and double-layer constructs with multiple rectangular perforations per unit cell, each potentially loaded with dielectric material. We harness this degree-of-freedom abundance to devise diverse polarization-sensitive transmissive MGs, ranging from all-metallic single-layer and double-layer structures for single-polarized (TM or TE) perfect anomalous refraction, to dielectric-loaded architectures implementing dual-polarized routing of the incident wave. Beyond highlighting concrete paths to address TE-polarized fields in such formations, our results, validated via full-wave simulations and experiments at K band, showcase the great potential of metal-based MGs for manipulating fields in transmission, facilitating effective synthesis of durable dual-polarized beamforming superstrates for environmentally demanding and high power antenna applications.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出并实验验证了一套用于设计透射式金属超光栅（MG）的完整解析方法，以实现双极化异常折射。针对带可控介质加载的穿孔金属板复合结构，作者建立了严格的模式匹配公式，将超光栅的各个自由度与反射、透射的各阶 Floquet-Bloch 模式联系起来，从而对横电（TE）与横磁（TM）极化都能实现高效波束偏折。该解析框架通用性强，可精确建模单元内含有多个矩形穿孔、且每孔可加载介质的单层与双层结构。作者利用这些丰富的自由度设计了多种极化敏感的透射式超光栅：从实现单一极化（TM 或 TE）完美异常折射的全金属单层与双层结构，到实现入射波双极化分路的介质加载结构。研究不仅指出了在此类结构中处理 TE 极化场的具体路径，还通过 K 波段全波仿真与实验验证，展示了金属基超光栅在透射场调控方面的巨大潜力，可用于构建耐用、双极化波束赋形的上层天线罩，服务于环境严苛与高功率天线应用。
items.highlight_zh: 严格模式匹配框架设计介质加载金属超光栅，实现双极化透射异常折射
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：如何让一束电磁波穿过一层薄薄的“人工结构”后，按指定角度偏折，并且对两种基本极化（TE 和 TM）都有效。传统超表面多用介质材料或复杂多层结构，而全金属结构更耐高温、耐高功率，但设计缺乏系统的理论工具。
2. 用了什么方法：作者把金属板打上多个矩形孔、并在孔中填充介质，构成“复合介质加载金属超光栅”。他们建立了严格的模式匹配解析模型：把孔的形状、数量、介质填充、层数等设计自由度，与透射/反射出来的各阶 Floquet-Bloch 模式直接挂钩，从而不必盲目地做大规模数值试错，就能算出怎样偏折波束。
3. 有什么结果：该模型能精确描述单层和双层、每个单元含多个孔并可选填充介质的结构。基于此设计出多类器件：全金属单层/双层结构可实现单一极化（TM 或 TE）的“完美”异常折射；介质加载结构则能把入射波按极化分到不同方向（双极化分路）。结果经 K 波段全波仿真与实测验证。
4. 为何重要：它给出了一套可直接用于工程设计的解析工具，并证明金属基超光栅能高效操控透射波，为高功率、恶劣环境下工作的双极化天线波束赋形上层结构提供了可行方案。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
items.title_zh: 基于潜世界模型子块展开的 VLA 高效强化学习
items.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）可利用“想象”经验改进预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。然而现有 VLA-MBRL 方法多依赖大规模图像或视频生成世界模型，计算开销巨大。潜世界模型更高效，但面临两个挑战：递归预测中的误差累积，以及与 VLA 视觉输入接口不兼容。为此，作者提出 LS-MBPO——一个利用潜世界模型改进预训练 VLA 的轻量级残差 MBRL 框架。其两项关键技术为：（1）分层强制（Hierarchical Forcing），结合稠密因果监督与自回归反馈以缓解累积预测误差；（2）潜子块展开（Latent Subchunk Rollouts），利用冻结 VLA 策略输出的动作块与一个潜残差策略进行连续子块精化，从而弥合潜空间想象与 VLA 策略执行之间的差距。作者还引入进度条件分支起点课程，使展开起点从任务后段逐步前移，从而能从短程想象中有效学习策略。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 与真实 ALOHA 机器人上的实验表明，LS-MBPO 的任务性能与训练效率均优于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 轻量潜世界模型加子块展开，让预训练 VLA 训练更省更准
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：VLA（视觉-语言-动作）大模型能让机器人看图、听指令、做动作，但预训练好之后还想继续变强，就需要强化学习。一种省数据的办法是让模型在“想象”中练习（基于模型的强化学习）。可现有做法要靠生成图像或视频来想象，代价太高；而更省算力的“潜世界模型”（在抽象特征空间里想象）又有两个毛病：一步步预测会越错越离谱，而且和 VLA 习惯的视觉输入接口对不上。
2. 用了什么方法：作者提出 LS-MBPO。一是“分层强制”：在想象时既给密集的逐步监督，又保留自回归反馈，压制误差滚雪球。二是“潜子块展开”：冻结原来的 VLA，用它的动作片段作为起点，再让一个小的潜空间“残差策略”在潜想象中逐段微调，使想象与真正执行衔接起来。三是“进度条件分支起点课程”：让想象从任务靠后的阶段开始，逐渐前移到靠前阶段，使短程想象也能学到有效策略。
3. 有什么结果：在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 仿真和真实 ALOHA 机器人上，LS-MBPO 的任务成功率与训练效率都优于现有方法。
4. 为何重要：它说明不必依赖昂贵的视频生成，只用轻量潜世界模型就能让机器人策略在线提升，为 VLA 在真实机器人上的持续学习提供了更实用的路线。

items.title_en: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
items.title_zh: SheetAlign：面向表格智能体的接地交互与阶段隔离学习
items.abstract_en: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, our grounded task interface improves Qwen3-4B's accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% on average without training. With learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% accuracy on average on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: 电子表格广泛用于数据分析与决策支持。为保护敏感数据并控制部署成本，本地部署的开源大模型成为表格自动化的选择。复杂表格任务既需任务推理又需理解工作簿，而预定义操作接口还带来工具选择与调用负担。作者提出 SheetAlign 框架，围绕“在哪里操作、改什么、如何实现变换”组织分阶段策略学习：任务引导的检查与 API 接地把代码生成锚定在工作簿观察与可用操作上，阶段隔离学习用编辑进度奖励优化程序生成与审核；推理时通过工作簿状态间的一致性选择程序。在 SpreadsheetBench 上，接地任务接口无需训练即使 Qwen3-4B 平均准确率从 13.5% 升至 29.2%；结合学习与执行一致性后平均达 32.8%，在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达 30.1%，优于同类基线。
items.highlight_zh: 阶段隔离学习与 API 接地使 4B 模型表格准确率翻倍
items.digest_zh:
问题：若用云端大模型自动分析电子表格，敏感数据有泄露风险且成本高，因此更希望本地部署开源模型；但复杂表格任务既要理解任务意图，又要读懂工作簿结构，而固定的操作接口还要求模型正确选择并调用工具。
方法：SheetAlign 把任务拆成三步——在哪里操作（任务引导的工作簿检查与 API 接地）、改什么（生成变换程序）、如何校验（阶段隔离学习，以编辑进度为奖励分别优化程序生成与审核）。推理时用多次执行后工作簿状态的一致性挑选最可靠的程序。
结果：在 SpreadsheetBench 上，仅靠接地的任务接口、不做训练，Qwen3-4B 的平均准确率就从 13.5% 升到 29.2%；再加上学习与执行一致性后平均达 32.8%，在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达 30.1%，优于同类基线。
意义：说明把代码锚定在真实的单元格观察与可用 API 之上，并分阶段训练，能让较小规模的开源模型在本地化表格自动化中更可靠。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接式 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它建立在高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，包含两项关键创新。其一，将原始点直接配准到地图并随之更新地图（即建图），无需提取特征；这既能利用环境中的细微特征提高精度，也使算法天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR。其二，用增量式 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持增量更新（点的插入、删除）与动态重平衡。与八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d 树等现有动态数据结构相比，ikd-Tree 整体性能更优，并天然支持树上下采样。我们在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做了详尽基准比较，FAST-LIO2 以远低得多的计算量取得持续更高的精度；并在小视场固态 LiDAR 上开展多项真实实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（大型室外场景可达 100 Hz 里程计与建图）、鲁棒（杂乱室内、转速达 1000 deg/s 时仍可靠估计位姿）、通用（适用于多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），且精度仍高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 免特征提取的直接点云配准加增量 k-d 树建图，又快又准
items.digest_zh:
- 要解决什么：LiDAR-惯性里程计既要算得快又要稳。传统流程先从点云提取角点、面点等特征再配准，但特征提取是手工设计的，依赖特定雷达扫描模式，还会丢掉环境里的细节。
- 怎么做：两项改动。第一，直接把原始点配准到地图并更新地图，完全不提特征，因此能利用细微结构提升精度，也自动适配各种新式雷达，包括视场很小的固态雷达。第二，用增量 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 存地图，支持点的插入与删除、动态重平衡，还能直接在树上完成下采样；与八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d 树相比综合表现更好。整体仍架在紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波上。
- 结果：在多个公开数据集的 19 个序列上，精度一致高于现有先进系统，而计算量小得多；大型室外场景能达到 100 Hz 的里程计与建图；在杂乱室内、旋转速度高达 1000 deg/s 时仍能可靠估计位姿；在多线旋转雷达和小视场固态雷达、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器上都能跑。
- 为何重要：它把手工的特征提取环节整个去掉，用高效数据结构替代，工程上更简洁、更通用，尤其适合快速运动和小视场固态雷达，已成为 LiDAR SLAM 中被广泛采用的基础方案。

items.title_en: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 探测“意识”心智：视觉-语言模型中的选择性访问与全局工作空间
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）整合视觉与文本信息，但其输出并不揭示内部概念表征。全局工作空间理论（GWT）提出，信息从并行的脑过程中被选择，在共享工作空间中被整合，并可供专门化过程使用。我们引入多模态概念透镜（MC-Lens），一种多模态雅可比透镜，用于研究VLM概念处理中的这些功能。其视觉编码器和语言解码器透镜将中间状态映射到由解码器输出词表定义的共享语义空间，以比较跨模态的概念可访问性。MC-Lens支持内部概念干预，以考察被访问概念在下游计算中的作用。（i）可访问性与选择性访问。多模态概念信息可在中间状态中读取，并可根据任务需要被选择性访问。我们将“读出载体”从一个名称词元扩展到一个词元集合，以更好地捕获和表达概念信息，并支持反事实实验。（ii）下游计算中的概念。反事实实验表明，被访问的概念信息参与下游计算与推理。（iii）跨模态对齐与选择性访问的发展。我们开发了两个J空间度量，在受控VLM训练中比隐藏状态余弦更清晰地追踪跨模态概念对齐的发展。实验还表明，可靠的选择性访问的发展晚于概念可访问性。（iv）跨模型的共享功能。在不同VLM系列和规模中，尽管内部组织存在差异，我们发现了概念可访问性、查询依赖的选择性以及跨任务干预效应的共享模式。这些发现为在多模态人工系统中研究GWT以及它如何指导跨模态对齐改进提供了实验基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: HealthFound: a health world model for quantitative reasoning on longitudinal health profiles
items.title_zh: HealthFound：面向纵向健康档案定量推理的健康世界模型
items.abstract_en: Medical large language models have shown promise in medical knowledge retrieval and clinical reasoning but remain limited in quantitative reasoning over longitudinal health data, partly due to the lack of effective data construction and model training strategies tailored to large-scale prospective cohorts. Here, we present HealthFound, a health world model trained on 12.4 million constructed examples, including 14-year longitudinal biomedical records from 501,936 participants and datasets for medical knowledge and general reasoning. We propose a three-stage training framework comprising progressive curriculum supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled retention fine-tuning, and task-verifiable policy optimization. This enables the model to effectively parse heterogeneous quantitative data and perform robust quantitative reasoning about incident diseases and health trajectories. HealthFound achieves the highest mean accuracy across eight public medical benchmarks. On the task of predicting 1,074 future disease onsets, it outperforms the closest large language model by approximately 10 percentage points on average. In two independent external validations (MIMIC-IV and NHANES), it demonstrates superior zero-shot generalization, achieving improvements of over 5.2% across 417 disease endpoints. The model also achieves top results on tasks involving literature-derived question answering and quantitative indicator imputation. Furthermore, HealthFound generates interpretable reasoning rationales that are consistent with established biomedical knowledge. Collectively, our results demonstrate that HealthFound enables medical LLMs to evolve from static knowledge repositories into dynamic quantitative reasoning engines over longitudinal health data.
items.abstract_zh: 医学大语言模型在医学知识检索与临床推理上展现潜力，但在纵向健康数据的定量推理上仍受限，部分原因在于缺少面向大规模前瞻队列的数据构建与模型训练策略。本文提出 HealthFound，一个在 1240 万个构建样本上训练的健康世界模型，数据包括 501,936 名参与者长达 14 年的纵向生物医学记录，以及医学知识与通用推理数据集。我们提出三阶段训练框架：渐进式课程监督微调、拒绝采样保留微调与任务可验证的策略优化，使模型能有效解析异构定量数据，并对新发疾病与健康轨迹进行稳健的定量推理。HealthFound 在八个公开医学基准上取得最高平均准确率；在预测 1,074 种未来疾病发病的任务上，比最接近的大语言模型平均高出约 10 个百分点。在 MIMIC-IV 与 NHANES 两项独立外部验证中，它在 417 个疾病终点上取得超过 5.2% 的提升，展现出优异的零样本泛化能力。模型在文献衍生问答与定量指标插补任务上也居首，并能生成与既有生物医学知识一致的可解释推理依据。结果表明，HealthFound 使医学大模型从静态知识库演进为面向纵向健康数据的动态定量推理引擎。
items.highlight_zh: 三阶段训练让医学大模型做纵向健康数据定量推理
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：医学大模型擅长背知识、答临床题，但对“纵向”健康数据（多年体检与化验指标的数值变化）做定量推理仍很弱，且缺少面向大规模前瞻队列的数据构造与训练方法。
- 方法：构建 1240 万样本的训练数据，包含 50 万余名参与者长达 14 年的纵向生物医学记录，以及医学知识和通用推理数据；采用三阶段训练——渐进式课程监督微调、拒绝采样保留微调、任务可验证的策略优化，使模型学会解析异构的定量数据。
- 结果：在 8 个公开医学基准上平均准确率最高；预测 1,074 种未来疾病发病，比最接近的大模型平均高约 10 个百分点；在 MIMIC-IV 与 NHANES 两个外部数据上，对 417 个疾病终点零样本提升超过 5.2%；文献问答与指标插补任务同样领先，并能给出符合生物医学知识的可解释推理。
- 为何重要：它把医学大模型从“静态知识库”推向“动态定量推理引擎”，为基于长期健康档案的疾病风险预测与健康管理提供了可验证的新范式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Spatially multiplexed opto-electronic Ising machine with single-shot parallel readout of 100,000 spins
items.title_zh: 具有10万个自旋单次并行读出的空间复用光电伊辛机
items.abstract_en: Ising machines offer a promising route to solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems by mapping them onto the ground state of the Ising model. Free-space optical implementations are attractive for their inherent parallelism, scalability, and energy efficiency, yet nearly all rely on individual, sequential spin updates, leaving most of this parallelism unexploited. Here, we reclaim it with a free-space optical analog Ising machine built from off-the-shelf components in which every spin is addressed in parallel and read out in a single camera shot, while letting the system evolve under analog dynamics rather than being written and read one spin at a time. We demonstrate this architecture with over 100,000 spins, the largest spatially multiplexed analog Ising machine reported to date, with a realistic path beyond one million spins limited only by spatial-light-modulator and camera resolution. Across sparse and dense MaxCut and fully connected number-partitioning instances, our machine matches state-of-the-art solution quality. Because every spin updates in parallel, throughput increases with system size, unlike time-multiplexed machines, which slow as problems grow. The same free-space geometry also lets us solve more than 50 problem instances simultaneously, further boosting throughput. Together, these results mark an important step towards a scalable, and energy-efficient Ising machine.
items.abstract_zh: 伊辛机通过将NP难组合优化问题映射到伊辛模型的基态，为解决这些问题提供了一条有前景的途径。自由空间光学实现因其固有的并行性、可扩展性和能效而颇具吸引力，然而几乎所有实现都依赖单个、顺序的自旋更新，导致大部分并行性未被利用。在此，我们利用由现成组件构建的自由空间光学模拟伊辛机重新获得这种并行性：其中每个自旋都被并行寻址，并通过单次相机拍摄读出，同时让系统在模拟动力学下演化，而不是一次写入和读取一个自旋。我们以超过100,000个自旋展示了该架构，这是迄今为止报道的最大的空间复用模拟伊辛机，并且仅受空间光调制器和相机分辨率限制，具有超过一百万个自旋的现实路径。在稀疏和稠密MaxCut以及全连接数划分实例上，我们的机器达到了最先进的解质量。由于每个自旋并行更新，吞吐量随系统规模增大而提高，这与时间复用、会随问题增大而变慢的机器不同。相同的自由空间几何结构还使我们能够同时求解50多个问题实例，进一步提高吞吐量。总之，这些结果标志着朝着可扩展且高能效的伊辛机迈出了重要一步。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 通过微调视觉语言模型实现目标引导的强化学习
items.abstract_en: Exploration remains a major challenge for reinforcement learning (RL) agents in Craftax-style environments due to sparse rewards and long horizons. Large language models (LLMs) can guide exploration by generating high-level goals, but methods using models without explicit task adaptation often rely on carefully designed prompts and may produce inconsistent or contextually inappropriate goals. We introduce CCGP-2M, a multimodal goal-preference dataset constructed from interaction trajectories in Craftax-Classic, and propose a vision-language model (VLM)-guided RL framework that learns environment-specific goal guidance from this dataset. The framework consists of two stages: offline VLM fine-tuning and online goal-guided RL. In the offline stage, we align the VLM with goal preferences using Kullback-Leibler Token-level Direct Preference Optimization (KLTDPO), which combines token-level KL regularization with distributionally robust reweighting. Experiments on Craftax-Classic show that our method collects diamonds earlier than state-of-the-art baselines, achieves the highest score and reward, and attains the highest success rates on most achievements.
items.abstract_zh: 在 Craftax 类环境中，稀疏奖励与长时程使探索成为强化学习（RL）智能体的主要难题。大语言模型（LLM）可通过生成高层目标来引导探索，但未做明确任务适配的模型往往依赖精心设计的提示，可能产生不一致或不符合情境的目标。我们构建了 CCGP-2M——一个由 Craftax-Classic 交互轨迹构造的多模态目标偏好数据集，并提出一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的 RL 框架，从该数据集中学习环境特定的目标引导。框架包含两个阶段：离线 VLM 微调与在线目标引导 RL。离线阶段使用 KLTDPO（token 级 KL 正则结合分布鲁棒重加权）使 VLM 对齐目标偏好。在 Craftax-Classic 上的实验表明，本方法比最先进的基线更早采集到钻石，取得最高得分与奖励，并在多数成就上取得最高成功率。
items.highlight_zh: 用偏好微调的 VLM 生成目标，引导 RL 智能体高效探索
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】在 Craftax 这类开放世界式的游戏环境中，奖励非常稀疏、任务链很长，智能体很难靠随机试错发现有用行为，探索因此成为强化学习最头疼的问题。一个思路是让大语言模型充当“军师”，不断给出“下一步该干什么”的高层目标。但现成模型没在特定环境里训练过，只能靠人工反复雕琢提示词，输出的目标常常前后矛盾或者根本不符合当前情境。

【用了什么方法】作者做了两件事。第一，构建 CCGP-2M：从 Craftax-Classic 的真实交互轨迹里整理出多模态的目标偏好数据集，让模型学习“在当前画面下，哪种目标更值得追求”。第二，提出两阶段框架：先离线微调视觉语言模型，用 KLTDPO 对齐偏好——它在 token 级别加 KL 正则以防偏离原模型太远，同时用分布鲁棒的重加权来应对偏好数据分布不均；再在线用微调后的 VLM 给出目标，引导 RL 智能体去探索和执行。

【有什么结果】在 Craftax-Classic 上，该方法比当前最强基线更早拿到钻石，最终得分与累计奖励最高，并且在多数成就上成功率最高。

【为何重要】它把“用 LLM 指导探索”从依赖手工提示的脆弱做法，转变为可由数据驱动的、环境自适应的做法：模型不再是通用聊天助手，而是懂这个游戏的目标规划器。这为稀疏奖励、长时程任务中的探索问题提供了一个可复制的范式。

items.title_en: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
items.title_zh: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview技术报告
items.abstract_en: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and a separate, zero-initialized right-context convolution branch. Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, it reaches a reported generation speed of 680 tokens/s using one NVIDIA GB300 GPU at BF16 precision and batch size one. We organize the evaluation around model quality, drafting and verification costs, and deployment under constrained memory. We also describe a decision-model variant that generates answers to related questions in one denoising pass. On an internal set of 500 groups, joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍Clover-35B-A3B-Preview（Clover），一种专家混合扩散语言模型，总参数量350亿，激活参数量30亿，支持思考模式生成。Clover通过将先前生成上下文的循环记忆与当前块内的双向softmax注意力相结合，将Gated Delta Networks适配到块扩散。历史记忆读出与当前块令牌在共享softmax中竞争，并具有可学习的块大小校准和单独、零初始化的右上下文卷积分支。Clover在七项评估的智能体指标上领先，包括SWE-bench Verified上的73.6和Terminal-Bench 2.1上的51.7。在内部智能体工作负载上，使用一块NVIDIA GB300 GPU、BF16精度和批大小一，其报告的生成速度达到680 tokens/s。我们围绕模型质量、起草与验证成本以及受限内存下的部署来组织评估。我们还描述了一种决策模型变体，其在一次去噪过程中生成相关问题的答案。在内部500组集合上，联合预测将问题准确率从90.37%提高到93.88%，并将全组正确率从65.4%提高到77.0%。

items.title_en: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
items.title_zh: 学习动作改变了什么：面向动力学忠实世界模型的动作效应匹配
items.abstract_en: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations. This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes. To address this, we propose AFFECT, an auxiliary training objective for learning the distribution of visual changes induced by action perturbations. Specifically, we inject temporally correlated noise into the actions of a policy trained on task-agnostic human teleoperation. We then train the world model so that its generated videos respond to this noise as the recorded videos do, without requiring repeated executions from the same initial state. Across OGBench simulation and real-world DROID and ALOHA-2 setups, AFFECT makes world-model rollouts more faithful to real outcomes. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates in the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, alongside up to 23% lower FVD. These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型旨在预测动作下的环境动力学，从而无需在真实世界中执行动作即可预测动作后果。然而，尽管当前世界模型生成的视频越来越逼真，它们往往无法捕捉小的动作变化如何影响未来观测。这限制了它们在机器人策略评估和基于模型的规划等任务中的使用，在这些任务中，几乎相同的动作可能导致定性不同的结果。为解决此问题，我们提出AFFECT，一种辅助训练目标，用于学习由动作扰动引起的视觉变化分布。具体而言，我们向在任务无关的人类遥操作上训练的策略动作中注入时间相关噪声。然后我们训练世界模型，使其生成的视频对该噪声的响应与记录视频相同，而无需从相同初始状态重复执行。在OGBench仿真以及真实世界DROID和ALOHA-2设置中，AFFECT使世界模型rollout更忠实于真实结果。在DROID上，世界模型中与真实机器人上的策略成功率之间的Pearson相关性从0.47升至0.79，同时FVD降低最多23%。这些收益延续到规划中，使用AFFECT训练的世界模型选择动作可将任务成功率提高最多8.3%。

recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
items.title_zh: 一个先验，两种动力学：改造视频扩散Transformer用于自监督潜动作学习
items.abstract_en: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 视频揭示了世界如何变化，但很少揭示导致这些变化的动作。潜在动作学习从视觉过渡中恢复此类监督，但通常在很大程度上从头学习底层动力学。我们探究预训练视频生成器是否可以转而同时为逆向动力学和正向动力学提供先验。我们引入O$^{2}$LaF，其基于一个简单原则：一个先验，两种动力学。我们用同一个预训练视频DiT初始化两个模型，并将它们适配到各自不同的角色：一个带有可学习动作查询的前馈过渡编码器用于逆向动力学，以及一个因果的、以动作为条件的视频生成器用于正向动力学。通过控制信息访问并通过紧凑瓶颈端到端优化两种动力学，O$^{2}$LaF从无标签视频中学习可迁移的动作。在导航和机器人操作中，O$^{2}$LaF在少样本动作探测上建立了新的最先进水平，并实现了跨视觉上下文和具身形态更强的零样本动作迁移。除生成式视频先验之外，我们进一步将框架扩展到V-JEPA2等预测性表示先验，取得了有竞争力的性能。我们的发现提出了潜在动作学习的一种更广泛范式：重新利用预训练视频模型来发现可迁移动作并预测其后果。

items.title_en: Leveraging the largest harmonized epigenomic data collection for metadata prediction validated and augmented over 350,000 public epigenomic datasets
items.title_zh: 利用最大的统一表观基因组数据集合进行元数据预测，并在超过350,000个公共表观基因组数据集上验证和扩充
items.abstract_en: Epigenomic data found in public databases often suffer from issues of non-standardization and incompleteness in their associated metadata. There are currently no automated approaches to validate or correct such missing or inaccurate metadata information. To tackle this challenge, we harnessed the extensive harmonized data and metadata provided by the EpiATLAS project of the International Human Epigenome Consortium (IHEC) to train EpiClass, a suite of machine learning classifiers that can predict key metadata (~98% accuracy), including experimental assay, donor sex, biospecimen source and sample cancer status. The development of these classifiers enabled the identification of a few mislabeled and low-quality datasets in the EpiATLAS project, while also completing with high-confidence most of the missing metadata. These classifiers were also validated on thousands of ENCODE datasets absent from the initial training, then applied to assess more than 350,000 human ChIP-seq and RNA-seq datasets from public repositories. Overall, this effort not only validated the accuracy of the vast majority of assays reported by the original authors, but also unveiled ~500 datasets with discrepancies, in particular through data swap during data entry. More importantly, EpiClass also supplied high-confidence predictions for over 320,000 metadata attributes of the biological sample such as the sex, cancer status and biomaterial type, which had been originally omitted in the majority of cases. Our work introduces the first systematic approach for metadata correction and augmentation, enhancing the quality and reliability of publicly available epigenomic data.
items.abstract_zh: 公共数据库中的表观基因组数据常存在关联元数据不标准化和不完整的问题。目前尚无自动化方法来验证或纠正此类缺失或不准确的元数据信息。为应对这一挑战，我们利用国际人类表观基因组联盟（IHEC）EpiATLAS项目提供的大量统一数据和元数据，训练EpiClass，这是一套机器学习分类器，可预测关键元数据（约98%准确率），包括实验测定、供体性别、生物样本来源和样本癌症状态。这些分类器的开发使得能够识别EpiATLAS项目中少数标记错误和低质量的数据集，同时以高置信度补全了大多数缺失元数据。这些分类器还在初始训练中未包含的数千个ENCODE数据集上得到验证，随后应用于评估来自公共存储库的超过350,000个人类ChIP-seq和RNA-seq数据集。总体而言，这项工作不仅验证了原始作者报告的绝大多数测定的准确性，还揭示了约500个存在差异的数据集，特别是数据录入期间的数据交换。更重要的是，EpiClass还为超过320,000个生物样本元数据属性提供了高置信度预测，如性别、癌症状态和生物材料类型，而这些属性在大多数情况下最初被省略。我们的工作引入了首个用于元数据校正和扩充的系统化方法，提高了公开可用表观基因组数据的质量和可靠性。

items.title_en: Dephasing-free plasma acceleration with millijoule picosecond lasers
items.title_zh: 毫焦级皮秒激光实现无退相干的等离子体加速
items.abstract_en: Laser-plasma accelerators reach gradients a thousand times above radio-frequency cavities, but need joule-class femtosecond lasers firing about once per second, and electrons outrun the wave. A comb of laser lines spaced by the plasma frequency, each in its own mode of a matched channel, drives a wake moving at the speed of light. In particle-in-cell simulations a 175\,mJ, 0.5\,ps drive holds 21\,GV/m over 10\,mm with a 0.15\,rad phase drift; a test electron gains 208\,MeV, 2.6 times more than in one mode. Because the wave builds up resonantly, the required energy falls steeply with density: a 29\,mJ drive sustains 20\,GV/m, and a 10\,mJ drive, within reach of kilohertz industrial lasers, gives a test electron 170\,MeV over 30\,mm. A simulated stage transfers 5\,\% of the laser energy to the wake; the Manley--Rowe limit is about 18\,\% for five lines.
items.abstract_zh: 激光等离子体加速的梯度比射频腔高上千倍，但通常需要焦耳级飞秒激光、每秒仅约一次，且电子会超越波而失相。作者用一列频率间隔等于等离子体频率的激光梳，让每条谱线处于匹配通道的对应模式，从而驱动以光速前进的尾波。粒子网格模拟中，175 mJ、0.5 ps 的驱动在 10 mm 内维持 21 GV/m，相位漂移仅 0.15 rad，测试电子获得 208 MeV，为单模式的 2.6 倍。由于波靠共振建立，所需能量随密度陡降：29 mJ 可维持 20 GV/m，而 10 mJ（千赫兹工业激光可达）在 30 mm 内给出 170 MeV。模拟中 5% 的激光能量转入尾波，五条谱线的 Manley–Rowe 极限约 18%。
items.highlight_zh: 毫焦皮秒激光梳驱动无退相等离子体尾波加速
items.digest_zh:
问题：激光尾波加速的梯度极高，但依赖大型焦耳级飞秒激光，重复频率很低；同时电子在波中的前进速度超过波速，很快失相，难以长距离加速。
方法：作者提出用一列频率间隔恰为等离子体频率的激光谱线（激光梳），每条谱线激发匹配通道中的一个模式，多模式叠加形成以光速传播的尾波，让电子始终处于加速相位。
结果：粒子网格模拟显示，175 mJ、0.5 ps 的驱动可在 10 mm 内保持 21 GV/m 梯度，相位漂移仅 0.15 rad；测试电子获得 208 MeV，是单模式情形的 2.6 倍。由于尾波靠共振逐步建立，所需激光能量随等离子体密度升高而迅速下降：29 mJ 可维持 20 GV/m，10 mJ 就可在 30 mm 内把电子加速到 170 MeV。模拟中约 5% 的激光能量转化为尾波能量，五条谱线对应的 Manley–Rowe 理论上限约 18%。
意义：这意味着高梯度、低失相的电子加速或许不再需要庞大的焦耳级激光，而可用千赫兹工业级毫焦皮秒激光实现。

items.title_en: Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
items.title_zh: 面向单细胞时空动力学的水平流匹配
items.abstract_en: Learning the spatiotemporal dynamics of cells from spatial transcriptomics requires connecting snapshots of different cells acquired in different coordinate frames. A rotation or translation of a section can appear as cell movement and distort the inferred correspondence. We introduce horizontal flow matching, which learns changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance up to shared rigid motion. The dynamics follow a continuity--reaction equation whose action assigns no cost to shared rigid motion, and the resulting horizontal projector removes this component from spatial prediction errors during learning and from predicted velocities during generation. An equivalent endpoint problem jointly estimates correspondence and relative pose in Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry and yields analytic paths whose velocity and growth serve as regression targets. Regressing these targets recovers the horizontal dynamics under ideal population conditions. Our model, HORIZON, uses an equivariant transformer to predict velocity and growth from the current tissue, so that a tissue can be generated continuously from a single initial snapshot. On a simulated tissue observed in perturbed coordinate frames, alignment improves reconstruction and projection reduces rigid drift. On four spatial transcriptomics time courses, HORIZON reconstructs tissue geometry, gene expression, and cell abundance more accurately than existing spatial and unbalanced trajectory methods, and interpolates held-out developmental stages.
items.abstract_zh: 从空间转录组学习细胞的时空动力学，需要把在不同坐标系中采集的细胞快照联系起来。切片的旋转或平移会被误当成细胞运动，扭曲推断出的对应关系。我们提出水平流匹配（horizontal flow matching）：在允许共同刚体运动的前提下，学习组织结构、分子状态与细胞丰度的变化。其动力学服从连续性-反应方程，该方程的作用量对共同刚体运动不计代价；由此得到的水平投影器在学习时从空间预测误差中、在生成时从预测速度中移除该成分。等价的端点问题在 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao 几何下联合估计对应关系与相对位姿，给出解析路径，其速度与增长量可作为回归目标；回归这些目标可在理想群体条件下恢复水平动力学。我们的模型 HORIZON 用等变 Transformer 从当前组织预测速度与增长，使组织可由单一初始快照连续生成。在受扰动坐标系下观测的模拟组织中，对齐改善重建、投影抑制刚性漂移。在四个空间转录组时间序列上，HORIZON 对组织几何、基因表达与细胞丰度的重建比现有空间与不平衡轨迹方法更准确，并能插值出留出的发育阶段。
items.highlight_zh: 把切片整体刚体运动视为零代价，使流匹配只学生物学真实变化
items.digest_zh:
- 要解决什么：空间转录组只能给出若干时间点的「切片快照」，却想从中推断细胞如何迁移、增殖与分化。难点在于不同切片处在不同坐标系里：整张切片被旋转或平移，看起来就像细胞集体移动，于是「真实的生物学运动」和「切片摆放差异」混在一起，推断出的对应关系会被扭曲。
- 怎么做：提出水平流匹配。动力学写成连续性-反应方程，但规定所有细胞共同做刚体运动不付代价，于是刚体成分在学习时被从空间预测误差中投影掉、在生成时被从预测速度中剔除。等价地，把问题改写为端点问题：在 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao 几何下同时估计细胞对应关系与切片相对位姿，得到解析路径，其速度与增长量作为回归目标。模型 HORIZON 用等变 Transformer 从当前组织预测速度与增长，可从单个初始快照连续生成后续组织。
- 结果：在坐标系被扰动的模拟组织上，对齐改善了重建，投影抑制了刚性漂移；在四个真实空间转录组时间序列上，组织几何、基因表达与细胞丰度的重建都优于现有空间轨迹与不平衡方法，还能插值出未观测的发育阶段。
- 为何重要：把「对齐」与「动力学推断」统一到一个框架里，避免把技术性的错位误读成生物学信号，对发育、损伤修复等时空过程研究有直接价值。

items.title_en: RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
items.title_zh: RoSci：探索科学视觉语言模型的鲁棒性
items.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, which defines a model's ability to detect anomalies, assess solvability, and perform self-calibration when faced with Information Error (inconsistencies) or Information Loss (insufficiency). Specifically, we present RoSci-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,220 samples using a seed-variant strategy across six degradation types. To address VLM fragility, we further propose RoSci-Agent, a framework that employs a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to vet premises before reasoning. The evaluated VLMs sometimes answer questions whose premises are invalid or incomplete. RoSci-Agent achieves a higher Overall Robustness Score than the evaluated standalone VLMs. RoSci-Bench gives the multimodal reasoning community a common test of when models answer, request clarification, or reject a scientific question.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展使科学任务取得了显著进步。然而，这些模型通常被假设接收完整且准确的信息，忽视了真实场景中错误/缺失信息的挑战。为填补这一空白，我们引入科学模型鲁棒性概念，其定义模型在面对信息错误（不一致）或信息丢失（不充分）时检测异常、评估可解性并进行自校准的能力。具体而言，我们提出RoSci-Bench，一个包含1,220个样本的诊断基准，采用种子变体策略覆盖六种退化类型。为解决VLM的脆弱性，我们进一步提出RoSci-Agent，一个采用解析-验证-决策（Parse-Verify-Decide）流水线在推理前审查前提的框架。被评估的VLM有时会回答前提无效或不完整的问题。与所评估的独立VLM相比，RoSci-Agent取得了更高的总体鲁棒性得分。RoSci-Bench为多模态推理社区提供了一个共同测试，用于判断模型何时回答、请求澄清或拒绝一个科学问题。

items.title_en: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
items.title_zh: 教视觉-语言-动作模型安全停止
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides an appropriate alternative response. SAFI comprises two stages, (1) fallback target construction, which assigns stationary arm commands and consistent gripper targets throughout prohibited-task demonstrations, and (2) joint policy adaptation, which learns these targets alongside the original actions of retained tasks. This supervision teaches an explicit alternative response at intermediate execution states while maintaining the robot's other skills. Extensive experiments with OpenVLA-OFT across LIBERO and BadLIBERO tasks evaluate prohibited completion, physical incidents, and retained-task performance. On the evaluated LIBERO tasks, SAFI reduces aggregate target success after takeover to 1.3\%, with no recorded physical incidents or action saturation, while preserving high retained-task success.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够根据视觉观察和语言指令执行多样任务。虽然先前工作探索了任务抑制和拒绝，但在执行已经开始后停止被禁止的行为并控制由此产生的物理响应仍然具有挑战性。我们的评估揭示，从初始状态抑制任务的策略在执行中途接管时仍可能完成任务。即使任务仍未完成，机器人也可能掉落所持物体，使得未完成成为不完整的安全度量。为应对这些挑战，我们引入状态感知回退模仿（State-Aware Fallback Imitation, SAFI），适用于保持动作可提供适当替代响应的任务。SAFI 包括两个阶段：（1）回退目标构建，在禁止任务演示全程分配静止机械臂命令和一致的夹爪目标；（2）联合策略适配，在保留任务的原始动作之外学习这些目标。这种监督在中间执行状态教授明确的替代响应，同时保持机器人的其他技能。使用 OpenVLA-OFT 在 LIBERO 和 BadLIBERO 任务上的大量实验评估了禁止任务完成、物理事件和保留任务性能。在评估的 LIBERO 任务上，SAFI 将接管后的聚合目标成功率降至 1.3%，未记录到物理事件或动作饱和，同时保持较高的保留任务成功率。

items.title_en: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
items.title_zh: 在失败之处修复：面向场景图生成的根因引导智能体化 harness 优化
items.abstract_en: Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. The analysis shows that the components where ground-truth triplets are lost differ across models and datasets. RoHa-SGG improves every metric on all five model-dataset combinations. Graph-constrained R@100 and mR@100 rise by up to 15.8 and 26.4 points for the multimodal LLM and by up to 3.6 and 10.1 points for the two-stage and one-stage models. With root-cause guidance, the harness search reaches the final score of an unguided search up to three times faster.
items.abstract_zh: 场景图生成（SGG）旨在检测图像中的对象并预测它们之间的关系。标准的 PredCls、SGCls 和 SGDet 设置显示了在没有真实边界框和标签时性能下降多少，但没有显示模型在哪里失败或为何失败。了解这一点将能够在模型失败处修复模型，而无需重新训练。我们提出 RoHa-SGG（面向 SGG 的根因引导 harness 优化），将智能体化 harness 优化扩展到 SGG。它优化 harness，即围绕冻结 SGG 模型的推理代码。RoHa-SGG 有两个主要 LLM 智能体。根因分析（RCA）智能体找到模型失败的组件并诊断原因，提议者智能体搜索能修复这些原因的 harness。我们在 Visual Genome 和 PSG 上，用代表性的两阶段、一阶段和多模态 LLM SGG 模型评估 RoHa-SGG。分析表明，真实三元组丢失的组件因模型和数据集而异。RoHa-SGG 在所有五个模型-数据集组合上提升每一项指标。对于多模态 LLM，图约束 R@100 和 mR@100 分别最多提升 15.8 和 26.4 个点；对于两阶段和一阶段模型，分别最多提升 3.6 和 10.1 个点。在根因引导下，harness 搜索达到无引导搜索最终分数的速度快至三倍。
