items.title_en: Layer-Wise Emergence of Human-Derived Object Dimensions in Deep Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 深度神经网络中源自人类的对象维度的逐层涌现
items.abstract_en: Object recognition in the human visual system is implemented within a hierarchy characterised by increasing feature complexity. Here, we investigated whether human-derived dimensions of object knowledge become increasingly predictable from layer-wise activations in deep neural networks (DNNs), and how this predictability is related to architecture, learning objective, dimension type, and stimulus statistics. To test this, we predicted human-derived dimensions from layer-wise activations of multiple DNNs and transformer models trained on large-scale datasets. In trained DNNs, information relevant to human-derived object dimensions was largely absent in early layers, strengthened across layers, and peaked in later layers, in contrast to the flatter, non-progressive profiles we observed for raw pixel statistics and untrained networks. Differences in architecture, including recurrence and skip connections, and learning objectives were associated with changes in the strength and distribution of dimension-relevant information across layers. Dimension type also modulated predictability: perceptual dimensions were more predictable than semantic dimensions in simpler representations, a gap that was reduced or absent in more complex models. Stimulus statistics further modulated where this information was most available, including in a separate material perception dataset. These findings indicate that the layer-wise increase in the predictability of human-derived dimensions depends on training rather than on network depth alone, and that where in the network this information becomes available differs systematically with architecture, learning objective, dimension type, and stimulus statistics.
items.abstract_zh: 人类视觉系统中的对象识别在特征复杂度递增的层级结构中实现。在此，我们研究源自人类的对象知识维度是否能从深度神经网络（DNN）的逐层激活中越来越可预测，以及这种可预测性与架构、学习目标、维度类型和刺激统计有何关系。为检验这一点，我们从在大型数据集上训练的多个 DNN 和 transformer 模型的逐层激活中预测源自人类的维度。在训练过的 DNN 中，与源自人类的对象维度相关的信息在早期层中基本缺失，在层间增强，并在较后层达到峰值，这与我们在原始像素统计和未训练网络中观察到的更平坦、非渐进式分布形成对比。架构差异（包括循环和跳跃连接）以及学习目标与跨层维度相关信息强度和分布的变化相关。维度类型也调节可预测性：在较简单表示中，感知维度比语义维度更可预测，而在更复杂模型中这一差距缩小或消失。刺激统计进一步调节这种信息最可用的位置，包括在一个单独的材料感知数据集中也是如此。这些发现表明，源自人类维度的可预测性的逐层增加取决于训练，而不仅仅是网络深度；并且，这种信息在网络中何处变得可用会随架构、学习目标、维度类型和刺激统计而系统性变化。

items.title_en: Material optimization of optical properties of particulate products by transition matrix method and sequential global programming
items.title_zh: 基于传输矩阵法与序贯全局规划的颗粒产物光学性质材料优化
items.abstract_en: Material optimization of nanoparticle assemblies, such as structurally coloured photonic crystals, attracts increasing interest. We combine the transition matrix method (TMM), which avoids spatial discretization of particles and surrounding medium, with sequential global programming (SGP) to optimize optical properties of particulate products by iteratively assigning predefined catalogue materials to individual particles. We derive exact separable models, reproducing the fully coupled objective under single-particle material changes, and computationally accessible first-order correct approximations for general continuously differentiable objectives. These approximations aim to capture the nonlinear, potentially nonconvex dependence on individual material variables beyond their local first-order behaviour. Within SGP, globally minimizing the particle-wise subproblems can yield substantial improvements in few outer iterations, including steps away from unfavourable stationary points, as previously demonstrated for discrete dipole approximation-based SGP. The construction exploits the decomposition of the TMM system matrix into a material-dependent block-diagonal and a material-independent coupling matrix, while the state and adjoint problems remain fully coupled. Applications include extinction, scattering quantities, and colour objectives. In a 35-particle extinction minimization problem, the objective decreases by 31.0% in 13 iterations. A fine-grid evaluation of the fully coupled objective shows that no tested single-particle material change improves the final design. For a 627-particle photonic crystal, chroma increases by 58.4-122.1% for different particle diameters in 17-42 iterations. The optimized designs favour absorbing material in layers away from the incident light, consistent with experimental findings.
items.abstract_zh: 纳米颗粒组装体（如结构色光子晶体）的材料优化日益受到关注。我们将无需对颗粒与周围介质做空间离散化的传输矩阵法（TMM）与序贯全局规划（SGP）相结合，通过迭代地为单个颗粒指定预定义材料库中的材料，来优化颗粒产物的光学性质。我们推导了精确的可分模型，能在单颗粒材料变化下复现完全耦合的目标函数，并给出对一般连续可微目标的计算可行的、一阶正确的近似，以捕捉对单个材料变量超越局部一阶行为的非线性、可能非凸的依赖。在 SGP 中，全局最小化逐颗粒子问题可在少量外迭代内带来显著改进，包括远离不利驻点的步骤。该构造利用了 TMM 系统矩阵可分解为材料相关的块对角矩阵与材料无关的耦合矩阵，而状态与伴随问题仍完全耦合。应用涵盖消光、散射量与颜色目标。在 35 颗粒的消光最小化问题中，目标在 13 次迭代内下降 31.0%；细网格评估表明没有测试过的单颗粒材料改动能改进最终设计。对 627 颗粒的光子晶体，不同颗粒直径下色度在 17–42 次迭代内提升 58.4–122.1%。优化设计倾向于在远离入射侧的材料层中使用吸收材料。
items.highlight_zh: TMM 结合 SGP，高效优化颗粒组装体的光学材料配置
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】如果想让一堆纳米颗粒（比如用来产生“结构色”的光子晶体）呈现想要的消光、散射或颜色效果，需要为每一颗颗粒挑选合适的材料。这是一个离散的组合优化问题：材料只能从给定目录里选，颗粒数量又可能成百上千，而且改一颗颗粒会影响整体的光场耦合，目标函数对材料变量既非线性也可能非凸。

【用了什么方法】作者把两件工具组合起来。一是传输矩阵法（TMM），它把颗粒与周围介质的散射关系写成矩阵，不需要在空间上划分网格，计算更省。二是序贯全局规划（SGP），它每次只优化“一颗颗粒的材料”这个子问题，但把子问题全局求解，而不是只沿梯度走一小步。关键的数学技巧是：TMM 的系统矩阵可以拆成一个与材料相关的块对角矩阵加上一个与材料无关的耦合矩阵，作者据此推导出精确的可分模型，以及针对一般连续可微目标的一阶正确近似，这样在解单颗粒子问题时还能保留非线性、非凸的影响。状态与伴随问题仍保持完全耦合，保证梯度正确。

【有什么结果】在 35 颗粒的消光最小化测试中，13 次外迭代就把目标降低了 31.0%，且用细网格重新评估后，没有任何单颗粒换材料能进一步改善，说明落点质量不错。在 627 颗粒的光子晶体上，不同颗粒直径下色度提升 58.4%–122.1%，用了 17–42 次迭代。优化出来的设计有一个有趣的规律：倾向于把吸收性材料放在远离入射光的那几层。

【为何重要】它说明“不 discretize、只用少量外层迭代”也能求解大规模颗粒组装体的材料配置问题，为设计结构色涂层、光学滤光器等提供了一条计算可行的路径。

items.title_en: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型的硬件加速：权重精度随流步递增
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models such as GR00T control robots through an action head: a diffusion transformer that turns noise into a chunk of actions in a few flow-matching steps. Every step re-reads all of the head's weights from DRAM but applies each weight to only about fifty tokens. Inference is therefore memory-bound, and its latency and energy are largely determined by the total number of transferred weight bits. We show that later flow steps attenuate the quantization errors of earlier steps, so the weight precision of an action head should rise over the steps. With plain per-channel rounding and without calibration or training, widths rising over the steps from 2 to 4 bits preserve the closed-loop success of robot policies. These widths transfer 25% fewer bits than 4-bit weights at every step. However, we show that on Jetson AGX Thor, current GPU kernels cannot exploit this per-step precision due to fixed overheads. We therefore present a programmable accelerator whose latency and energy both scale with the transferred weight bits. It decodes entropy-coded weights for bit-serial sub-arrays at the DRAM rate. Because the width changes per step, a run-time allocator divides these sub-arrays between the linear layers and the attention to balance their workloads. The same sub-arrays are thus capable of running action heads of different families and sizes, as well as a vision-language model. On the DRAM side, a requantizer and an entropy encoder at each bank let one stored 8-bit copy replace the copies of all widths. Simulated with LPDDR5X timing, our RTL implementation runs the GR00T N1.6 action head in 8.02 ms per inference with 2, 3, 3 and 4 bits in its four flow steps. With a copy per width and 50% of Thor's memory bandwidth, the accelerator runs this schedule 1.7x faster than Thor in NVFP4, at 9.1x less energy and equal closed-loop success.
items.abstract_zh: GR00T 等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过动作头控制机器人：动作头是一个扩散 Transformer，在少数流匹配步内把噪声变成一段动作。每一步都要从 DRAM 重新读取动作头全部权重，但每个权重只作用于约五十个 token，因此推理受内存带宽限制，其延迟与能耗主要由传输的权重比特总量决定。我们发现，较晚的流步会衰减较早步的量化误差，故动作头的权重精度应随步数上升。仅用普通的逐通道舍入、无需校准或训练，让位宽随步从 2 bit 升到 4 bit，即可保持机器人策略的闭环成功率，且比每步都用 4 bit 少传 25% 的比特。然而在 Jetson AGX Thor 上，现有 GPU 内核因固定开销无法利用这种逐步精度。为此我们提出可编程加速器，其延迟与能耗均随传输的权重比特缩放：它以 DRAM 速率对位串行子阵列解码熵编码权重；由于宽度逐步变化，运行时分配器在子阵列之间为线性层与注意力分配负载以均衡工作，同一批子阵列因而可运行不同家族与规模的动作头，以及视觉-语言模型。在 DRAM 侧，每个 bank 的重量化器与熵编码器让一份存储的 8-bit 副本替代各宽度的多份副本。以 LPDDR5X 时序仿真，我们的 RTL 实现以 2、3、3、4 bit 跑完 GR00T N1.6 动作头的四个流步，每次推理 8.02 ms。
items.highlight_zh: 权重位宽随流步由 2 升到 4 bit，省 25% 比特且不掉成功率
items.digest_zh:
- 要解决什么：VLA 模型（如 GR00T）用一个扩散式「动作头」在几步流匹配内把噪声变成一段机器人动作。每步都要把全部权重从 DRAM 重读一遍，而每个权重只用在大约 50 个 token 上，属于典型访存受限：延迟和能耗基本由「搬了多少比特的权重」决定。
- 关键观察：后面的流步会吸收前面步留下的量化误差，所以精度不必每步相同，可以逐步升高。
- 做法与算法结果：只用最普通的逐通道舍入，不做校准也不训练，让位宽随步从 2 bit 升到 4 bit，传输比特比全程 4 bit 少 25%，而机器人策略的闭环成功率不降。
- 硬件难点与设计：Jetson AGX Thor 上的 GPU 内核有固定开销，用不上这种逐级变精度。于是作者设计可编程加速器，延迟与能耗都随比特数缩放：以 DRAM 速率对位串行子阵列做熵解码；运行时分配器把子阵列在注意力与线性层之间分配以平衡负载；同一硬件还能跑不同家族与规模的动作头和视觉语言模型；DRAM 侧每个 bank 配重量化器与熵编码器，用一份 8-bit 存储副本替代各精度的多份副本。
- 结果：按 LPDDR5X 时序进行仿真，RTL 实现以 2、3、3、4 bit 四个流步跑完 GR00T N1.6 动作头，每次推理 8.02 ms。
- 为何重要：它把「算法上允许的精度调度」和「硬件上真能兑现的收益」接了起来，说明量化策略必须与内存系统协同设计，否则省下的比特变不成真正的延迟与能耗下降。

items.title_en: Tasklets: A Unit-Test Benchmark for Language Model Architectures
items.title_zh: Tasklets：面向语言模型架构的单元测试基准
items.abstract_en: We introduce Tasklets, a benchmark of small synthetic tasks for evaluating the computational capabilities of language model sequence-mixing layers. These tasks probe foundational capabilities such as recall, sequence manipulation, and state tracking. Such tasks are widely used in architecture research, but differences in task selection, formulation, and evaluation make comparisons across studies difficult. Tasklets brings these tasks together, organizing them by the capabilities they test and providing a shared setup for evaluating how different architectural layer types learn fundamental computations. We compare a broad range of layer types through controlled experiments with small models. Our task implementations and evaluation code support reproducible, low-cost testing of new architectural proposals: https://github.com/zaydzuhri/flame/tree/tasklets.
items.abstract_zh: 我们推出 Tasklets，一个用于评估语言模型序列混合层计算能力的小型合成任务基准。这些任务探测回忆、序列操作和状态跟踪等基础能力。此类任务在架构研究中被广泛使用，但任务选择、表述和评估的差异使跨研究比较变得困难。Tasklets 将这些任务汇集在一起，按其所测试的能力组织，并提供共享设置，用于评估不同架构层类型如何学习基本计算。我们通过小模型的控制实验比较广泛的层类型。我们的任务实现和评估代码支持对新架构提议进行可复现、低成本的测试：https://github.com/zaydzuhri/flame/tree/tasklets。

items.title_en: Real-time neuromorphic audio and vision perception for autonomous robotic applications: Integration and experimental evaluation on a rover platform
items.title_zh: 面向自主机器人应用的实时神经形态听觉与视觉感知：在巡视车平台上的集成与实验评估
items.abstract_en: Neuromorphic sensing and computing offer a promising alternative to conventional deep learning pipelines for mobile robots, where perception must run continuously under tight latency and energy constraints. However, most neuromorphic solutions are still evaluated offline or on isolated benchmarks, and their integration into complete robotic systems remains largely unexplored. In this technical report, a four-wheel rover platform is presented that combines three real-time perception pipelines: a classical audio tagging pipeline based on Pretrained Audio Neural Networks (PANNs) running on an NVIDIA Jetson GPU, a neuromorphic audio pipeline in which a spiking neural network (SNN) is deployed on the SynSense Xylo Audio~2 chip, and a neuromorphic vision pipeline in which events from an event-based camera are processed by the SpikeYOLO spiking detector for traffic cone detection. On the Xylo chip, the whole processing chain---from the microphone signal to the classification of low- and high-pitched sounds---is performed on-chip, while the host only configures the device and reads the output neurons. All models are deployed as containerised services and integrated through ROS~2, and a configurable action dispatcher maps the detected classes to robot behaviours, closing the loop between perception and actuation. The platform is demonstrated in a proof-of-concept scenario in which the robot reacts to sound classes detected by both audio pipelines and detects traffic cones with the event camera, showing the feasibility of integrating neuromorphic hardware into a multimodal robotic platform operating in real time.
items.abstract_zh: 神经形态感知与计算为移动机器人提供了替代传统深度学习流水线的有前景方案，因为移动机器人的感知必须在严格的时延与能耗约束下持续运行。然而，多数神经形态方案仍停留在离线评估或孤立基准测试，将其集成到完整机器人系统中尚少探索。本技术报告介绍一台四轮巡视车平台，集成了三条实时感知流水线：基于预训练音频神经网络（PANNs）并运行于 NVIDIA Jetson GPU 的传统音频标注流水线；将脉冲神经网络（SNN）部署于 SynSense Xylo Audio 2 芯片的神经形态音频流水线；以及由事件相机采集事件、经 SpikeYOLO 脉冲检测器处理以检测交通锥的神经形态视觉流水线。在 Xylo 芯片上，从麦克风信号到高低音分类的整条处理链均在芯片内完成，主机仅负责配置设备与读取输出神经元。所有模型以容器化服务部署并通过 ROS 2 集成，可配置的动作分发器将检测类别映射为机器人行为，闭合感知与执行的回路。平台在概念验证场景中演示：机器人对两条音频流水线检测到的声音类别作出反应，并用事件相机检测交通锥，表明将神经形态硬件集成到实时多模态机器人平台的可行性。
items.highlight_zh: 把脉冲神经网络芯片与事件相机接入巡视车，实时闭环验证可行性
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：移动机器人要一直“听”和“看”，但电池和算力有限、反应还必须快。神经形态（类脑）硬件用脉冲方式计算，理论上省电又低时延，可现有研究大多只在实验室离线跑基准测试，真正装到整台机器人上、与感知-行动闭环一起工作的例子很少。
2. 用了什么方法：作者搭了一台四轮巡视车，上面并行跑三条感知流水线：①传统音频标注，用 PANNs 模型在 NVIDIA Jetson GPU 上运行；②类脑音频，把脉冲神经网络（SNN）部署到 SynSense Xylo Audio 2 芯片，从麦克风信号到区分高低音全部在芯片内完成，主机只负责配置和读取输出；③类脑视觉，用事件相机采集数据，交给 SpikeYOLO 脉冲检测器识别交通锥。所有模型打包成容器服务，通过 ROS 2 通信，再用一个可配置的动作分发器把识别结果变成机器人动作。
3. 有什么结果：在概念验证场景中，机器人能对两条音频流水线各自识别出的声音类别作出反应，也能用事件相机找到交通锥，说明整条实时闭环可以跑通。
4. 为何重要：这是把神经形态芯片真正嵌入多模态机器人系统的工程示范。它不只是比较芯片性能，而是展示了软硬件集成、通信与行为映射的完整路径，为低功耗实时机器人感知提供了可复制的模板。

items.title_en: Ego2Ego: Generative Visual Perspective Taking Across Collaborators
items.title_zh: Ego2Ego：跨协作者的生成式视觉视角采择
items.abstract_en: Visual perspective taking, the ability to infer what another person sees from their position, is fundamental to human collaboration. However, prior works reduced perspective taking to state estimation, geometric reconstruction, or discrete question answering, whereas existing cross-view video generation methods either inferred the target view from the input video alone or required an external camera that observes the target person. We introduce generative visual perspective taking: Given an ego person's egocentric video, a scene point cloud, and a collaborator's camera trajectory, the task is to generate the continuous egocentric video from the collaborator's perspective. This task is challenging given extreme viewpoint shifts, dynamic occlusions, and sparse visual overlap. We address these challenges with Ego2Ego -- a set of backbone-agnostic geometric modules that provide a pretrained video diffusion model with the 3D scene geometry shared by both interactants. Ego2Ego renders dense, temporally consistent scene coordinate maps into every view as a shared spatial reference, aligns cross-view tokens in 3D ray space through relative geometric attention, and recovers regions outside the ego person's current view from the ego person's visual memory. Experiments on the CoMind dataset across three video diffusion backbones show that Ego2Ego consistently improves visual quality, Level-2 scene layout accuracy, and collaborator motion, outperforming state-of-the-art cross-view video generation baselines on every backbone. By generating the collaborator's egocentric video more accurately, Ego2Ego brings visual perspective taking to human-robot collaboration, where it can help infer what a human collaborator sees and does, and can turn single-person recordings into synchronised multi-perspective videos for robot learning.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉视角采择，即从他人的位置推断其看到什么的能力，是人类协作的基础。然而，先前工作将视角采择简化为状态估计、几何重建或离散问答，而现有的跨视角视频生成方法要么仅从输入视频推断目标视角，要么需要外部相机观察目标人物。我们引入生成式视觉视角采择：给定自我人物的自我中心视频、场景点云和协作者的相机轨迹，任务是生成来自协作者视角的连续自我中心视频。由于极端的视点偏移、动态遮挡和稀疏的视觉重叠，该任务具有挑战性。我们通过 Ego2Ego 应对这些挑战——Ego2Ego 是一组与骨干无关的几何模块，为预训练视频扩散模型提供两个交互者共享的 3D 场景几何。Ego2Ego 将稠密、时间一致的场景坐标图渲染到每个视角中，作为共享空间参考；通过相对几何注意力在 3D 射线空间中对齐跨视角 token；并从自我人物的视觉记忆中恢复自我人物当前视角之外的区域。在 CoMind 数据集上跨三个视频扩散骨干的实验表明，Ego2Ego 一致地改善视觉质量、Level-2 场景布局准确率和协作者运动，并在每个骨干上优于最先进的跨视角视频生成基线。通过更准确地生成协作者的自我中心视频，Ego2Ego 将视觉视角采择带入人-机器人协作，在其中它可以帮助推断人类协作者看到什么和做什么，并可将单人录制转换为用于机器人学习的同步多视角视频。

items.title_en: Interspecies differences in lamina cribrosa fiber composition and architecture might arise from differences in optic nerve head size and mechanical constraints
items.title_zh: 筛板纤维组成与结构的种间差异可能源于视神经乳头尺寸与机械约束的差异
items.abstract_en: The lamina cribrosa (LC) is a complex network of fibers that plays an important mechanical role in protecting optic nerve axons as they exit the eye. Both the architecture and composition of the LC network varies throughout animal species. However, the function of these differences between species is unknown. We hypothesize that this variety in LC architecture and composition is a result of species-specific adaptations to the mechanical constraints present in each species' optic nerve head. To test this hypothesis, we developed a novel optimization framework to systematically derive optimal LC fiber architecture and composition under different mechanical constraints. We then compared predicted LC architectures to instant polarized light microscopy images of actual human, tree shrew, monkey, cow, pig, and rat LCs. Distinct features from the various LCs were replicated by varying the mechanical constraints, consistent with our hypothesis. The wheel-and-spoke architecture of the tree shrew LC was captured with angularly symmetric loading conditions. Non-radial fibers like those found in monkey and human LCs were captured by adding horizontal eye rotation tractions. The softer glial LC of the rat and stiffer collagenous LC of larger species were replicated by a two-material extension of the model. To our knowledge, these are the first results that systematically show how interspecies differences in LC architecture and composition can arise from mechanical constraints and size. This work can result in better interpretation of animal models and provide a point of comparison for changes in LC architecture under pathological conditions such as glaucoma.
items.abstract_zh: 筛板（LC）是由纤维构成的复杂网络，在视神经轴突离开眼球时为其提供重要的机械保护。不同动物物种的 LC 网络结构与成分各异，但这些种间差异的功能意义尚不清楚。我们假设这种多样性源于各物种视神经乳头的机械约束所导致的适应性。为检验该假设，我们建立了一个新的优化框架，系统推导不同机械约束下最优的 LC 纤维结构与成分，并将预测结构与人类、树鼩、猴、牛、猪和大鼠真实 LC 的瞬时偏振光显微镜图像进行比较。通过改变机械约束可复现各类 LC 的显著特征，与假设一致：角度对称的加载条件再现了树鼩的轮辐状结构；加入水平眼球旋转牵引再现了猴与人 LC 中的非径向纤维；模型的双材料扩展则再现了大鼠较软的胶质 LC 与大型物种较硬的胶原 LC。据我们所知，这是首批系统表明 LC 结构与成分的种间差异可由机械约束与尺寸产生的结果。该工作有助于更好地解读动物模型，并为青光眼等病理条件下 LC 结构变化提供对照。
items.highlight_zh: 筛板结构的种间差异可由视神经乳头尺寸与机械约束解释
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】筛板是眼球后部一层纤维编织成的网，视神经轴突从这里穿出眼球，它像一张承重的筛子，替神经纤维分担眼内压力。有趣的是，不同动物的筛板在纤维走向和材料成分上差别很大：树鼩是轮辐状，猴和人带非径向纤维，大鼠偏软而牛猪等大型动物更硬更富胶原。这些差别有什么功能意义，此前没有答案。

【用了什么方法】作者提出一个假设：这些差异是各物种为适应自己视神经乳头处的力学条件而“优化”出来的。为此他们建立了一个新的优化框架，输入不同的机械约束（如加载方向、眼球旋转带来的牵引、材料软硬），让算法自行求解最优的纤维排列与成分，再把预测结构与六种物种真实筛板的瞬时偏振光显微镜图像逐一比对。

【有什么结果】改变约束就能“长出”不同物种的特征：角度对称的加载复现出树鼩的轮辐状结构；额外加入水平眼球旋转的牵引，就出现猴和人那样的非径向纤维；把模型扩展为两种材料，则分别再现大鼠的软胶质筛板和大型动物的硬胶原筛板。

【为何重要】这是首次系统说明：筛板的种间差异不必诉诸各自独立的生物学机制，仅凭力学约束与眼球尺寸的差异就能自然解释。这对科研有实际价值——用动物模型研究青光眼时，需要知道该动物的筛板力学环境与人有何不同，才能正确外推结论；同时，该框架也为判断病理状态下筛板结构如何异常改变提供了正常对照。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: MatVerse: A Foundation Model for Materials Science
items.title_zh: MatVerse：材料科学的基础模型
items.abstract_en: Materials science involves highly heterogeneous scientific information, including textual knowledge, molecular and crystal structures, experimental characterization data, microscopy images, and structure-property relationships. Developing a general-purpose foundation model capable of understanding and reasoning over these diverse materials representations remains challenging. In this technical report, we introduce MatVerse, a materials foundation model built upon Intern-S2-Preview and further specialized through large-scale materials-domain post-training. We construct a large-scale multimodal training corpus covering materials knowledge, scientific reasoning, quantitative problem solving, structural understanding, and multimodal scientific interpretation. To improve domain adaptation, we develop a unified data construction pipeline combining teacher-guided reasoning distillation, scientific problem synthesis, consistency-based filtering, and retrieval-based multimodal data construction. We evaluate MatVerse on three representative materials-science benchmarks: our human-calibrated OmniMatBench, MatSciBench, and MaCBench. Results demonstrate consistent improvements after materials-specific post-training over the base model on all three benchmarks, alongside improved inference efficiency on calculation-intensive problems. These results show that targeted domain-specific post-training can effectively enhance scientific reasoning, materials knowledge understanding, and multimodal scientific capabilities of foundation models. MatVerse provides a unified language-and-vision interface for materials science and serves as a foundation for future AI-assisted materials research workflows.
items.abstract_zh: 材料科学涉及高度异质的科学信息，包括文本知识、分子与晶体结构、实验表征数据、显微图像以及结构-性质关系。开发能够理解和推理这些多样材料表示的通用基础模型仍然具有挑战性。在本技术报告中，我们介绍MatVerse，一个基于Intern-S2-Preview构建并通过大规模材料领域后训练进一步专门化的材料基础模型。我们构建了一个大规模多模态训练语料库，涵盖材料知识、科学推理、定量问题求解、结构理解和多模态科学解释。为改进领域适应，我们开发了一个统一的数据构建流程，结合教师引导的推理蒸馏、科学问题合成、基于一致性的过滤和基于检索的多模态数据构建。我们在三个代表性材料科学基准上评估MatVerse：我们经人工校准的OmniMatBench、MatSciBench和MaCBench。结果证明，材料特定后训练后在所有三个基准上均较基础模型取得一致改进，同时在计算密集型问题上提高了推理效率。这些结果表明，有针对性的领域特定后训练可以有效增强基础模型的科学推理、材料知识理解和多模态科学能力。MatVerse为材料科学提供了统一的语言与视觉接口，并为未来AI辅助材料研究工作流奠定基础。

items.title_en: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
items.title_zh: Model Carving：训练能优化自身拓扑的 Transformer
items.abstract_en: Machine learning has largely kept separate the choice of architecture and the process of training. A classic Transformer, for instance, trains a fixed set of attention and MLP sublayers at every layer, in the same order, and optimizes the weights within. This uniformity is a convention rather than a principled design choice, and it is likely suboptimal: the best architecture for a given task may be smaller, more efficient, and far from uniform. We believe that, ideally, training itself should shape the model's topology. To this end, we introduce Model Carving, which learns both a Transformer's weights and its architecture in a single run. By applying learnable, scalar gates to each sublayer, we allow the training loss to remove the model's own components during training -- freeing a smaller heterogeneous network inside. We evaluate Model Carving by pre-training standard Transformers from 140M to 2.7B parameters and looped Transformers from 140M to 1.3B. At equal training compute, carved models reach a lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute. Furthermore, carved models also outperform size-matched models produced by pruning or distillation, suggesting that the best way to obtain small models for edge devices is to carve them during training, not to compress a large one afterwards. This advantage both grows with scale and carries over to downstream tasks such as few-shot evaluation and generation. Because the removed sublayers no longer run, carved models also cost up to 34% fewer FLOPs per token and decode up to 1.6 times faster without cost in quality. Our results show that architecture, like weights, should be learned and not fixed in advance, and that inside every large transformer is a smaller, faster, stronger one waiting to be carved out.
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习在很大程度上将架构选择与训练过程分开。例如，经典 Transformer 在每一层以相同顺序训练一组固定的注意力和 MLP 子层，并优化其中的权重。这种统一性是一种惯例，而非有原则的设计选择，并且很可能次优：给定任务的最佳架构可能更小、更高效，且远非统一。我们认为，理想情况下，训练本身应当塑造模型的拓扑。为此，我们引入 Model Carving，它在一次运行中同时学习 Transformer 的权重和架构。通过对每个子层施加可学习的标量门控，我们允许训练损失在训练期间移除模型自身的组件——从而释放出内部更小的异构网络。我们通过预训练 140M 到 2.7B 参数的标准 Transformer 和 140M 到 1.3B 参数的循环 Transformer 来评估 Model Carving。在相同训练计算量下，雕刻后的模型达到的验证损失低于用最多 1.7 倍计算量训练的稠密模型。此外，雕刻后的模型也优于通过剪枝或蒸馏产生的同尺寸模型，这表明为边缘设备获得小模型的最佳方式是在训练期间雕刻它们，而不是之后压缩一个大模型。这种优势既随规模增长，也会延续到少样本评估和生成等下游任务。由于被移除的子层不再运行，雕刻后的模型每 token 的 FLOPs 最多减少 34%，解码速度最多快 1.6 倍，且不损失质量。我们的结果表明，架构和权重一样应当被学习，而不是预先固定；并且在每个大型 Transformer 内部，都有一个更小、更快、更强的模型等待被雕刻出来。

items.title_en: Structurally Different, Functionally Persistent: Capability Regions Under Model Optimization
items.title_zh: 结构不同，功能持续：模型优化下的能力区域
items.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) capabilities have been associated with localized parameter regions, enabling targeted model editing and intervention. However, it remains unclear whether a region identified before model optimization remains an effective intervention target afterward. We evaluate the functional persistence and parameter overlap of coding capability regions across three instruction-tuned models under quantization, pruning, and LoRA-based adaptation. Although re-extracted regions exhibit substantial parameter reorganization, ablating the original region after optimization eliminates or nearly eliminates coding performance in almost all conditions, while magnitude-matched controls preserve performance. Partition analysis further shows that the shared subset of the original and re-extracted regions accounts for most of the observed ablation effect in the majority of conditions. These results demonstrate that parameter overlap and functional persistence are distinct: capability regions can remain causally effective intervention targets even when their parameter realization changes substantially.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的能力被认为与局部参数区域相关，这支持有针对性的模型编辑与干预。然而，模型优化前识别出的区域在优化后是否仍是有效的干预目标仍不清楚。我们评估了三个指令微调模型在量化、剪枝和基于LoRA的适配下，编码能力区域的功能持续性与参数重叠。尽管重新提取的区域表现出显著的参数重组，但在几乎所有条件下，优化后消融原始区域会消除或几乎消除编码性能，而幅度匹配的对照仍保持性能。分区分析进一步表明，在大多数条件下，原始区域与重新提取区域的共享子集解释了观察到的大部分消融效应。这些结果表明，参数重叠与功能持续性是不同的：即使能力区域的参数实现发生显著变化，它们仍可作为因果有效的干预目标。

items.title_en: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: Embodied-Harness：迈向机器人操作中的递归自我改进
items.abstract_en: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体为机器人操作提供了一种有前景的方法，但仍受限于记忆组织不足、失败归因不确定以及执行经验复用有限。我们提出Embodied-Harness，一种双智能体框架，通过细化执行框架而不更新模型参数来改进操作。Actor通过机器人控制接口与环境交互，而Reflector将执行证据转化为可复用的操作指导。分层记忆架构维护短期执行上下文和长期经验知识，以支持执行与反思。基于证据的经验反思将失败诊断建立在观察到的交互上，而递归框架自我改进在多次尝试中细化操作指导。在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA和RMBench上的实验证明了Embodied-Harness在环境变化下的泛化、空间推理、长时程规划和依赖记忆的操作中的有效性。我们的方法在三个基准上分别达到82.4%、76.7%和94.4%的成功率。真实世界评估进一步在三个操作任务上取得平均96.7%的成功率。这些结果凸显了Embodied-Harness通过经验驱动的框架自我改进来提升机器人操作的潜力。

items.title_en: EgoSurgHands: An Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Dataset & Benchmark for Open Surgery Training
items.title_zh: EgoSurgHands：用于开放手术训练的自中心3D手部姿态数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration all benefit from 3D tracking of the surgeon's hands, yet no surgical dataset offers real egocentric articulated 3D hand pose. We introduce EgoSurgHands, a benchmark for real-captured egocentric hand pose estimation in open surgery training on synthetic pads. Captured with multi-sensor glasses, it contains 41,909 training hand-instance rows across 55 procedure recordings and 9,476 human-validated evaluation rows across 13 held-out recordings, spanning 13 tasks, 3 glove colors, and 4 trainees from first-year medical student to third-year resident. Each frame carries a multi-sensor stack: intrinsics, hand landmarks with per-hand confidence, timestamps, and eye gaze, plus SLAM extrinsics where SLAM succeeded. Evaluation labels combine sensor-fused pseudo-ground truth, human cross-review of every frame, surgeon adjudication of flagged cases, and an independent multi-view triangulated reference. Alongside the within-corpus, procedure-disjoint split, a leave-one-wearer-out protocol tested unseen trainees. Across eight methods evaluated zero-shot, from MANO-based reconstructors to the two-hand IntagHand and the keypoint-only MediaPipe Hands, egocentric pretraining was associated with stronger transfer on every held-out wearer. WildHands and JointTransformer had 18\% and 40\% lower PA-MPJPE, respectively, than the non-egocentric HaMeR. JointTransformer was the best performing model with an error of 14.95 mm. A substantial surgical domain gap remains, and the widely deployed MediaPipe Hands detected a hand in only 24.1\% of evaluation rows. As a baseline, a 58K-parameter residual corrector (JRN) on frozen backbones reached 10.96-14.85 mm PA-MPJPE on held-out wearers for the two ego-pretrained backbones. We release the dataset and benchmark code at https://egosurghands.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 手术技能评估、AR引导以及从演示中学习机器人都受益于对术者手部的3D跟踪，然而尚无手术数据集提供真实的、自中心的关节式3D手部姿态。我们推出EgoSurgHands，一个用于在合成垫上进行开放手术训练时真实采集的自中心手部姿态估计基准。该数据集使用多传感器眼镜采集，包含55段手术过程记录中的41,909条训练手部实例行，以及13段留出记录中的9,476条经人工验证的评估行，涵盖13个任务、3种手套颜色和4名受训者（从一年级医学生到三年级住院医师）。每一帧都带有多传感器栈：内参、带每只手置信度的手部关键点、时间戳和眼动注视，以及SLAM成功时的SLAM外参。评估标签结合了传感器融合的伪真值、对每一帧的人工交叉复核、外科医生对标记病例的裁定，以及独立的多视图三角化参考。除了语料内、过程不相交的划分外，还采用留一佩戴者协议测试未见过的受训者。在零样本评估的八种方法中，从基于MANO的重建器到双手的IntagHand和仅关键点的MediaPipe Hands，自中心预训练在每个留出佩戴者上都与更强的迁移相关。WildHands和JointTransformer的PA-MPJPE分别比非自中心的HaMeR低18%和40%。JointTransformer是表现最好的模型，误差为14.95 mm。仍然存在显著的手术领域差距，广泛部署的MediaPipe Hands仅在24.1%的评估行中检测到手。作为基线，在冻结主干上的58K参数残差校正器（JRN）在两个自中心预训练主干上对留出佩戴者达到10.96–14.85 mm的PA-MPJPE。我们在https://egosurghands.github.io发布数据集和基准代码。

items.title_en: MicroBioAgent: an AI agent for automated microbiome analysis
items.title_zh: MicroBioAgent：用于自动化微生物组分析的AI智能体
items.abstract_en: Microbiome data analysis demands customized workflows tailored to specific biological questions, sequencing modalities, and data properties. However, constructing and executing these workflows requires navigating heterogeneous software dependencies, reference databases, and multi-step parameter tuning. Here, we present MicroBioAgent, an autonomous, domain-specific agent framework that translates high-level biological queries into executable, study-specific pipelines across 16S rRNA amplicon, reference-based shotgun, and de novo assembly-based metagenomics. Rather than relying on static pipeline templates, MicroBioAgent employs a closed-loop execution architecture: it dynamically selects and runs bioinformatics tools within user-controlled environments while iteratively inspecting intermediate outputs to adapt downstream analytical decisions. Furthermore, to address the long-running nature of metagenomic computation, we introduce an asynchronous background task-management mechanism that reduces LLM token consumption by over 50% while enabling real-time plan adjustment and automated workflow resumption. We systematically evaluated MicroBioAgent across three benchmarks of increasing complexity: (1) paired amplicon and shotgun profiling of tomato rhizosphere microbiomes, (2) taxonomic and functional profiling coupled with machine-learning classification in a colorectal cancer cohort, and (3) de novo metagenomic assembly, metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) binning, and metabolic pathway reconstruction in a polyethylene degradation study. Across all benchmarks, MicroBioAgent faithfully recapitulated the primary biological findings of the original studies, exhibiting high analytical concordance despite expected tool- and database-dependent variations. In systematic robustness evaluations across 27 independent runs spanning three backbone large language models and three prompt-complexity tiers, MicroBioAgent achieved a 98.8% task completion rate and yielded highly reproducible diversity and differential-abundance estimates. MicroBioAgent establishes a scalable, adaptive paradigm for end-to-end computational microbiome research.
items.abstract_zh: 微生物组数据分析需要针对特定生物学问题、测序模态和数据特性定制的工作流程。然而，构建和执行这些工作流程需要处理异构的软件依赖、参考数据库和多步参数调优。在此，我们提出MicroBioAgent，一个自主的、领域特定的智能体框架，可将高层次生物学查询转化为可执行的、研究特定的流程，涵盖16S rRNA扩增子、基于参考的鸟枪法以及基于从头组装的宏基因组学。MicroBioAgent不依赖静态流程模板，而是采用闭环执行架构：它在用户控制的环境中动态选择和运行生物信息学工具，同时迭代检查中间输出，以调整下游分析决策。此外，针对宏基因组计算运行时间长的特点，我们引入了一种异步后台任务管理机制，将LLM token消耗降低50%以上，同时支持实时计划调整和自动化工作流恢复。我们在三个复杂度递增的基准上系统评估了MicroBioAgent：（1）番茄根际微生物组的配对扩增子与鸟枪法分析；（2）结直肠癌队列中的分类学与功能分析，并结合机器学习分类；（3）聚乙烯降解研究中的从头宏基因组组装、宏基因组组装基因组（MAG）分箱和代谢通路重建。在所有基准中，MicroBioAgent忠实再现了原始研究的主要生物学发现，尽管存在预期的工具和数据库相关差异，仍表现出高分析一致性。在涵盖三个骨干大语言模型和三个提示复杂度层级的27次独立运行的系统稳健性评估中，MicroBioAgent达到了98.8%的任务完成率，并产生了高度可重复的多样性和差异丰度估计。MicroBioAgent为端到端计算微生物组研究建立了一种可扩展的自适应范式。

items.title_en: Multi-Illumination Spectral Reflectance Reconstruction: A method for hyperspectral imaging using digital photography
items.title_zh: 多光照光谱反射率重建：一种使用数字摄影进行高光谱成像的方法
items.abstract_en: Quantitative measurement of complex coloration patterns is essential for many biological studies and practical applications. Although color perception depends on the observer's visual system, an objective characterization is possible by measuring the spectral reflectance across the sample surface. Traditional methods for measuring spectral reflectance are either limited in spatial resolution, as with spectrometer probes, or limited in spectral detail, as with digital cameras. We present a method for reconstructing spatially resolved spectral reflectance of samples from multiple images taken under different illuminants with known spectral irradiance. Using an optimization scheme that minimizes pixel-value error while regularizing for the smoothness of the reflectance spectrum, our method generates high-resolution hyperspectral images. We tested our method using both existing spectral reflectance datasets and original multi-illumination images taken in a custom photo-box, demonstrating high accuracy and simple implementation of the method, as well as the ability to infer how samples are perceived by different visual systems. Our method can be a useful tool for objective quantification of complex visual patterns in color-related biological research and imaging applications.
items.abstract_zh: 对复杂着色模式进行定量测量，对许多生物学研究和实际应用至关重要。尽管颜色感知取决于观察者的视觉系统，但通过测量样本表面的光谱反射率可以实现客观表征。传统的光谱反射率测量方法要么空间分辨率有限（如光谱仪探头），要么光谱细节有限（如数码相机）。我们提出一种方法，从在已知光谱辐照度的不同光源下拍摄的多幅图像中重建样本的空间分辨光谱反射率。该方法采用一种优化方案，在最小化像素值误差的同时对反射率光谱的平滑性进行正则化，从而生成高分辨率高光谱图像。我们使用现有光谱反射率数据集以及在定制摄影箱中拍摄的原始多光照图像测试了该方法，证明了其高准确性和实现的简便性，以及推断样本如何被不同视觉系统感知的能力。我们的方法可成为在颜色相关生物学研究和成像应用中对复杂视觉模式进行客观量化的有用工具。

items.title_en: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
items.title_zh: 双层情感框架：网络搜索中可扩展的多模态UX归因
items.abstract_en: Sustaining user experience (UX) quality in large-scale web search requires scalable evaluation. Traditional surveys are slow and bottleneck rapid A/B testing, while automated metrics often lack the granularity to diagnose visual-spatial UX anomalies. To address this, we introduce the Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework, a novel industrial architecture for automated UX attribution. Tier 1 (Macro System) acts as a scalable user sentiment regression detector, utilizing a fine-tuned encoder-decoder LLM (based on Gemini XS) on telemetry features. Through multi-task regularization and contextual feature engineering, this tier achieves a +9.8% PR-AUC gain on over 500,000 held-out records, matching baseline recall on all validated regressions with $\sim$20% relative precision gain among the 12 held-out experiments. In production, it reduces measurement latency from weeks to hours and cuts survey overhead by over 40%. Tier 2 (Micro System) provides granular diagnostics by employing a Multimodal LLM (Gemini 3.0 Pro) to natively assess visual renderings and spatial layout of web result blocks, quantifying "User Toil" as the estimated effort required to reach a satisfactory result. Enhanced by RL-based automated prompt optimization and an AI judge for win/loss patterns, the MLLM yields a $>$6.5% F1 score improvement, offering deep insights into content quality and layout friction. Ultimately, this framework enables scalable, accurate, and diagnostic UX attribution, processing O(100k) live experiment queries daily.
items.abstract_zh: 在大规模网络搜索中维持用户体验（UX）质量需要可扩展的评估。传统调查速度慢，会瓶颈快速A/B测试，而自动化指标通常缺乏诊断视觉空间UX异常的粒度。为此，我们引入双层情感框架（Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework），一种用于自动化UX归因的新颖工业架构。第一层（宏观系统）作为可扩展的用户情感回归检测器，在遥测特征上使用微调的编码器-解码器LLM（基于Gemini XS）。通过多任务正则化和上下文特征工程，该层在超过500,000条留出记录上取得+9.8%的PR-AUC提升，在全部验证回归上匹配基线召回率，并在12个留出实验中实现约20%的相对精确率提升。在生产中，它将测量延迟从数周降至数小时，并将调查开销降低40%以上。第二层（微观系统）通过采用多模态LLM（Gemini 3.0 Pro）原生评估网页结果块的视觉渲染和空间布局来提供细粒度诊断，将“用户辛劳”（User Toil）量化为达到满意结果所需的估计工作量。借助基于RL的自动化提示优化和用于胜/负模式的AI评判器，MLLM取得>6.5%的F1分数提升，提供对内容质量和布局摩擦的深入洞察。最终，该框架实现可扩展、准确且具诊断性的UX归因，每天处理O(100k)实时实验查询。

items.title_en: Breaking the Long Horizon: Short-Horizon Process Supervision for Long-Form Generation in LLMs
items.title_zh: 打破长时程：面向LLM长篇生成的短时程过程监督
items.abstract_en: Long-form generation is increasingly important for agentic LLM systems, yet current reinforcement learning methods typically optimize an entire document with a single outcome-level reward. This delayed and coarse-grained supervision makes it difficult to localize errors and assign credit across semantically distinct parts of the output. To address this, we propose a short-horizon framework that reformulates long-form generation through semantic decomposition into segment-level decisions. Each segment is generated with prefix-conditioned context, allowing cross-segment coherence to be preserved while keeping supervision local. The generated segments are then scored with rubric-based rewards for adherence, coherence, and relevance, enabling explicit local supervision at the segment level. These local rewards are used to compute step-wise advantages, yielding localized policy updates. To isolate the effect of supervision granularity, we instantiate both outcome-level supervision and our short-horizon process reward method (SH-PRM) under the same GRPO framework. Across multiple LLMs and two long-form generation benchmarks, SH-PRM consistently outperforms outcome-level supervision and strong inference-time baselines under the same optimizer and comparable budgets. Further analyses suggest that these gains primarily arise from improved credit assignment. Overall, our results suggest that aligning supervision granularity with the semantic structure of long-form generation is an effective design principle for long-form LLM training.
items.abstract_zh: 长篇生成对于智能体LLM系统日益重要，然而当前的强化学习方法通常用单一结果级奖励优化整个文档。这种延迟且粗粒度的监督难以定位错误并在输出中语义不同的部分之间分配信用。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种短时程框架，通过语义分解将长篇生成重构为片段级决策。每个片段在目标片段前缀条件的上下文中生成，从而在保持跨片段连贯性的同时使监督保持局部。生成的片段随后使用基于评分准则的奖励对遵循性、连贯性和相关性进行打分，从而在片段级实现显式局部监督。这些局部奖励用于计算逐步优势，产生局部化的策略更新。为分离监督粒度的影响，我们在相同的GRPO框架下实例化结果级监督和我们的短时程过程奖励方法（SH-PRM）。在多个LLM和两个长篇生成基准上，SH-PRM在相同优化器和可比预算下始终优于结果级监督和强推理时基线。进一步分析表明，这些增益主要来自改进的信用分配。总体而言，我们的结果表明，将监督粒度与长篇生成的语义结构对齐是长篇LLM训练的有效设计原则。

items.title_en: RoboCap-10k: A Metrically Accurate Egocentric Dataset for Robot Learning
items.title_zh: RoboCap-10k：用于机器人学习的度量精确自中心数据集
items.abstract_en: Egocentric video is the most scalable source of manipulation data for robot learning, but its difficulty lies in producing high-quality supervision. Existing large corpora lack metric 3D labels or rely on heterogeneous devices, motion-capture labs, or a headset's built-in real-time tracker, whose accuracy is not reported for the released data. We introduce RoboCap-10k: 10,000 curated hours of unscripted manipulation recorded during workers' paid shifts in 11 countries, spanning 18 task families, 200 task types, and 2,000 tasks. Every hour is captured on one device, the RoboCap, a 250 g hat with six synchronized global-shutter cameras and dual IMUs. Online calibration brings every device below 1 px of epipolar error, visual-inertial SLAM yields gravity-aligned 6-DoF head trajectories, and a multi-view hand tracker yields metric cm-precise hand poses. Each episode is annotated with task and sub-task language captions. Project page: https://robocap10k.com
items.abstract_zh: 自中心视频是机器人学习中最可扩展的操作数据来源，但其难点在于产生高质量监督。现有大型语料缺乏度量3D标签，或依赖异构设备、动作捕捉实验室，或头戴设备内置的实时跟踪器，而这些跟踪器的精度未针对发布数据报告。我们推出RoboCap-10k：10,000个精选小时的无脚本操作数据，录制于11个国家工人在带薪班次期间，涵盖18个任务族、200种任务类型和2,000个任务。每一小时都由同一设备RoboCap采集，这是一种250克帽子，配有六个同步全局快门相机和双IMU。在线校准使每台设备低于1像素的对极误差，视觉惯性SLAM产生重力对齐的6自由度头部轨迹，多视图手部跟踪器产生度量级厘米精确的手部姿态。每个片段都用任务和子任务语言描述标注。项目页面：https://robocap10k.com

items.title_en: 3D Open-Vocabulary Detection via Visual Alignment and Generative Captions
items.title_zh: 通过视觉对齐与生成式描述进行3D开放词汇检测
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection remains a significant challenge for outdoor scenes, with existing methods often struggling to effectively transfer the rich semantic knowledge from powerful 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into a 3D context. We propose a novel, two-part framework for this task. First, we introduce a direct, object-level distillation method. We generate class-agnostic 3D proposals to source regions from the entire scene, without relying on any manual labels. We leverage a spatially-aware VLM to extract a semantic embedding from each proposal's projected 2D bounding box and supervise our 3D model to predict this embedding on a per-instance basis. Second, to enhance zero-shot capability and inject domain-specific information, we employ a powerful Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as an image captioner to generate rich textual captions for each of these proposals. These captions are integrated into the training objective to directly align the 3D features with these rich semantics, creating a composite loss that combines direct feature distillation with caption-based semantic enrichment. Our experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, establishing a new state of the art in 3D open-vocabulary detection on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇3D目标检测对于室外场景仍是一项重大挑战，现有方法往往难以有效地将强大的2D视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的丰富语义知识迁移到3D情境中。我们为该任务提出了一种新颖的两部分框架。首先，我们引入一种直接的对象级蒸馏方法。我们生成类别无关的3D候选框，以从整个场景中获取区域，而不依赖任何人工标签。我们利用空间感知的VLM从每个候选框投影后的2D边界框中提取语义嵌入，并监督我们的3D模型逐实例预测该嵌入。其次，为增强零样本能力并注入领域特定信息，我们采用强大的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为图像描述生成器，为这些候选框中的每一个生成丰富的文本描述。这些描述被整合到训练目标中，以直接将3D特征与这些丰富语义对齐，形成一种复合损失，将直接特征蒸馏与基于描述的语义增强相结合。我们的实验验证了该方法的有效性，在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上确立了3D开放词汇检测的新最先进水平。

items.title_en: One-Step Self-Assembling Lipopolymer Coatings Enable Direct Longitudinal Biosensing in Native Biological Matrices
items.title_zh: 一步自组装脂质聚合物涂层实现天然生物基质中的直接纵向生物传感
items.abstract_en: Sample-driven cross-reactivity remains a fundamental bottleneck for sensitive and selective biosensing in complex biological environments, particularly in microfluidic systems where high surface-to-volumes ratios amplify non-specific interactions. Here, we address this challenge with a one-step, biomimetic surface functionalization strategy based on engineered lipid-based nanocarriers that self-assemble within minutes into immunoassay-ready, antifouling interfaces that couple pegylated-lipid passivation with biorthogonal, site-specific probe conjugation. This approach enables rapid, tuneable, and reproducible surface functionalization, which suppresses sample-specific cross-reactivity even in undiluted serum, and supports direct, label-free digital biosensing assays directly in native biological environments. When integrated into an optofluidic platform combining digital in-line holography and microfluidics, this approach allows time-resolved quantification of tetraspanin-positive extracellular vesicle secretion dynamics from two-dimensional and three-dimensional lung cancer cell models using 50 μL of sample within 10 min, without isolation or purification. Because the presented surface functionalization proceeds via self-assembly rather than covalent surface modification, this one-step modular-approach is intrinsically decoupled from device fabrication and applies to both glass and PDMS, coating the entire microfluidic channel, thereby establishing a general route for integrating biomimetic nanostructures into robust, high-performance immunoassays, advancing biosensing beyond end-point measurements, and towards rapid and continuous real-time monitoring.
items.abstract_zh: 样本驱动的交叉反应性仍然是复杂生物环境中灵敏且选择性生物传感的基本瓶颈，尤其是在高表面积体积比会放大非特异性相互作用的微流控系统中。在此，我们通过一种基于工程化脂质纳米载体的一步仿生表面功能化策略来应对这一挑战，这些载体在数分钟内自组装成可用于免疫测定的防污界面，将聚乙二醇化脂质钝化与生物正交、位点特异性探针偶联相结合。该方法能够实现快速、可调且可重复的表面功能化，即使在未稀释血清中也能抑制样本特异性交叉反应性，并支持直接、无标记的数字生物传感测定在天然生物环境中进行。当集成到结合数字同轴全息与微流控的光流控平台中时，该方法可使用50 μL样本在10分钟内，对二维和三维肺癌细胞模型的四跨膜蛋白阳性细胞外囊泡分泌动力学进行时间分辨定量，且无需分离或纯化。由于所提出的表面功能化通过自组装而非共价表面修饰进行，这种一步模块化方法本质上与器件制造解耦，并适用于玻璃和PDMS，涂覆整个微流控通道，从而为将仿生纳米结构集成到稳健、高性能免疫测定中建立了一条通用途径，推动生物传感超越终点测量，迈向快速连续实时监测。

items.title_en: A fast and accurate model for gradient-based inverse design of multimode waveguides
items.title_zh: 一种用于多模波导基于梯度逆向设计的快速准确模型
items.abstract_en: Multimode photonic inverse design requires fast, accurate computational models that provide geometry gradients. Based on coupled-mode theory (CMT), we propose a differentiable surrogate model. Its parameter-extraction method uses a change of modal basis to obtain coupled-mode parameters from cross-sectional mode data. We also provide a complete, easy-to-implement propagation and optimization workflow. Using finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulation data as a common reference, we compare the prediction accuracy of our model and forward dataset-based eigenmode expansion (EME) for randomly generated thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) waveguide profiles that traverse modal coupling regions. Using identical modal libraries, the model reduces the maximum per-mode mean absolute transmission error by 17-37% compared with forward EME. We demonstrate a spot-size converter design that preserves the fundamental TM$_0$ mode in its hybridization region with the first-order TE$_1$ mode and obtain nine structures, each with FDTD-verified transmission above 98%. These tests demonstrate the model's utility for large-scale photonic inverse design, enabling rapid exploration of the design parameter space by combining gradient information with improved prediction accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 多模光子逆向设计需要快速、准确且能提供几何梯度的计算模型。基于耦合模理论（CMT），我们提出一种可微代理模型。其参数提取方法利用模态基变换，从横截面模式数据中获得耦合模参数。我们还提供了完整且易于实现的传播与优化工作流。以有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真数据作为共同参考，我们针对随机生成的、穿越模态耦合区域的薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）波导剖面，比较了我们的模型与基于前向数据集的本征模展开（EME）的预测精度。在相同模态库下，与正向 EME 相比，该模型将每个模式的最大平均绝对透射误差降低了 17–37%。我们展示了一种光斑尺寸转换器设计，其在与一阶 TE$_1$ 模式的杂化区域中保持基模 TM$_0$ 模式，并获得九个结构，每个结构的 FDTD 验证透射率均高于 98%。这些测试证明了该模型在大规模光子逆向设计中的实用性，通过将梯度信息与改进的预测精度相结合，能够快速探索设计参数空间。

items.title_en: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: WEIR：用于多轮智能体强化学习的分水岭探索与漂移感知前缀收缩
items.abstract_en: Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values. Prefix-tree methods improve sample efficiency by merging trajectories that share action histories, yet two structural flaws remain: naive pooling mixes stale off-policy outcomes into critic targets with fixed weights, and uniform or entropy-driven branching wastes continuations on dead-end states whose outcome is already settled. We introduce WEIR (Watershed Exploration and Intrinsic-Drift Shrinkage), an actor-critic reinforcement learning framework grounded in a Doob turn-variance conservation identity. WEIR maintains a cross-iteration canonical action-prefix tree with exponentially discounted visit counts and trains a prefix-conditioned critic toward a minimax drift-aware shrinkage target that adapts from single-trajectory returns at rare nodes to pooled empirical means at dense nodes. Using the same pre-update critic, WEIR allocates rollout budgets across tasks via Neyman stratification $B_q \propto \sqrt{\hat{p}_q(1-\hat{p}_q)}$ and directs within-task branches to watershed forks where high survival-headroom uncertainty coincides with steep value cliffs. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, ALFWorld, and WebShop on Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct, WEIR achieves $32.18\%$ and $37.85\%$ average QA exact match and $84.83\%$ and $87.81\%$ ALFWorld success rates, outperforming CAPO by $1.50$--$3.74$ points while generating $28$--$29\%$ fewer rollout tokens than chain sampling.
items.abstract_zh: 多轮语言模型智能体往往仅在长交互轨迹结束时获得单一二值奖励，这使得难以将决定性决策与常规步骤区分开，也难以估计准确的中间价值。前缀树方法通过合并共享动作历史的轨迹来提高样本效率，但仍存在两个结构缺陷：朴素池化以固定权重将过时的离策略结果混入评论家目标；均匀或熵驱动分支将续写浪费在结果已确定的死胡同状态上。我们提出WEIR（分水岭探索与内在漂移收缩），一种基于Doob轮次方差守恒恒等式的演员-评论家强化学习框架。WEIR维护一棵跨迭代规范动作前缀树，其访问计数采用指数折扣，并训练以前缀为条件的评论家，朝向一个极小极大漂移感知收缩目标，该目标从稀有节点的单轨迹回报自适应到密集节点的池化经验均值。使用相同的更新前评论家，WEIR通过Neyman分层 B_q ∝ √(p̂_q(1−p̂_q)) 在任务间分配rollout预算，并将任务内分支导向分水岭分叉，即高生存余量不确定性与陡峭价值悬崖同时出现之处。在四个多跳QA基准、ALFWorld和WebShop上，基于Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct，WEIR分别取得32.18%和37.85%的平均QA精确匹配率，以及84.83%和87.81%的ALFWorld成功率，比CAPO高1.50–3.74个百分点，同时比链式采样少生成28–29%的rollout token。

items.title_en: Your Judge Inherits Your Prompt: In-Context Label Bias in an LLM-as-Judge Is Directional, Not Symmetric
items.title_zh: 你的评判器继承了你的提示：LLM作为评判器中的上下文标签偏差是方向性的，而非对称的
items.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge has become a standard way to score open-ended model outputs, yet the judge is itself a frozen language model steered by a few in-context examples, and such models are known to absorb the label balance of their demonstrations rather than treat them as neutral illustrations. We ask whether this label bias reaches an LLM judge used inside a multimodal (video question answering) evaluation pipeline, and what form it takes. Using a fully frozen generator-judge pipeline, we hold the generated answers fixed and vary only the Yes/No balance of the judge's few-shot examples across four demonstration sets. Each verdict is validated against a two-annotator human consensus on 200 examples per dataset. The judge's acceptance rate stays close to human consensus when its examples are balanced or skewed toward rejection, but jumps sharply (by about 30 points on NExT-QA and 20 on MSVD-QA, with a strongly one-sided error profile) when the examples are skewed toward acceptance; the opposite skew produces no matching drop. The bias is therefore one-directional within the tested range of label ratios. A separate five-draw analysis shows that results from a single example draw are unreliable, varying by up to 18 points, more than any difference between prompting conditions. We conclude that demonstration label bias in an LLM judge is a directional, inflation-only failure mode that can fabricate apparent benchmark gains but not losses, and that it is cheaply avoided by balancing the judge's examples and reporting results averaged over several draws.
items.abstract_zh: LLM作为评判器已成为对开放式模型输出进行评分的标准方式，但评判器本身是一个由少量上下文示例引导的冻结语言模型，而此类模型已知会吸收其演示的标签平衡，而不是将其视为中性的示例说明。我们考察这种标签偏差是否会触及多模态（视频问答）评估流程中使用的LLM评判器，以及它呈现何种形式。使用完全冻结的生成器-评判器流程，我们保持生成答案不变，仅在四个演示集中改变评判器少样本示例的Yes/No平衡。每个判定均与每个数据集200个示例上的两名标注者人工共识进行验证。当评判器的示例平衡或偏向拒绝时，其接受率与人工共识保持接近；但当示例偏向接受时，接受率急剧上升（在NExT-QA上约30个百分点，在MSVD-QA上20个百分点，且错误分布强烈偏向一侧）；相反的偏斜不会产生相应的下降。因此，在测试的标签比例范围内，该偏差是单向的。一项单独的五次抽样分析表明，单次示例抽样的结果不可靠，变化可达18个百分点，超过任何提示条件之间的差异。我们得出结论：LLM评判器中的演示标签偏差是一种方向性的、仅膨胀的失效模式，它可以伪造出明显的基准提升，但不能伪造下降；通过平衡评判器的示例并报告多次抽样平均结果，可以低成本地避免该问题。

items.title_en: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
items.title_zh: 从序列到空间：面向主动地理定位的显式空间信念与视觉-语言蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 主动地理定位（Active geo-localization，AGL）要求智能体在一个小型空中搜索网格中导航，并到达由航空图像、地面照片或文本指定的目标。现有方法能很好地对齐目标模态，但它们将导航状态保留在一个大型序列Transformer中，并使用一种利用隐藏目标位置的稠密距离奖励进行训练。本文提出EAGLE，一种用于地理定位与探索的显式空间信念智能体（Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration）。离线训练从相同的随机掩码部分镶嵌图中联合优化一个以教师为条件的Swin分支和一个无上下文的Swin学生。教师分支关注由Qwen2.5-VL-7B提取的冻结全场景上下文，两个分支都接受掩码单元航空特征重建和不确定性监督，而学生额外蒸馏来自教师的停止梯度特征预测。蒸馏后，Qwen、其缓存上下文以及教师注意力分支被丢弃。保留的学生仅从部分观测预测单元级航空特征嵌入和预测不确定性。这些预测与模态对齐的目标嵌入以及由轨迹导出的访问掩码相结合，构建空间信念张量。随后学生被冻结，同时用PPO优化一个紧凑的CNN演员-评论家（actor-critic）。EAGLE在MASA、xBD零样本迁移和MM-GAG零样本航空目标划分上分别取得78.1%、76.4%和76.8%的最先进平均成功率，且在推理时不使用VLM或缓存的视觉token。代码将公开。

items.title_en: SCATR-ITS: a scalable transformer for large-area individual tree segmentation from LiDAR point clouds
items.title_zh: SCATR-ITS：用于从LiDAR点云进行大面积单木分割的可扩展Transformer
items.abstract_en: Individual tree segmentation (ITS) from LiDAR point clouds is one of the most widely studied segmentation tasks in forestry. Although deep learning methods define the state of the art on the majority of ITS benchmarks, their high computational complexity and long runtime currently prevent their adoption in large-scale operational workflows. In this work, we present SCATR-ITS, a scalable transformer model specifically designed for efficient ITS over large geographical areas. Based on the ForestFormer3D framework, SCATR-ITS transitions to superpoint-level processing to accelerate inference, with the superpoints constructed from learned embeddings. The architecture incorporates size-aware superpoint-level postprocessing, a dynamic query count module to handle high variation in forest structure, and a maximal input stride designed to minimize prediction redundancy. SCATR-ITS achieves accuracy on par with the state of the art on the FGI-EMIT and FOR-InstanceV2 datasets with an up to 8.5$\times$ higher inference speed. In addition, SCATR-ITS has a significantly lower GPU VRAM footprint during both training and inference, and exhibits excellent zero-shot generalization across multiple datasets. To demonstrate large-area ITS capabilities, SCATR-ITS is applied to a 142 km$^2$ region of Finnish national laser scanning data where it achieves an average throughput of 13.8 min/km$^2$, $\sim$18.6$\times$ faster than ForestFormer3D and approaching the speed of the unsupervised watershed algorithm, which it vastly outperforms in accuracy and segment quality. Overall, SCATR-ITS delivers state-of-the-art accuracy at speeds where operational-scale adoption becomes viable, paving the way toward countrywide deployment. The source code for SCATR-ITS and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its.
items.abstract_zh: 从LiDAR点云进行单木分割（ITS）是林业中研究最广泛的分割任务之一。尽管深度学习方法在大多数ITS基准上代表了最先进水平，但其高计算复杂度和长运行时间目前阻碍其在大规模业务工作流中采用。在这项工作中，我们提出SCATR-ITS，一种专门为在大地理区域内高效进行ITS而设计的可扩展Transformer模型。基于ForestFormer3D框架，SCATR-ITS转向超点级处理以加速推理，其中超点由学习到的嵌入构建。该架构结合了尺寸感知的超点级后处理、用于处理森林结构高变化的动态查询数量模块，以及设计用于最小化预测冗余的最大输入步幅。SCATR-ITS在FGI-EMIT和FOR-InstanceV2数据集上达到与最先进水平相当的精度，推理速度最高提升8.5倍。此外，SCATR-ITS在训练和推理期间的GPU显存占用显著更低，并在多个数据集上表现出优异的零样本泛化。为展示大面积ITS能力，SCATR-ITS被应用于芬兰国家激光扫描数据的142 km²区域，平均吞吐量为13.8 min/km²，比ForestFormer3D快约18.6倍，接近无监督分水岭算法的速度，并在精度和分割质量上大幅优于后者。总体而言，SCATR-ITS在使业务规模采用变得可行的速度下提供最先进精度，为全国范围部署铺平道路。SCATR-ITS的源代码和预训练权重可在https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its获取。

items.title_en: Learning effective stochastic predator and prey dynamics across physical and biological systems from limited data
items.title_zh: 从有限数据中学习跨物理与生物系统的有效随机捕食者-猎物动力学
items.abstract_en: Constructing an effective low-dimensional stochastic model from sparse observations requires separating deterministic drift from state-dependent fluctuations when the governing interaction law is unknown. We formulate an adaptive neural stochastic differential equation with topology constraints (TC-AdaNSDE) for two-variable predator--prey dynamics. To regularize the inverse problem when data are scarce, the model combines flexible drift and correlated diffusion fields with density-adaptive local Kramers--Moyal moment estimates and soft phase-space constraints reflecting boundary saddle behavior near extinction and local stability near coexistence. Using a known nonlinear stochastic system, we first show that short-time trajectory error cannot assess diffusion accuracy on its own and must be paired with distributional measures of one-step transitions and long-time phase-space occupancy. We then apply this framework to macroscopic turbulence and zonal flow energies reduced from Hasegawa--Wakatani plasma simulations and to short ecological time series. In the sparse-data regime, TC-AdaNSDE reproduces both short-horizon evolution and long-time invariant energy distributions where deterministic reductions collapse and unconstrained stochastic fits diverge, while recovering physically interpretable drift and fluctuation fields across both physical and biological systems.
items.abstract_zh: 从稀疏观测构建有效的低维随机模型，需要在支配相互作用规律未知时，将确定性漂移与状态相关涨落分离。我们针对双变量捕食者-猎物动力学，构建了具有拓扑约束的自适应神经随机微分方程（TC-AdaNSDE）。为在数据稀缺时正则化反问题，该模型将灵活的漂移场和相关扩散场与密度自适应的局部Kramers–Moyal矩估计以及软相空间约束相结合，这些约束反映灭绝附近的边界鞍行为与共存附近的局部稳定性。使用一个已知的非线性随机系统，我们首先表明短时轨迹误差不能单独评估扩散精度，必须与一步转移的分布度量和长期相空间占据测度配对。随后，我们将该框架应用于从Hasegawa–Wakatani等离子体模拟约简得到的宏观湍流与纬向流能量，以及短生态时间序列。在稀疏数据情形下，TC-AdaNSDE能够再现短时程演化和长期不变能量分布，而确定性约简会失效、无约束随机拟合会发散，同时在物理和生物系统中恢复具有物理解释性的漂移场和涨落场。

items.title_en: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
items.title_zh: 横向 MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ 异质结构中取向可调的界面热导：一项深度势分子动力学研究
items.abstract_en: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m$^2$K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m$^2$K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.
items.abstract_zh: 管理横向二维过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）异质结构界面处的热流是下一代纳米电子和光电子器件的一项关键挑战。为此，我们使用 DeePMD-kit 在密度泛函理论（DFT）数据上训练深度学习原子间势（DLP），然后将其与非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）模拟结合，研究横向 MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ 异质结构中的界面热导（ITC），并同时考虑扶手椅型和锯齿型界面取向。我们训练的势与 DFT 能量、力和声子色散关系高度吻合，这证实了其用于热输运模拟的可靠性。考察 10 至 40 nm 的晶胞长度并外推到无限长度，扶手椅型界面表现出比锯齿型界面更高的 ITC（473 MW/m$^2$K 对 387 MW/m$^2$K），并且在所考虑的每个长度下扶手椅型界面都保持更高。随着温度升高，两者均进一步增加。在 300 K 时，振动态密度显示扶手椅型界面处的声子谱重叠大于锯齿型界面。总之，这些结果为研究横向 TMD 异质结构中的热输运提供了可靠的机器学习框架，并确定界面取向是控制这些结处热耗散的有效手段。

items.title_en: Ruby: State-of-the-Art Potency Prediction across Discovery Regimes Using Learned Structural Representations
items.title_zh: Ruby：利用学习到的结构表示在跨发现阶段实现最先进的效力预测
items.abstract_en: Small-molecule drug discovery proceeds through repeated design-make-test-analyze cycles. The goal is often to maximize potency while keeping other properties within the ranges required for a viable therapeutic candidate. Compound prioritization places different demands on computational methods as drug discovery progresses from hit identification through hit-to-lead and lead optimization, with changing computational budgets and increasing amounts of on-target experimental data. We introduce Ruby, a Robust Universal Binding affinitY predictor that uses intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring an explicit binding pose for every compound. Ruby is trained on proprietary data plus GenesisPotency-2026, an audited public-source potency training dataset released for academic and commercial use under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license with row-level provenance and audit annotations. Ruby achieves the highest aggregate early enrichment across seven public hit-identification targets among evaluated methods, with adjustable inference effort trading off enrichment and computational cost over more than two orders of magnitude. Ruby achieves the highest average correlations across four public benchmarks: OpenFE, CASP16, FEP+ 4, and OpenBind. Ruby significantly outperforms other methods in zero-shot prediction across eight biochemical and cellular assays from five ongoing Genesis-Incyte programs, widening its performance advantage relative to the public benchmarks. Ruby continues to improve more than other methods when all are given the opportunity to recalibrate using earlier assay measurements. Together, these contributions provide an annotated training resource for the field and a state-of-the-art potency predictor for broad screening, prioritization within related chemical series, and assay-specific prediction as experimental measurements accumulate.
items.abstract_zh: 小分子药物发现通过重复的设计-制造-测试-分析循环推进。目标通常是最大化效力，同时使其他性质保持在可行治疗候选物所需的范围内。随着药物发现从命中识别推进到命中到先导和先导优化，化合物优先级排序对计算方法提出了不同需求，计算预算不断变化，在靶实验数据量不断增加。我们介绍 Ruby，一种稳健通用结合亲和力预测器，它使用结构基础模型 Pearl 的中间表示，而无需为每个化合物提供显式结合构象。Ruby 在专有数据加上 GenesisPotency-2026 上训练；GenesisPotency-2026 是一个经审计的公共来源效力训练数据集，以 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可证发布供学术和商业使用，具有行级来源和审计注释。在所评估方法中，Ruby 在七个公开命中识别靶标上取得最高的聚合早期富集，并具有可调推理投入，可在超过两个数量级的范围内权衡富集与计算成本。Ruby 在四个公开基准（OpenFE、CASP16、FEP+ 4 和 OpenBind）上取得最高的平均相关性。在来自五个正在进行的 Genesis-Incyte 项目的八项生化和细胞分析中，Ruby 在零样本预测上显著优于其他方法，相对于公开基准扩大了其性能优势。当所有方法都有机会使用较早的分析测量重新校准时，Ruby 的改进继续超过其他方法。总之，这些贡献为该领域提供了带注释的训练资源，以及一种最先进的效力预测器，用于广泛筛选、相关化学系列内的优先级排序，以及随着实验测量积累进行特定分析预测。

items.title_en: How Long Will My Language Model Run? A Benchmark for Pre-Execution Runtime Prediction
items.title_zh: 我的语言模型会运行多久？一个执行前运行时预测基准
items.abstract_en: Researchers submitting deep learning jobs to shared GPU clusters need runtime estimates to request time limits, choose hardware, and budget compute. Large language models (LLMs) offer a tempting shortcut: describe the job and ask. We introduce PreRun, a benchmark for predicting deep learning training and inference runtime from information available before execution. PreRun contains 801 training and 1,884 inference records of language and vision models collected on a GPU cluster, paired with workload configurations and explicitly defined timing targets. It also includes 64 text-generation configurations measured under standardized conditions, each in three separate program launches. We compare three LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Claude Opus 5.5) with regression baselines and evaluate analytical estimates on a supported forward-pass subset. On 16 held-out generation configurations, the open-weight LLMs underestimate latency by 90-99% on average without examples. Claude's zero-shot mean absolute error is 4.5 times that of a Random Forest fit on 32 configurations. Five labeled examples substantially reduce Claude's generation error, but their benefit varies across timing targets. We will open-source our data and evaluation pipeline upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 向共享 GPU 集群提交深度学习作业的研究人员需要运行时估计来申请时间限制、选择硬件并预算计算资源。大型语言模型（LLM）提供了一条诱人的捷径：描述作业并询问。我们介绍 PreRun，一个根据执行前可获得的信息预测深度学习训练和推理运行时的基准。PreRun 包含在 GPU 集群上收集的 801 条语言和视觉模型训练记录及 1,884 条推理记录，配以工作负载配置和明确定义的计时目标。它还包括 64 种文本生成配置，在标准化条件下测量，每种配置在三次独立程序启动中测量。我们将三个 LLM（Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-OSS-120B 和 Claude Opus 5.5）与回归基线进行比较，并在支持的前向传播子集上评估解析估计。在 16 个留出的生成配置上，开放权重 LLM 在没有示例时平均将延迟低估 90–99%。Claude 的零样本平均绝对误差是在 32 个配置上拟合的随机森林的 4.5 倍。五个带标签示例显著降低 Claude 的生成误差，但其收益因计时目标而异。录用后我们将开源数据和评估流程。

items.title_en: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 教VLM说什么，而非如何推理：重新思考自动驾驶中的反事实推理
items.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端自动驾驶系统已被证明会受到捷径学习和因果混淆的影响，限制了其在分布偏移下稳健泛化的能力。为缓解这些限制，近期基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的工作探索将语言推理能力纳入驾驶决策，并报告了驾驶性能的提升。特别是，反事实（CF）推理被提出以实现自我反思的高层因果理解。然而，目前尚不清楚基于语言的推理是缓解了捷径学习，还是仅将其从视觉表示转移到语言模式，从而制造出因果理解的错觉。此外，现有方法常将基于干预的推理与CF推理混为一谈，使真正CF推理的效果未被探索。在本工作中，我们考察CF推理在基于VLM的自动驾驶中实际诱导了什么，并观察到它使动作分布转向更保守的行为，同时增加推理和决策中的不确定性。该效应在强化微调下仍然存在，表明它不仅是短暂伪影。此外，视觉注意力分析表明CF推理并未改变视觉基础，而因果干预实验揭示，在事故场景中遮蔽因果相关因素和非因果因素会导致相当的决策变化率。总体而言，这些结果表明CF推理并未诱导出以视觉证据为基础的真正因果推理。相反，它充当一种语言捷径，重塑动作分布，教模型说什么而非如何推理，凸显了自动驾驶中基于语言的推理与因果理解之间的差距。

items.title_en: AnyVIO: Feed-Forward Streaming Visual-Inertial Odometry Across Platforms
items.title_zh: AnyVIO：跨平台的前馈流式视觉惯性里程计
items.abstract_en: Geometric foundation models (GFMs) estimate camera mo- tion and scene structure from images without requiring ex- pert parameter tuning, but either lack metric scale or rely on learned priors to infer scale, which is unobservable from monocular images alone. Inertial sensing offers a way to observe metric scale, but existing methods add inertial in- formation through a filter or factor graph, which reintro- duces bespoke parameter tuning and optimization costs that can grow with the trajectory. To bridge this gap, we present AnyVIO, a real-time, feed-forward streaming model for monocular visual-inertial odometry (VIO), which combines a streaming GFM with an inertial foundation model (IFM). Both the GFM and IFM predict the metric motion between consecutive frames, and a lightweight learned fusion head quantifies the reliability of each estimate and blends them in a single forward pass. Across nine datasets recorded from cars, legged and ground robots, and handheld and head- mounted devices, AnyVIO reduces the metric position error of its visual model by 36% while publishing each pose esti- mate 70 ms after an image is received. We further deploy AnyVIO onboard two real vehicles at up to 140 km/h, where it remains accurate in poor lighting and heavy dust.
items.abstract_zh: 几何基础模型（GFM）无需专家参数调优即可从图像中估计相机运动与场景结构，但要么缺乏度量尺度，要么依赖学习到的先验来推断尺度，而仅凭单目图像无法观测该尺度。惯性传感提供了一种观测度量尺度的途径，但现有方法通过滤波器或因子图引入惯性信息，这重新引入了定制化的参数调优以及可能随轨迹增长的优化开销。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 AnyVIO，一种用于单目视觉惯性里程计（VIO）的实时前馈流式模型，它将流式 GFM 与惯性基础模型（IFM）相结合。GFM 与 IFM 均预测相邻帧之间的度量运动，一个轻量级学习融合头量化每个估计的可靠性，并在单次前向传播中将二者融合。在来自汽车、足式与地面机器人、手持及头戴设备记录的九个数据集上，AnyVIO 将其视觉模型的度量位置误差降低 36%，同时在接收到图像后 70 ms 内发布每个位姿估计。我们进一步将 AnyVIO 部署在两辆真实车辆上，速度最高达 140 km/h，在弱光和浓尘环境下仍保持准确。

items.title_en: An Explainable and Scalable Hierarchical Tensor Framework for Integrating Multi-Omics and Digital Pathomics
items.title_zh: 一个可解释且可扩展的分层张量框架，用于整合多组学与数字病理组学
items.abstract_en: Background: Precision oncology requires integration of heterogeneous molecular and pathology data, yet many fusion models offer limited biologically grounded interpretability and struggle with missing modalities. Methods: We present Hierarchical Interpretable Tensor Fusion (HIT-Fuse), integrating six modalities: somatic copy number variation, DNA methylation, RNA sequencing, microRNA expression, RPPA protein abundance, and vision transformer-derived pathomics across four TCGA cohorts (glioma, lung adenocarcinoma, breast, and kidney cancer). Modality-specific autoencoders compress high-dimensional inputs, followed by two-stage CP tensor decomposition. Missing latent modalities are reconstructed using clinical covariates and observed omics to expand cohorts and retrain downstream models. A mathematical traceback mechanism enables global and local xAI attributions. Results: HIT-Fuse identifies distinct latent subgroups with significant survival stratification in glioma, breast, and kidney cohorts, both with complete and reconstructed modalities. Cohort expansion yields cohort-specific gains, including a 56.4% relative increase in weighted F1 for glioma. Biological validation against DepMap CRISPR screens, miRTarBase and RPPA annotations supports decoded drivers across all four cohorts. Essential gene rates range from 6.2% in glioma to 7.6% in lung cancer; example drivers include ANAPC11, SNRPD1, PLK1 and RPL14. Of decoded miRNAs, 71-92% have miRTarBase regulatory support, while 77-84% of selected genes are covered in DepMap. Conclusions: HIT-Fuse combines hierarchical tensor fusion, missing-modality reconstruction and traceable attributions to support interpretable multi-omics and digital pathology-based cancer prognosis across heterogeneous cohorts.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：精准肿瘤学需要整合异质的分子与病理数据，但许多融合模型提供的具生物学依据的可解释性有限，且难以处理缺失模态。方法：我们提出分层可解释张量融合（HIT-Fuse），在四个 TCGA 队列（胶质瘤、肺腺癌、乳腺癌和肾癌）中整合六种模态：体细胞拷贝数变异、DNA 甲基化、RNA 测序、microRNA 表达、RPPA 蛋白丰度以及视觉 Transformer 衍生的病理组学。模态特异性自编码器压缩高维输入，随后进行两阶段 CP 张量分解。利用临床协变量和已观测组学重建缺失的潜在模态，以扩增队列并重新训练下游模型。一种数学回溯机制可实现全局和局部 xAI 归因。结果：HIT-Fuse 在胶质瘤、乳腺癌和肾癌队列中识别出具有显著生存分层差异的不同潜在亚组，在模态完整和重建两种情况下均如此。队列扩增带来队列特异性增益，包括胶质瘤加权 F1 相对提升 56.4%。针对 DepMap CRISPR 筛选、miRTarBase 和 RPPA 注释的生物学验证支持了四个队列中解码得到的驱动因子。必需基因比例从胶质瘤的 6.2% 到肺癌的 7.6% 不等；示例驱动因子包括 ANAPC11、SNRPD1、PLK1 和 RPL14。在解码的 miRNA 中，71–92% 具有 miRTarBase 调控支持，而所选基因中有 77–84% 在 DepMap 中有覆盖。结论：HIT-Fuse 结合分层张量融合、缺失模态重建和可追溯归因，支持在异质队列中开展可解释的、基于多组学与数字病理的癌症预后分析。

items.title_en: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 超越语料驱动的模仿：通过量子强化学习在智能体管弦乐团中演化音乐思维模式
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于量子强化学习和多智能体交互的计算机辅助音乐创作与表演框架。我们引入智能体管弦乐团（agentic orchestra），其中音乐智能体通过与音乐环境的试错互动来演化出不同的思维模式（mindsets），而非通过在大规模数据集上训练。智能体被实现为参数化量子电路。它们演化出不同的作曲行为，称为思维模式。这使在混合量子-经典循环中利用量子叠加和纠缠来探索音乐决策空间成为可能。我们提出两种互补的智能体架构：原子式智能体（atomistic agents），独立处理音高和节奏；整体式智能体（holistic agents），将音高和时值作为统一的音符事件处理。思维模式通过具有音乐依据的奖励函数塑造，这些奖励函数可以组合并加权，以在不同智能体间形成不同的思维模式。由此得到的系统将量子计算智能体定位为更具适应性的音乐伙伴，而非自主作曲者，每个智能体通过交互而非模仿发展出自己的音乐个性。演示展示了智能体如何将其学到的行为泛化到此前未见过的素材，并使用MIDI编码的音乐以交互和离线批处理两种模式运行。尽管量子计算机仍处于发展阶段，在IBM量子硬件上进行的实验证实，使用现有量子计算机可实现具有音乐意义的学习。对于作曲者和演奏者而言，智能体管弦乐团为涌现式的、过程导向的音乐创造力开辟了新的可能性，随着量子计算技术的不断进步，为量子计算机辅助音乐创作提供了可扩展的基础。

items.title_en: DNN-Assisted Deterministic Policy Learning for Adaptive IRS-NOMA-OWC Networks
items.title_zh: DNN 辅助的确定性策略学习用于自适应 IRS-NOMA-OWC 网络
items.abstract_en: Intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) has been considered a promising technology in optical wireless communication (OWC) networks due to its potential to overcome the line-of-sight (LoS) blockage issue and enhance coverage. In this paper, a dynamic IRS-assisted indoor non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-OWC network is modeled, and an optimization problem is formulated to maximize the sum rate subject to the quality-of-service (QoS) requirements of multiple mobile users, by jointly optimizing the power allocation and the IRS mirror orientations, from which the user's decoding order is induced rather than being fixed. Since the problem is non-convex and the channel conditions vary with user mobility, conventional optimization methods may incur considerable computational overhead. Therefore, a two-stage deep neural network-deep reinforcement learning (DNN-DRL) framework is proposed. In the first stage, the DNN estimates the user's positions and orientations in real time, removing the need for perfect knowledge of the user state. In the second stage, a deterministic policy gradient (DPG)-based DRL algorithm uses these estimates to jointly optimize the power allocation and IRS mirror orientations, with the decoding order updated according to the resulting effective channel gains. The results show that the proposed framework approaches the performance upper bounds and outperforms standard DRL algorithms, conventional optimization methods, and deployments without IRS in terms of sum rate and fairness, while achieving faster convergence. Furthermore, online adaptation of the decoding order maintains higher QoS satisfaction than a fixed decoding order, particularly under high user mobility.
items.abstract_zh: 智能反射面（IRS）因其克服视距（LoS）阻塞问题并增强覆盖的潜力，被认为是光无线通信（OWC）网络中一项有前景的技术。本文对动态 IRS 辅助室内非正交多址接入（NOMA）-OWC 网络进行建模，并构建一个优化问题，在多个移动用户的服务质量（QoS）要求约束下，通过联合优化功率分配和 IRS 反射镜朝向最大化总速率，用户解码顺序由该优化导出而非固定。由于该问题非凸且信道条件随用户移动性变化，传统优化方法可能产生相当大的计算开销。因此，提出一种两阶段深度神经网络-深度强化学习（DNN-DRL）框架。第一阶段，DNN 实时估计用户的位置和朝向，从而无需完美掌握用户状态。第二阶段，基于确定性策略梯度（DPG）的 DRL 算法利用这些估计联合优化功率分配和 IRS 反射镜朝向，并根据得到的有效信道增益更新解码顺序。结果表明，所提框架接近性能上界，并在总速率和公平性方面优于标准 DRL 算法、传统优化方法以及无 IRS 部署，同时实现更快收敛。此外，解码顺序的在线自适应比固定解码顺序保持更高的 QoS 满意度，尤其在高用户移动性下。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
