items.title_en: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
items.title_zh: LLM 在后训练期间记忆自身的幻觉
items.abstract_en: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.
items.abstract_zh: 推理领域塑造了前沿模型的后训练方案，尽管它们在数学和代码之外的领域训练和部署。本文研究直接将推理中心训练方案用于知识任务的后果，例如对强化学习（RL）使用基于结果的奖励、注入“认知”行为（如在推理链中提出假设并回溯）等。我们假设，这些决策虽然对推理有用，却会在知识任务训练时无意中鼓励模型记忆其在长推理链中自身生成的幻觉。为研究这一点，我们用标准后训练训练模型，在 RL 期间提取其自生成幻觉，并在其余训练中跟踪记忆。我们在两个模型家族和两种架构的六个开放模型上的实验证实了该假设。我们发现，模型对训练期间被强化的幻觉的召回率平均增加 4.83%，而未收到训练信号的自幻觉仅增加 0.17%。事实上，模型甚至记住它们在推理中立即撤回的虚假事实；这是一种继承自推理中心训练的回溯模板，对知识召回没有益处。此外，我们发现记忆在最难的训练问题上最强，奖励一个幻觉会使模型之后更不可能放弃它（平均降低 7.23%）。总体而言，我们的工作识别并系统研究了一条此前未被考察的、模型在训练期间学习幻觉的路径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Assessing Vision-Language Models for Early Prediction of Unsafe Situations in Robotics
items.title_zh: 评估视觉语言模型在机器人不安全情境早期预测中的表现
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information and textual instructions and, by using their ability to understand and reason about context, are well-suited for predicting robot failures before they occur. However, evidence supporting this remains limited. To address this, we present an empirical evaluation of VLMs for predicting robot failures. In particular, we experiment with Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA-OneVision across three robotic case studies (HuRoN, Pal Robotics, and CrowdBot), analyzing both video and odometry data for early failure warning (i.e., before an unsafe situation occurs). Specifically, we evaluate their performance in classifying situations as safe, potentially unsafe, and unsafe, together with uncertainty quantified using various metrics, and study the relationship between uncertainty and performance. Our results showed that Qwen provides the strongest overall classification and prediction-reliability performance, while InternVL shows stronger early-warning capability in several configurations. The results further show that the effect of robot-state information and temporal history depends on the model and evaluation objective. Overall, our findings indicate that general-purpose VLMs can support early robot-safety monitoring, but the most suitable configuration depends on whether the priority is accurate assessment of safety-state, reliable confidence and uncertainty, or timely warning before unsafe events.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）处理视觉信息和文本指令，并利用其理解和推理上下文的能力，适合在机器人故障发生前进行预测。然而，支持这一点的证据仍然有限。为此，我们对用于预测机器人故障的 VLM 进行了实证评估。具体而言，我们在三个机器人案例研究（HuRoN、Pal Robotics 和 CrowdBot）中实验 Qwen、InternVL 和 LLaVA-OneVision，分析视频和里程计数据，以实现早期故障预警（即在不安全情境发生之前）。具体来说，我们评估它们将情境分类为安全、潜在不安全和不安全的表现，以及使用多种指标量化的不确定性，并研究不确定性与性能之间的关系。我们的结果表明，Qwen 提供最强的整体分类和预测可靠性表现，而 InternVL 在若干配置中表现出更强的预警能力。结果进一步表明，机器人状态信息和时序历史的影响取决于模型和评估目标。总体而言，我们的发现表明，通用 VLM 可以支持早期机器人安全监测，但最合适的配置取决于优先目标是准确评估安全状态、可靠的置信度和不确定性，还是在不安全事件发生前及时预警。

items.title_en: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
items.title_zh: FirstCross：基于稀疏视角的凸单光子三维重建
items.abstract_en: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons. However, leading neural methods such as Transientangelo require over an hour of non-convex per-scene optimization, and their accuracy degrades as photon flux decreases. We propose FirstCross, a network-free approach that instead solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid. For a solid object, the Poisson likelihood of a ray with given signal and background rates depends on the scene solely through its first crossing, the point where the ray first enters the object. Decomposing this likelihood yields two tractable terms. The first penalizes surfaces in front of detected photons and admits a tight convex closure, namely volume rendering with a running-maximum transmittance in place of NeRF's product transmittance. The second accounts for photons that no surface explains and admits a convex upper bound once the object is assumed to be thick behind each detected surface point. Compared with Transientangelo under its own real-data protocol, FirstCross achieves lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With three views and 100 times fewer photons than at the protocol's lowest flux, our mean object depth error stays under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Given our detected surface points, the best classical fusion has 1.3 to 1.8 times our three-view error across flux levels. On real room-scale captures with 1% of their photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8 to 7.7 times our error. FirstCross lets few-view single-photon scanners cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct an object in about a minute on one GPU.
items.abstract_zh: 单光子激光雷达通过记录每个返回光子的到达时间，使得在少量视角与极少光子条件下进行三维重建成为可能。然而，Transientangelo 等主流神经方法需要超过一小时的非凸逐场景优化，且精度随光子通量下降而退化。我们提出 FirstCross，一种无需神经网络的方案：它在体素网格上求解一系列简短的凸问题。对实体物体而言，给定信号率与背景率时，一条光线的泊松似然仅通过其“首次穿越”点，即光线首次进入物体的位置，依赖于场景。对该似然进行分解可得到两个可处理的项：第一项惩罚位于已探测光子之前的表面，并具有紧致的凸闭包，即用运行最大值透射率替代 NeRF 乘积透射率的体渲染；第二项解释没有表面能够解释的光子，在假定每个探测表面点之后物体较厚时可得到凸上界。结果：在与 Transientangelo 相同的真实数据协议下，FirstCross 在所有测试场景、视角数量和通量水平上均取得更低的深度误差；在 3 个视角、光子数比该协议最低通量还少 100 倍时，我们的平均物体深度误差仍低于 Transientangelo 使用全部光子时的一半。以我们探测到的表面点为输入，最佳经典融合方法在各通量下的误差是我们的 3 视角误差的 1.3 至 1.8 倍；在真实房间尺度采集且仅使用 1% 光子的情况下，TransientNeRF 的误差是我们的 2.8 至 7.7 倍。FirstCross 使少视角单光子扫描仪可将曝光降至 1%，并在单块 GPU 上约一分钟内完成物体重建。
items.highlight_zh: 用凸优化替代非凸神经优化，1 分钟完成极稀疏光子三维重建。
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：单光子激光雷达能记录每个返回光子的到达时间，因此理论上只需很少视角、很少光子就能重建三维形状。但现有最强的神经方法（如 Transientangelo）需要为每个场景做超过一小时的非凸优化，且光子越少精度越差。作者希望找到一个又快又准、且在极低光子通量下依然稳健的方案。
2. 方法思路：关键观察是——对不透明实体物体，一条光线上的光子统计（泊松似然）只取决于“首次穿越”点，即光线第一次碰到物体表面的位置，之后的物体内部结构并不影响这条光线。基于此，作者把似然拆成两项：一项惩罚“在已探测光子之前出现表面”的情况，可写成紧致的凸形式，相当于把 NeRF 的连乘透射率换成累计最大值透射率；另一项处理没有表面能解释的杂散光子，在“表面点之后物体足够厚”的假设下给出凸上界。于是整个重建变成体素网格上一连串短小的凸优化问题，无需训练神经网络。
3. 实验结果：在与 Transientangelo 相同的真实数据评测协议下，FirstCross 在每个场景、每种视角数、每档光子通量上都取得更低深度误差；即使只用 3 个视角且光子数比该协议最低档还少 100 倍，其平均深度误差仍不到 Transientangelo 用全部光子时的一半。与经典点云融合方法相比误差低 1.3–1.8 倍；在真实房间尺度数据上只用 1% 光子时，误差比 TransientNeRF 低 2.8–7.7 倍。
4. 意义：这意味着少视角单光子扫描设备可以把曝光时间压缩到原来的百分之一，并在一块 GPU 上约一分钟完成重建，对低成本、快速、低功耗的三维成像（如机器人、自动驾驶、远程 sensing）很有价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ShEPhERD-score: Fast, adaptable three-dimensional alignment of molecular features
items.title_zh: ShEPhERD-score：快速、可适应的分子特征三维对齐
items.abstract_en: Three-dimensional (3D) molecular similarity scoring and alignment are widely employed in ligand-based virtual screening and molecular design, and are increasingly used for training and evaluating machine learning models. Existing open-source methods utilize various molecular representations spanning shape, electrostatics, pharmacophores, and hybrid representations, but their implementations as independent software packages with distinct application programming interfaces (APIs), optimizers, and limited GPU support make them difficult to compare, combine, or extend. Here, we develop ShEPhERD-score into a unified, modular platform for differentiable 3D molecular similarity scoring and alignment by combining diverse molecular representations with high-performance Numba CPU and Triton GPU kernels to support both large-scale library screening and pairwise similarity workflows. In matched comparisons with open-source 3D similarity tools on the DUDE-Z virtual screening benchmark, ShEPhERD-score performed comparably or better in eight of nine cases. Across the scoring modes in ShEPhERD-score, throughput ranges from 17,800 to 1.03 million alignments/second for ten-million-conformer libraries using a single NVIDIA L40S GPU. Moreover, we found that the most effective scoring mode varied by protein target, indicating that target-specific calibration against validation data may be valuable before large-scale screening and underscoring the need for a unified platform that provides diverse molecular representations. Together, these capabilities establish ShEPhERD-score as a single, extensible toolkit for rapid virtual screening and machine learning workflows.
items.abstract_zh: 三维（3D）分子相似性评分与对齐广泛应用于基于配体的虚拟筛选和分子设计，并越来越多地用于训练和评估机器学习模型。现有开源方法利用涵盖形状、静电、药效团和混合表示的各种分子表示，但它们作为独立软件包实现，具有不同的应用程序编程接口（API）、优化器且 GPU 支持有限，使其难以比较、组合或扩展。在此，我们将 ShEPhERD-score 开发为一个统一、模块化的平台，用于可微的 3D 分子相似性评分与对齐，通过将多样分子表示与高性能 Numba CPU 和 Triton GPU 内核相结合，支持大规模库筛选和成对相似性工作流。在 DUDE-Z 虚拟筛选基准上与开源 3D 相似性工具进行匹配比较时，ShEPhERD-score 在九种情况中的八种表现相当或更好。在 ShEPhERD-score 的各评分模式下，使用单块 NVIDIA L40S GPU 处理千万构象库时，吞吐量范围为 17,800 至 103 万次对齐/秒。此外，我们发现最有效的评分模式因蛋白质靶标而异，这表明在大规模筛选前针对验证数据进行靶标特异性校准可能有价值，并凸显了提供多样分子表示的统一平台的必要性。总之，这些能力使 ShEPhERD-score 成为用于快速虚拟筛选和机器学习工作流的单一、可扩展工具包。

items.title_en: Observation of room-temperature intrinsic antiferroelectricity in van der Waals NbOCl2
items.title_zh: 范德华NbOCl2中室温本征反铁电性的观测
items.abstract_en: In recent years, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectricity has been extensively investigated across a wide range of 2D materials, while intrinsic 2D antiferroelectricity remains exceptionally rare, limiting its implementation in next-generation photonic and electronic devices. Here, we report the observation of room-temperature-stable antiferroelectricity in the layered transition metal oxyhalide NbOCl2, and demonstrate a reversible, stimuli-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric (AFE-to-FE) phase transition in this material. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) mapping reveals a well-defined stripe-like spatial distribution of SHG intensity across as-grown NbOCl2 flakes spanning thickness from few-layer to bulk-like configurations. This distinctive SHG signature originates from the existence of antiferroelectric phase and the coexistence of antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases within individual crystals, as evidenced by a combined incident-angle-dependent SHG measurement and Raman spectroscopy. By integrating NbOCl2 with one-dimensional silver nanowires, we achieve spatially selective, strain-mediated AFE-to-FE phase transition. Moreover, an ultralow electric field (~20 kV/cm) induces a reversible SHG response, consistent with switching from the centrosymmetric antiferroelectric state (SHG-silent) to the non-centrosymmetric ferroelectric state (SHG-active). This study not only expands the family of room-temperature 2D antiferroelectrics but also establishes a versatile platform for dynamic manipulation of nonlinear light, paving the way toward electric-field-programmable nonlinear photonics and optical information processing.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，二维（2D）铁电性已在多种2D材料中得到广泛研究，而本征2D反铁电性仍然极为罕见，限制了其在下一代光子和电子器件中的应用。本文报道在层状过渡金属氧卤化物NbOCl2中观测到室温稳定的反铁电性，并证明该材料中存在可逆的、刺激驱动的反铁电-铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。二次谐波产生（SHG）映射显示，在厚度从少层到类块体构型的生长态NbOCl2薄片中，SHG强度呈现明确的条带状空间分布。这种独特的SHG特征源于反铁电相的存在以及单个晶体中反铁电相与铁电相的共存，这由入射角依赖的SHG测量与拉曼光谱相结合所证明。通过将NbOCl2与一维银纳米线集成，我们实现了空间选择性的、应变介导的AFE-to-FE相变。此外，超低电场（约20 kV/cm）诱导可逆SHG响应，这与从中心对称反铁电态（SHG静默）切换到非中心对称铁电态（SHG活跃）一致。本研究不仅扩展了室温2D反铁电体家族，还建立了一个用于非线性光动态调控的多功能平台，为电场可编程非线性光子学和光信息处理铺平道路。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Efficient and Variation-Tolerant Tree Inference via Compact and Scalable Mapping in Analog CAMs
items.title_zh: 模拟 CAM 中紧凑可扩展映射实现高效且耐变异的树推理
items.abstract_en: Tree-based machine learning methods are widely adopted for their interpretability and state-of-the-art accuracy on tabular data. These methods face efficiency challenges on conventional architectures due to irregular memory access patterns during tree traversal. Prior work uses analog CAM to accelerate tree traversal, but inefficient mapping requires exponentially more analog CAM columns as tree depth increases. Accuracy is also degraded by device non-idealities such as programming variations and soft decision boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose ACTIVAR, a compact variation-tolerant tree implementation in a dense analog CAM array via software-hardware codesign. On the software side, we introduce an analog-CAM-aware compact tree model that employs hierarchical subtrees with shared features to maximize hardware utilization. This dense mapping introduces redundancy, improving both model accuracy and hardware defect tolerance. Additionally, we develop Variation-Enhanced Training, which utilizes a fuzzy overlap boundary strategy to build models resilient to analog noise. On the hardware side, we design a FeFET-based analog CAM cell with a driver to sharpen decision thresholds and implement a pipelined multi-core architecture to optimize throughput and energy consumption. Across 13 classification and regression datasets, ACTIVAR maintains near-software-level accuracy while reducing hardware overhead by up to 99% compared with prior analog-CAM-based soft-tree designs. Under realistic hardware noise conditions, ACTIVAR limits accuracy degradation to just 3.7% on the MNIST dataset, whereas baseline models suffer a catastrophic 49.6% drop. Furthermore, the ACTIVAR architecture achieves energy efficiency gains ranging from $10^4$ to $10^6$ times over commercial general-purpose processors, establishing it as a highly efficient solution for high-capacity machine learning at the edge.
items.abstract_zh: 基于树的机器学习方法因其可解释性和在表格数据上的最先进精度而被广泛采用。由于树遍历过程中不规则的内存访问模式，这些方法在传统架构上面临效率挑战。先前工作使用模拟 CAM 加速树遍历，但低效映射导致随着树深度增加需要指数级更多的模拟 CAM 列。精度还因器件非理想性（如编程变异和软决策边界）而下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ACTIVAR，一种通过软硬件协同设计在密集模拟 CAM 阵列中实现的紧凑、耐变异树实现。在软件方面，我们引入一种模拟 CAM 感知的紧凑树模型，采用具有共享特征的分层子树以最大化硬件利用率。这种密集映射引入冗余，同时提高模型精度和硬件缺陷容忍度。此外，我们开发了变异增强训练（Variation-Enhanced Training），利用模糊重叠边界策略构建对模拟噪声具有鲁棒性的模型。在硬件方面，我们设计了一种带有驱动器的基于 FeFET 的模拟 CAM 单元以锐化决策阈值，并实现流水线多核架构以优化吞吐量和能耗。在 13 个分类和回归数据集上，ACTIVAR 保持接近软件水平的精度，同时与先前基于模拟 CAM 的软树设计相比，将硬件开销降低多达 99%。在现实硬件噪声条件下，ACTIVAR 在 MNIST 数据集上将精度下降限制在仅 3.7%，而基线模型则遭受灾难性的 49.6% 下降。此外，ACTIVAR 架构相较商用通用处理器实现 $10^4$ 至 $10^6$ 倍的能效提升，使其成为边缘高容量机器学习的高效解决方案。

items.title_en: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
items.title_zh: MemFolder：结构引导的记忆折叠，用于高效智能体记忆管理
items.abstract_en: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.
items.abstract_zh: 长期智能体随着交互展开会积累大量外部记忆存储，增加存储、检索和响应生成的成本。效率受到两个耦合因素的制约：不断增长的记录数量增加检索开销，而更长的检索上下文增加预填充计算和解码时注意力成本。现有方法对记录进行剪枝或合并，但剪枝可能丢弃有用证据，而合并可能产生更少但更长的检索单元。我们提出 MemFolder，一种结构引导的记忆折叠框架，按顺序减少记录数量和上下文长度。该框架包括两个共享记忆组的核心组件，利用跨记录结构指导证据合并和紧凑表示。RecordFolder 对实体提及进行接地，逐步选择具有代表性但互补的锚点，并将语义和实体亲和力与时间链相结合，将兼容记录合并为更少的检索单元。ContextFolder 将这些组内的原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并在关键事实无法恢复时利用验证反馈修正编码。在三个基于文本的记忆基准 LoCoMo、PersonaMem 和 LongMemEval，以及两个多模态基准 M3-Bench-web 和 M3-Bench-robot 上的实验证明了我们方法的强劲性能。值得注意的是，在 Mem0 上，RecordFolder 在记录数量减少 50% 的情况下，在三个基于文本的基准上保留了原始平均性能的 99.0%，在性能保留方面超过最强基线 1.9 个百分点。与 ContextFolder 结合后，现有记录压缩方法进一步缩短其输出记录，同时保留大部分性能。

items.title_en: BRINA: Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE, a Sonar SLAM for Autonomous Marine Vehicles
items.title_zh: BRINA：基于 AKAZE 的底部参考惯性导航——面向自主海上车辆的声纳 SLAM
items.abstract_en: Forward-looking sonar (FLS) provides reliable underwater perception where optical sensing is limited, but its use for navigation is hindered by the unobserved elevation of each return. As a result, motion estimated directly from sonar images suffers from an unknown metric scale that is commonly resolved using a Doppler velocity log (DVL). We present BRINA (Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE), a sonar-inertial SLAM system for marine vehicles that uses the FLS as its only exteroceptive sensor. BRINA estimates the sonar altitude from the first seabed return in each beam and uses it to project matched features onto the seabed, providing metric odometry without a DVL. We further derive a bound relating the remaining scale error to seabed tilt and slope variability. The method is evaluated in simulation with an autonomous underwater vehicle, and in field experiments with uncrewed surface vehicles over ten missions, using two FLS systems under different operating conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 前视声纳（FLS）在光学感知受限的地方提供可靠的水下感知，但其用于导航受到每次回波中未观测高度的影响。因此，直接从声纳图像估计的运动受到未知度量尺度的影响，这通常使用多普勒速度计（DVL）解决。我们提出 BRINA（Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE），一种用于海上车辆的声纳-惯性 SLAM 系统，将 FLS 作为其唯一外感知传感器。BRINA 从每个波束中的首个海底回波估计声纳高度，并利用它将匹配特征投影到海底，从而无需 DVL 提供度量里程计。我们进一步推导一个界，将剩余尺度误差与海底倾斜和坡度变化联系起来。该方法在自主水下航行器仿真中评估，并在使用无人水面艇的十次任务现场实验中评估，这些实验在不同操作条件下使用两套 FLS 系统。

items.title_en: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
items.title_zh: WHU-Road3D：面向精细路面制图的数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}.
items.abstract_zh: 准确提取和测绘路面要素对于高精地图、道路资产管理以及智能交通系统等应用至关重要。本研究首先对用于提取和测绘道路要素的基准数据集进行了全面综述，涵盖从俯视到透视的数据、从大范围到局部的尺度、以及从粗到细的细节。随后，我们详尽回顾了提取路面要素的相关方法。然而，我们认为现有数据集在语义丰富度、数据模态多样性和场景复杂性方面仍需改进。为弥补这些差距，本文提出WHU-Road3D，一个用于精细路面制图的大规模多模态数据集，以解决上述不足。WHU-Road3D提供约100公里的多样化中国高速公路和城市街道。它具有丰富的组合：MLS点云、相关联的全景图像、车辆轨迹、详细矢量化标注，以及路面要素的逐点实例标注。该数据集精心标注了15个不同类别的道路要素，包括道路边界、斑马线、车道分隔线、停止线等常见标线，以及10种方向符号。据我们所知，WHU-Road3D是首个用于测绘如此全面范围路面要素的多模态数据集，旨在促进路面实例分割、全要素提取与制图的前沿研究。除这些直接应用外，WHU-Road3D还为分层道路拓扑推理、地图更新和街景生成提供了宝贵资源。该数据集以及我们基准方法的代码将公开于\href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}。

items.title_en: Scalable Non-Parametric Bayesian Inference of Free Energy Landscapes and Emission Functions from Observations
items.title_zh: 从观测中进行自由能景观与发射函数的可扩展非参数贝叶斯推断
items.abstract_en: Free-energy landscapes govern processes from protein conformational change to climate oscillations, but are typically observed only indirectly, through observables such as FRET intensity or optical-tweezer transmittance. Neither the landscape shape, nor the emission function mapping latent state to signal, is usually known, and distinct states may produce the same signal. We therefore infer landscape and emission function jointly and non-parametrically, using the exact non-linear Bayesian filtering likelihood, to fully use the information contained in observable trajectories that are often noisy, scarce and costly to acquire. A novel parallel-in-time algorithm makes this tractable: it is up to 27 times faster than sequential filtering on one GPU, scales near-ideally across GPUs, and, given enough resources, has runtime independent of trajectory length. We demonstrate the method on a single-protein optical tweezer recording, where distinct conformations produce the same signal, and beyond biology on the El Nino-Southern Oscillation and financial market volatility.
items.abstract_zh: 自由能景观支配着从蛋白质构象变化到气候振荡的过程，但通常只能通过 FRET 强度或光镊透射率等可观测量间接观测。景观形状以及将潜在状态映射到信号的发射函数通常均未知，且不同状态可能产生相同信号。因此，我们联合且非参数地推断景观与发射函数，使用精确的非线性贝叶斯滤波似然，以充分利用通常含噪、稀少且获取成本高昂的可观测轨迹中所包含的信息。一种新颖的时间并行算法使这一推断变得可行：在单块 GPU 上，它比顺序滤波快至多 27 倍，在多块 GPU 上接近理想扩展，并且在资源充足时运行时间与轨迹长度无关。我们在单蛋白光镊记录上演示了该方法，其中不同构象产生相同信号；并在生物学之外，将其应用于厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和金融市场波动率。

items.title_en: A Microwave-Photonics Formulation of the Rydberg-Atom Receiver
items.title_zh: 里德堡原子接收机的微波光子学表述
items.abstract_en: The performance of Rydberg-atom receivers is seldom stated as a radio-frequency (RF) link budget. The receiver is shown to be an intensity-modulated direct-detection analog optical link whose modulator is the laser-driven vapor. The transmission of a warm vapor is derived in closed form by averaging the four-level response over atomic velocities. The conversion gain, noise figure, bandwidth, intercept points, and spurious-free dynamic range follow from this one function. For a weak probe the instantaneous bandwidth is half the width of the transparency window in two-photon detuning. The local-oscillator beat places the second-order intercept near twice the local-oscillator field, so the local oscillator sets the even-order linearity. For a rubidium transition at 17.04 GHz the closed forms agree with a velocity-resolved density-matrix model to 1% for the slope and the intercepts and to 10% for the bandwidth. They underestimate the group delay by a third. The response is tied to atomic constants, and the sensing volume escapes the Chu limit. However, the noise figure of a warm vapor rules it out as a general replacement for an antenna and low-noise amplifier.
items.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子接收机的性能很少以射频（RF）链路预算的形式表述。该接收机被证明是一种强度调制直接检测模拟光链路，其调制器是激光驱动的蒸气。热蒸气的透射通过对原子速度上的四能级响应取平均，以闭式形式推导。转换增益、噪声系数、带宽、截点以及无杂散动态范围均由这一函数得出。对于弱探测，瞬时带宽为双光子失谐中透明窗口宽度的一半。本振拍频使二阶截点接近本振场的两倍，因此本振决定偶数阶线性度。对于 17.04 GHz 的铷跃迁，闭式结果与速度分辨密度矩阵模型在斜率和截点方面一致到 1%，带宽一致到 10%。它们将群延迟低估三分之一。响应与原子常数相关，感测体积突破 Chu 极限。然而，热蒸气的噪声系数使其无法作为天线和低噪声放大器的通用替代。

items.title_en: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
items.title_zh: 通过残差学习分配改进多阶段任务的模仿策略
items.abstract_en: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 残差强化学习使用有限的环境交互预算来校正经模仿训练的基础策略。在包含多个阶段的任务中，该预算必须在各阶段之间分配，而基础策略失败的阶段不一定是校正最能提升任务完成的阶段。我们通过完成增益形式化这一区别：在单个阶段中，当状态反馈控制器替换基础策略动作的选定分量时，全任务完成概率的变化。我们将完成增益分解为到达该阶段的概率以及从该阶段开始时的条件完成改进，并从配对回合中估计它。正估计值决定残差策略校正哪些动作分量，以及训练回合如何在各阶段间分布。在随机点质量对接实验中，大多数失败发生在最终对接阶段，而最大的完成增益发生在其之前的通道阶段；基于增益的分配相比按失败计数比例分配提升了完成率，并且在具有更长接近过程的变体中，在半预算下相比均匀分配也有提升。在模拟双臂机器人装配中，完成增益估计仅在插入和释放阶段为正，尽管释放阶段发生的失败很少；在第二种装配配置中，在释放阶段训练的残差策略将从释放开始时留出状态下的完成率提高了 16.9%。

items.title_en: Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
items.title_zh: 胸部X光报告的多模态错误检测：大语言模型读取图像证据
items.abstract_en: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. On 131 quads, Rad-Linter achieves 98.5% pair accuracy versus 80.5% for the rule baseline, and classifies all four pairs correctly in 94.4% of quads versus 56.5%. The checkers perform similarly on omission items, including unmentioned and negated findings; larger differences occur on the remaining item types, which require interpreting how findings are described. The same language model without fine-tuning remains near 50% accuracy. On a second set of 181 quads that also includes reports on which the automatic labelers disagree, pair accuracy is 93.4% versus 75.3%. These controlled results show that, given the same image-derived scores, a trained language model detects report-score inconsistencies more accurately than the tested rule baseline, with the advantage concentrated in interpreting how findings are worded.
items.abstract_zh: Rad-Linter 将胸片报告与图像衍生证据比对，标出可能的错误以供复核。预训练图像分类器给出九种病变的分数，一个 1.5B 参数语言模型经 LoRA 在 1816 个样本上微调，检验这些分数与报告是否一致。我们在相同报告与分数上将其与「关键词+否定」规则基线对比。评估使用 OpenI 的受控报告-分数配对，一致性标签由自动报告标签与分数阈值导出。每个反事实四元组把两份真实报告与来自其他病人的两份真实分数向量交叉组合，形成两对一致、两对不一致；每份报告与分数向量都在两种条件下出现，故任何单一输入最高只有 50% 准确率。在 131 个四元组上，Rad-Linter 配对准确率 98.5%，规则基线 80.5%；四对全判对的比例为 94.4% 对 56.5%。在省略类条目（含未提及与否定发现）上两者相近，差异主要在需理解描述方式的其余条目类型。未经微调的同一语言模型仍接近 50%。在另含自动标注分歧报告的第二组 181 个四元组上，配对准确率为 93.4% 对 75.3%。结果说明：给定相同图像分数，训练过的语言模型比所测规则基线更准确地检测报告-分数不一致，优势集中在理解发现的措辞方式上。
items.highlight_zh: 同一图像分数下，微调大模型比规则基线更准地揪出报告错误
items.digest_zh:
- 要解决什么：放射报告里常出现与图像不符的描述，例如漏写、写反或写错病变。自动核对难在报告是自由文本，而图像模型只给出一组病变概率。
- 怎么做：Rad-Linter 让预训练胸片分类器为九种病变打分，再让一个 1.5B 参数语言模型（LoRA 微调 1816 个样本）判断报告说法与这些分数是否自洽；基线是关键词加否定词的规则。
- 实验设计很关键：构造反事实四元组，把两份真实报告和来自其他病人的两份真实分数交叉组合，每组两对一致、两对不一致。每份报告和分数都在两种条件下出现，所以只看报告或只看分数最多只能到 50%，真正考察的是两边联合推理。
- 结果：131 组上配对准确率 98.5%，规则基线 80.5%；四对全对的比例 94.4% 对 56.5%。差距主要出现在需要读懂「发现如何被措辞」的条目；在未提及或否定的省略类条目上两者相当。同一模型不微调则掉回约 50%，等于没用上两路信息。第二组含标注分歧的 181 组上仍是 93.4% 对 75.3%。
- 为何重要：说明小模型配上有针对性的数据设计就能做多模态一致性核查，可作报告质控初筛、把可疑报告交人复核，也提示这类任务的门槛是学会交叉比对，而不只是模型规模。

items.title_en: Seeing Is Not Steering: Where Verifiable Reasoning Can Enter an End-to-End Driving Planner
items.title_zh: 看见不等于操控：可验证推理能在何处进入端到端驾驶规划器
items.abstract_en: Driving models that reason may describe a hazard correctly while choosing their path for other reasons. We study where scene reasoning can enter an end-to-end planner so its influence can be checked. We freeze Drive-JEPA and use a fine-tuned vision-language model to state scene facts. Although fine-tuning improves fact accuracy, the two learned components we test show no detectable benefit from reading them. A rule-based fact check instead rejects or shortens paths that contradict the facts, linking each intervention to a stated fact. On the frozen planner alone, it gains 2.4 EPDMS points on navhard. Its 2.0-point margin over a control that changes the same frames without consulting facts remains statistically uncertain. A diagnostic using exact facts from maps and annotations yields a 3.6-point margin over its corresponding control, with a 95% confidence interval above zero. Separately, a path scorer and plan memory that read no stated facts raise navhard from 41.2 to 51.8. Bounding travel distance using the reasoner's facts adds 0.3 there and reduces navtest by 2.0. The fact check makes each intervention auditable, while the driving value of the reasoner's facts remains unresolved.
items.abstract_zh: 具备推理能力的驾驶模型可能正确描述危险，却因其他原因选择路径。我们研究场景推理可以在何处进入端到端规划器，从而使其影响可被检查。我们冻结 Drive-JEPA，并使用微调的视觉语言模型陈述场景事实。尽管微调提高了事实准确率，我们测试的两个学习组件在读取这些事实后并未表现出可检测的收益。相反，基于规则的事实检查会拒绝或缩短与事实相矛盾的路径，并将每次干预与一条陈述的事实关联起来。仅在冻结规划器上，该方法在 navhard 上获得 2.4 个 EPDMS 点。相较于一个在相同帧上做改变但不参考事实的对照，其 2.0 点优势在统计上仍不确定。一项使用来自地图和标注的精确事实的诊断，相较于其相应控制组取得 3.6 点优势，95% 置信区间高于零。另外，一个不读取任何陈述事实的路径评分器和规划记忆将 navhard 从 41.2 提升到 51.8。使用推理器事实限制行驶距离在此处增加 0.3，并使 navtest 下降 2.0。事实检查使每次干预可审计，而推理器事实的驾驶价值仍未解决。

items.title_en: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
items.title_zh: DACA：用于零样本3D视觉定位的双锚协作智能体
items.abstract_en: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
items.abstract_zh: 3D视觉定位（3D-VG）是一项连接自然语言与3D空间的任务，是具身智能和人机交互的基础能力。尽管近期3D-VG智能体克服了对预处理3D点云的依赖，但它们本质上采用单向、流水线式的工具调用架构。该架构将语义理解与几何重建分离，导致误差累积且无法自主从失败中恢复。为解决这一缺陷，本文提出双锚协作智能体（DACA），将3D-VG重新解释为语义-几何双锚协作推理范式。DACA包含两个互补的专用工具：语义锚工具持有目标的视觉语义特征，并通过光流和VLM局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚工具持有目标的3D空间几何特征，并通过体素化和多关键点投影执行全局空间推理。两个组件通过标准化工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决定下一个感知-动作步骤，形成闭环优化。在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上的实验表明，零样本DACA在ScanRefer上取得73.6%的总体Acc@0.25，在Nr3D上取得70.4%的总体准确率，远超最新的零样本3D-VG方法。代码和模型见 https://github.com/liujia99/DACA

items.title_en: Inferring Neural Activity Changes under Recording Uncertainty with Transformers and Variational Inference
items.title_zh: 利用Transformer与变分推断在记录不确定性下推断神经活动变化
items.abstract_en: A difference in recorded firing rate across days may reflect a change in neuronal activity, missed spikes or recording a different neuron. We present a statistical approach that combines neuron tracking with Bayesian estimates of stationary mean recorded firing rates. Bounds under assumed differences in spike detection connect recorded rates to biological rate changes. We assess recording loss and uncertainty in rate changes in simulations, and count-model fit in recordings. We also compare two transformer estimators with Gaussian and flow variational inference under a shared temporal negative-binomial model. Flow variational inference agrees most closely with reference posteriors, while predictive performance varies across mice. Rate-change intervals contain true simulated changes less often than intended. In UnitMatch recordings from five mice, some inferred changes remain supported when spike detection is allowed to differ between days; others depend on equal detection. These interpretations require a correct neuron match. The approach identifies which inferred rate changes remain supported under specified recording assumptions and where uncertainty limits interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 跨天记录到的放电率差异可能反映神经活动的变化、漏检的锋电位，或记录到了不同的神经元。我们提出一种统计方法，将神经元追踪与对平稳平均记录放电率的贝叶斯估计相结合。在假设的锋电位检测差异下给出的界限，将记录率与生物学速率变化联系起来。我们在模拟中评估记录丢失和速率变化的不确定性，并在实测记录中评估计数模型的拟合。我们还在共享的时间负二项模型下，比较了采用高斯变分推断和流变分推断的两种Transformer估计器。流变分推断与参考后验最为接近，而预测性能在不同小鼠间存在差异。速率变化区间包含真实模拟变化的频率低于预期。在来自五只小鼠的UnitMatch记录中，当允许不同天之间的锋电位检测存在差异时，部分推断出的变化仍得到支持；另一些则依赖于检测相同。这些解释需要一个正确的神经元匹配。该方法能够识别在指定记录假设下哪些推断的速率变化仍得到支持，以及不确定性在何处限制了推断。

items.title_en: Shift current as a stacking spectroscopy of hexagonal boron nitride multilayers
items.title_zh: 移位电流作为六方氮化硼多层的堆叠光谱学
items.abstract_en: Out-of-plane polarization can be tuned by sliding polar monolayers in van der Waals materials; the bulk photovoltaic effect is emerging as a natural optical probe, provided the photocurrent tracks the polarization. We test that assumption by computing the polarization and the shift-current tensor from first principles across the stacking landscape of bi-, tri-, and tetralayer hexagonal boron nitride. The two quantities share one robust property: the vertical response reverses with the polarization while the in-plane one does not. Beyond this rule, the correspondence must be read with caution: stackings with identical polarization carry vertical monochromatic photocurrents of opposite sign; the spectra reorganize and even reverse sign at some photon energies along a constant-polarization plateau; and the strongest vertical peak of the entire pathway sits where the polarization crosses zero. The reason is structural: the polarization counts polar interfaces, while the shift current reads their positions. Broadband illumination reads the domain sign; monochromatic photocurrent maps can read the stacking registry. In a sliding ferroelectric, the bulk photovoltaic effect can operate as a stacking spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 在范德华材料中，面外极化可通过滑动极性单层来调控；体光伏效应正成为一种自然的光学探针，前提是光电流能够追踪极化。我们通过第一性原理计算双、三、四层六方氮化硼堆叠构型空间中的极化和移位电流张量，以检验这一假设。这两个量共享一个稳健性质：垂直响应随极化反转，而面内响应则不随其反转。除这一规则外，二者的对应关系必须谨慎解读：具有相同极化的堆叠具有符号相反的垂直单色光电流；沿恒定极化平台，光谱在部分光子能量处发生重组甚至反号；而整个路径中最强的垂直峰值位于极化过零处。原因在于结构：极化计数的是极性界面，而移位电流读取的是它们的位置。宽带照明读取畴的符号；单色光电流图可以读取堆叠登记信息。在滑动铁电体中，体光伏效应可作为堆叠光谱学运行。

items.title_en: Towards Deep Learning-Based Linear Assignment Problem Solvers for Multi-Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向多目标跟踪的基于深度学习的线性分配问题求解器
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes and evaluates deep learning (DL)-based linear assignment problem (LAP) solvers as a replacement for the classical Hungarian algorithm in multi-object tracking (MOT) systems. Three representative neural models are studied, namely a convolutional network (CNN), a graph neural network (GNN), and the graph-based linear assignment network (GLAN). A cost-matrix embedding is introduced so that a single model operates on cost matrices of any size, as required in MOT where the number of objects varies over time, without training a separate model for each input shape. Extensive simulations show that the embedding improves the accuracy of the neural solvers (i.e., CNN and GNN), while GLAN attains the best accuracy among them. These solvers are then integrated into a generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) tracker and evaluated on the WILDTRACK dataset, where GLAN yields tracking accuracy close to the Hungarian reference and comparable to recent DL-based trackers.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出并评估基于深度学习（DL）的线性分配问题（LAP）求解器，用以替代多目标跟踪（MOT）系统中的经典匈牙利算法。研究了三种代表性神经模型，即卷积网络（CNN）、图神经网络（GNN）和基于图的线性分配网络（GLAN）。引入代价矩阵嵌入，使单个模型能够处理任意大小的代价矩阵，以满足MOT中目标数量随时间变化的要求，而无需为每种输入形状训练单独模型。大量仿真表明，该嵌入提高了神经求解器（即CNN和GNN）的准确率，而GLAN在它们之中取得最佳准确率。随后将这些求解器集成到广义标签多伯努利（GLMB）跟踪器中，并在WILDTRACK数据集上评估；其中GLAN的跟踪准确率接近匈牙利算法参考值，并与近期基于DL的跟踪器相当。

items.title_en: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
items.title_zh: SLAM-ASR 语音识别模型的归纳头起源
items.abstract_en: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.
items.abstract_zh: 是什么使得一个从编码器状态到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的、训练得到的小型映射，足以实现有竞争力的语音识别？SLAM-ASR 架构的前提是，冻结语言模型拥有足够丰富的语言知识来执行识别任务。这一假设虽然合理，却几乎没有揭示这些模型背后的机制。因此，我们寻找它们所依赖的具体内部结构。本工作表明，SLAM-ASR 模型依赖冻结语言模型的归纳头：那些在文本中复制重复词元序列的注意力头，同样对将语音嵌入映射到转写词元很重要。此外，我们发现成对的注意力头表现出一种受限形式的差分注意力，抵消注意力噪声并将注意力锐化到先前生成的词上。最后，我们展示了如何利用归纳头在噪声音频下提升转写质量。

items.title_en: ADEPT: Adaptive Monocular Depth Estimation via Model-In-The-Loop Photometric Tuning with Capture Risk Prediction
items.title_zh: ADEPT：通过模型在环光度调谐与采集风险预测的自适应单目深度估计
items.abstract_en: Exposure and gain determine the visual evidence available to monocular depth estimation (MDE), particularly when robot motion creates a tradeoff between light collection and motion blur. We present ADEPT, a framework that adapts these settings using learned feedback from a frozen depth model. During training, ground-truth depth identifies the lowest-error reference within a group of physically evaluated camera settings. A compact predictor learns reference-relative disagreement (RRD) between each candidate's depth prediction and the reference prediction using regression and ranking losses. At deployment, it scores observed captures using frozen-model features and camera, motion, and illumination context, without ground truth or reference images. A contextual Gaussian-process controller uses recent scores to select subsequent exposure and gain settings under motion and photometric constraints. We evaluate offline camera selection with relative and metric Depth Anything v2 and demonstrate online control with the affine-invariant variant on a mobile robot. Across nine equally weighted scene-illumination conditions, ADEPT reduces mean scale-and-shift-aligned $\mathrm{Abs}_{\mathrm{rel}}$ by 14.6% relative to built-in auto-exposure and by 10.0% relative to the best-performing evaluated prior controller.
items.abstract_zh: 曝光和增益决定了单目深度估计（MDE）可用的视觉证据，尤其是当机器人运动在光采集与运动模糊之间产生权衡时。我们提出 ADEPT，一个利用来自冻结深度模型的学习反馈来自适应这些设置的框架。在训练期间，真值深度在一组经过物理评估的相机设置中识别出误差最低的参考。一个紧凑预测器使用回归和排序损失学习每个候选的深度预测与参考预测之间的参考相对不一致（RRD）。在部署时，它使用冻结模型特征以及相机、运动和照明上下文对观测到的采集进行评分，无需真值或参考图像。一个上下文高斯过程控制器使用最近的评分，在运动和光度约束下选择后续曝光和增益设置。我们使用相对和度量版本的 Depth Anything v2 评估离线相机选择，并在移动机器人上使用仿射不变变体演示在线控制。在九个等权重的场景-照明条件下，ADEPT 相对于内置自动曝光将尺度与偏移对齐后的平均 Abs_rel 降低 14.6%，相对于表现最佳的已评估先前控制器降低 10.0%。

items.title_en: SegAnyFruit: Learning Generalizable and Edge Deployable Fruit Instance Segmentation at Scale
items.title_zh: SegAnyFruit：学习可泛化且可边缘部署的规模化水果实例分割
items.abstract_en: Deploying fruit instance segmentation in real agricultural settings requires generalizing across unseen species, orchards, and imaging conditions under strict onboard compute and annotation budgets. We introduce SegAnyFruit (SAF), a data construction and progressive training framework that distills foundation-model priors into lightweight, prompt-free segmenters. SAF combines generic mask pre-training, broad mid-training on automatically annotated web imagery from our curated WebFruits dataset, and human-verified agricultural refinement post-training on PaperFruits, together spanning 733K images and 9.66M whole-fruit masks across 165 fruit types. Across seven benchmarks, zero-shot SAF-RF-DETR-XL reaches 69.06 average mask AP50:95 (+4.76 over SAM 3) while remaining deployable on edge devices. SAF initialization also boosts few-shot to full-shot adaptation across five agricultural domains while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we systematically analyze training stages, data scale, model capacity, and generative augmentation, and validate our pipeline's transferability to underwater, cell, and human segmentation. We will release our datasets, code, and SAF models.
items.abstract_zh: 在真实农业环境中部署水果实例分割，需要在严格的板载计算和标注预算下，泛化到未见过的物种、果园和成像条件。我们提出 SegAnyFruit（SAF），一种数据构建与渐进式训练框架，将基础模型先验蒸馏到轻量级、无需提示的分割器中。SAF 结合了通用掩码预训练、在我们构建的 WebFruits 数据集上对自动标注网络图像进行广泛中期训练，以及在 PaperFruits 上进行经人工验证的农业细化后训练，合计涵盖 165 种水果类型的 733K 张图像和 9.66M 个整果掩码。在七个基准上，零样本 SAF-RF-DETR-XL 达到 69.06 的平均掩码 AP50:95（比 SAM 3 高 4.76），同时仍可部署在边缘设备上。SAF 初始化还提升了跨五个农业领域从小样本到全样本的适应能力，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。最后，我们系统分析了训练阶段、数据规模、模型容量和生成式增强，并验证了我们流程向水下、细胞和人体分割的可迁移性。我们将发布数据集、代码和 SAF 模型。

items.title_en: Remarkable Biosynthetic Diversity in the Bionectriaceae: Uncovering the genomic basis of antipathogen bioactivity of cacao fungal endophytes Clonostachys rosea and Waltergamsia zeylanica.
items.title_zh: Bionectriaceae 中显著的生物合成多样性：揭示可可真菌内生菌 Clonostachys rosea 和 Waltergamsia zeylanica 抗病原生物活性的基因组基础
items.abstract_en: Cacao (Theobroma cacao) production in tropical countries is threatened by fungal diseases caused by Moniliophthora roreri and M. perniciosa. Two cacao pod endophytes from Bionectriaceae, Clonostachys rosea TCF417 and Waltergamsia zeylanica TCF400, exhibit growth antagonism towards M. roreri; however, the genetic basis underlying the bioactivity of these strains has not been addressed. Here, we aimed to identify biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) potentially associated with the antifungal bioactivity of these two strains and performed a comparative analysis with 30 publicly available Bionectriaceae genomes using BiG-SCAPE. Whole-genome sequencing using Oxford Nanopore and Illumina technologies, resulted in assemblies of 52.9 Mb (C. rosea TCF417) and 31 Mb (W. zeylanica TCF400). Genome annotation was conducted using Funannotate, and secondary metabolite BGCs were predicted using antiSMASH. The two cacao endophytes harbored 92 BGCs (C. rosea: 67; W. zeylanica: 25), indicating remarkable biosynthetic diversity. Across all 32 genomes, 1,523 BGC-containing regions were identified, most belonging to T1PKS clusters. Network-based clustering revealed 209 gene cluster families (GCFs), of which 52 corresponded to previously characterized BGCs. Conserved BGCs for antifungal compounds, including sorbicillinoids and verticillins, were identified in cacao endophytes and across Bionectriaceae. Additionally, an antifungal assay conducted here demonstrated that verticillin D from C. rosea TCF417 exhibited growth inhibition of plant pathogens Moniliophthora roreri and Mycena citricolor. With about 75% of unassigned GCFs, our results reveal a largely untapped biosynthetic repertoire in the Bionectriaceae and identify verticillin D as a candidate contributor to the antagonism of C. rosea against plant pathogens.
items.abstract_zh: 热带国家的可可（Theobroma cacao）生产受到由 Moniliophthora roreri 和 M. perniciosa 引起的真菌病害威胁。来自 Bionectriaceae 的两种可可荚内生菌 Clonostachys rosea TCF417 和 Waltergamsia zeylanica TCF400 对 M. roreri 表现出生长拮抗；然而，这些菌株生物活性背后的遗传基础尚未得到研究。在此，我们旨在鉴定可能与这两株菌抗真菌生物活性相关的生物合成基因簇（BGCs），并使用 BiG-SCAPE 与 30 个公开可用的 Bionectriaceae 基因组进行比较分析。使用 Oxford Nanopore 和 Illumina 技术进行全基因组测序，分别获得 52.9 Mb（C. rosea TCF417）和 31 Mb（W. zeylanica TCF400）的组装。使用 Funannotate 进行基因组注释，并使用 antiSMASH 预测次级代谢产物 BGCs。这两种可可内生菌共包含 92 个 BGCs（C. rosea：67 个；W. zeylanica：25 个），表明显著的生物合成多样性。在所有 32 个基因组中，共鉴定出 1,523 个含 BGC 的区域，其中大多数属于 T1PKS 簇。基于网络的聚类揭示了 209 个基因簇家族（GCFs），其中 52 个对应于先前已表征的 BGCs。在可可内生菌以及 Bionectriaceae 中鉴定出抗真菌化合物的保守 BGCs，包括 sorbicillinoids 和 verticillins。此外，此处进行的抗真菌试验表明，来自 C. rosea TCF417 的 verticillin D 对植物病原体 Moniliophthora roreri 和 Mycena citricolor 表现出生长抑制。由于约 75% 的 GCFs 未被分配，我们的结果揭示了 Bionectriaceae 中很大程度上尚未开发的生物合成资源库，并鉴定 verticillin D 为 C. rosea 拮抗植物病原体的候选贡献者。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Autonomous quantum machine learning via Riemannian gradient-based optimization
items.title_zh: 基于黎曼梯度的优化实现自主量子机器学习
items.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning models typically rely on repeated quantum measurements and classical optimization during training, making the quantum-to-classical information-extraction process a fundamental bottleneck for scalability. We propose a framework for autonomous self-training quantum machine learning, based on Riemannian gradient optimization, in which the optimization proceeds entirely within the quantum domain without requiring quantum measurements or classical feedback. We derive the Riemannian gradient update rules for a broad class of learning tasks and identify sufficient conditions under which the resulting training dynamics can be realized fully autonomously. Within this regime, we establish an exponential convergence guarantee, in the training iterations, for sufficiently small step sizes, and further analyze the training cost in terms of the growth of the circuit depth. Importantly, we further show that the trained model can automatically discover symmetries hidden in the training data without $\textit{a priori}$ specification. For the canonical examples of quantum phase classification and unitary learning with a hidden symmetry, our numerical study indicates that learning can be achieved at low circuit depths with only a few distinct training examples. Our results thus establish autonomous quantum machine learning as a promising paradigm that removes the classical optimization loop while retaining strong theoretical guarantees and practical performances.
items.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习模型通常依赖训练期间的重复量子测量和经典优化，使得量子到经典的信息提取过程成为可扩展性的根本瓶颈。我们提出一个基于黎曼梯度优化的自主自训练量子机器学习框架，其中优化完全在量子域内进行，不需要量子测量或经典反馈。我们为一大类学习任务推导黎曼梯度更新规则，并确定使所得训练动力学能够完全自主实现的充分条件。在该机制内，我们建立了在步长足够小时的指数收敛保证（以训练迭代次数计），并进一步从电路深度增长的角度分析训练成本。重要的是，我们进一步表明，训练后的模型可以自动发现训练数据中隐藏的对称性，而无需先验指定。对于量子相分类和具有隐藏对称性的酉学习这两个典型示例，我们的数值研究表明，仅用少量不同训练样本即可在低电路深度下实现学习。因此，我们的结果确立了自主量子机器学习作为一种有前景的范式，它去除了经典优化循环，同时保留强理论保证和实际性能。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
items.title_zh: cmHC：通过几何收缩平衡超连接中的流混合
items.abstract_en: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. We reveal a mixing trade-off: when under-mixed residual matrices stay close to the vertices of the Birkhoff polytope, hyper-connections will degenerate into a set of nearly independent streams; when over-mixed residual matrices are concentrated around the uniform barycenter of the polytope, streams will become less distinguishable from each other. We theoretically validate our findings by bounding the cumulative residual mixing, stream difference and gradient difference of mixing coefficients across layers. Motivated by these findings, we propose Contraction for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (cmHC), an exact doubly stochastic method which geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior. This contraction mitigates under-mixing by forcing the residual matrices to explore deeper into the polytope, with a provable stream mixing bound and no new parameterization. Moreover, we apply a moderate contraction at the shallow layers to prevent over-mixing, enabling stable gradient propagation on extremely large-scale model pretraining. Extensive experiments across dense and mixture-of-experts models at various parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of cmHC. We also develop fused operators for cmHC on Ascend NPUs, reducing hyper-connection execution latency by up to 44.8%.
items.abstract_zh: 流形约束超连接（mHC）将残差连接扩展到多个流，并通过将流混合残差矩阵约束到 Birkhoff 多胞形（双随机矩阵集合）来稳定残差传播。在本工作中，我们研究如何在 Birkhoff 多胞形内有效混合残差流。我们揭示了一种混合权衡：当混合不足的残差矩阵靠近 Birkhoff 多胞形的顶点时，超连接将退化为一组几乎独立的流；当混合过度的残差矩阵集中在多胞形的均匀重心附近时，流之间将变得难以区分。我们通过对跨层混合系数的累积残差混合、流差异和梯度差异进行界定，在理论上验证了我们的发现。受这些发现启发，我们提出用于流形约束超连接的收缩方法（cmHC），这是一种精确的双随机方法，将 Birkhoff 多胞形几何收缩向其内部。这种收缩通过迫使残差矩阵更深入多胞形内部来缓解混合不足，具有可证明的流混合界且不引入新的参数化。此外，我们在浅层应用适度收缩以防止混合过度，从而在极大规模模型预训练中实现稳定的梯度传播。在不同参数规模的稠密模型和专家混合模型上的大量实验证明了 cmHC 的有效性和可扩展性。我们还为 cmHC 在昇腾 NPU 上开发了融合算子，将超连接执行延迟最多降低 44.8%。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器学习，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 方法、实验条件与结论以原文为准；推荐分不等于已复现或同行评审认证。

items.title_en: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进协同演化决策模型与数据
items.abstract_en: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出Piccolo，一个多模态决策模型家族（0.8B到27B），通过智能体数据工程（Agentic Data Engineering）和递归自我改进（RSI）协同演化模型能力与训练数据。这些模型针对通用文本和视觉判断、智能体框架（agent harnesses）、数据工作流和交互式游戏中的候选答案预测概率。Piccolo-27B以75.59分位居Decision Index Vision Full排行榜榜首，而Piccolo-9B和Piccolo-4B分别达到68.35和67.46。三者均在各自模型规模类别的Private基准上排名第一。研究智能体分析模型行为、构建训练数据、开展实验，并利用结果改进后续提案。语义切片和共享研究记忆将这些行动贯穿模型家族的开发过程。训练配方包含数十万个示例，数据选择和反馈驱动的改进是自我改进过程的核心。我们的大规模RSI探索为决策模型开发带来三个反直觉的洞见：（1）骨干-配方共同适应比原始模型的新近程度更重要：在相同配方下，较早的骨干在视觉任务上可以超过更新一代；（2）有针对性的数据整理使4B-9B模型在专门工作流上可与27B基线匹敌；（3）连续损失降低可能与离散决策准确率脱钩，甚至使其退化。连同来自Data-Juicer和AgentScope生态系统的已发布权重和工具，Piccolo为构建前沿决策模型和扩展数据驱动的RSI提供了可操作的蓝图。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: FORTH: Grounding Tactile VLA Execution via Forward-Only Proxy-Control Pairing
items.title_zh: FORTH：通过仅前向代理-控制配对为触觉 VLA 执行提供接地
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are widely credited with force control, operating on the unverified assumption that proxy loss minimization implies physical force grounding. In this work, we demonstrate that this assumption breaks down at three core deployment levels: frozen visual backbones discard contact geometry, downstream losses mask token-level gradient alignment, and discrete indicators trigger optimization collapse. To address these disconnections, we present FORTH, a forward-only measurement harness and execution framework that explicitly pairs the optimization objective at each level with its physical control observable. FORTH incorporates three grounded pillars: a layer-local, forward-only tactile encoder that preserves spatial contact geometry without backpropagation, a token-parallel zeroth-order adapter enabling activation-space updates, and SlipGuard, a continuous tactile verification gate that fires on incipient slip. On an elasto-plastic structural shell, FORTH's closed-loop gate peaks at 29 times lower grip force than a monotone reflex ramp, preventing structural crush where the baseline leaves permanent deformation. Furthermore, FORTH matches state-of-the-art execution performance with a 97.6% average success rate across three evaluated LIBERO suites, while reducing peak activation memory by 7.12 times compared to a backpropagated step on the same backbone. Enhanced perception enables deeper physical intelligence.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略被广泛认为具备力控制能力，但其运行基于一个未经证实的假设：代理损失最小化意味着物理力接地。在本工作中，我们证明该假设在三个核心部署层面失效：冻结的视觉骨干丢弃接触几何，下游损失掩盖 token 级梯度对齐，离散指标触发优化崩溃。为解决这些脱节，我们提出 FORTH，一个仅前向的测量装置和执行框架，将每个层面的优化目标与其物理控制可观测量显式配对。FORTH 包含三个接地支柱：一个层局部、仅前向的触觉编码器，无需反向传播即可保留空间接触几何；一个 token 并行的零阶适配器，支持激活空间更新；以及 SlipGuard，一个连续触觉验证门，在初始滑移时触发。在弹塑性结构外壳上，FORTH 的闭环门峰值夹持力比单调反射斜坡低 29 倍，防止了基线会留下永久变形的结构压溃。此外，FORTH 在三个评估的 LIBERO 套件上以 97.6% 的平均成功率匹配最先进执行性能，同时与同一骨干上的反向传播步骤相比，将峰值激活内存降低 7.12 倍。增强的感知使更深的物理智能成为可能。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场以进行视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图优化底层连续体场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 (x,y,z) 与观察方向 (θ, φ)），输出是该空间位置处的体密度和与视角相关的发射辐射亮度。我们通过沿相机射线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示唯一需要的输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何结构和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Xist deletion in T cells protects against influenza-induced lung injury
items.title_zh: T 细胞中 Xist 缺失可防止流感诱导的肺损伤
items.abstract_en: Sex differences in antiviral immunity are well established, yet the contribution of X-Chromosome Inactivation (XCI) to T cell responses during infection is unknown. Here, we identify an unexpected role for Xist RNA in shaping T cell immunity and pulmonary injury following influenza infection. We show that the inactive X chromosome (Xi) in pulmonary CD4+ and CD8+ T cells undergoes dynamic epigenetic remodeling, with limited Xist RNA localization, differential enrichment of H3K27me3 and H2AK119Ub modifications, and activation-dependent XCI escape of immune-related genes, including Il2rg and Cxcr3. Remarkably, T cell-specific Xist deletion protects female mice from influenza-induced weight loss and pulmonary pathology despite comparable early viral burdens. Transcriptomic profiling reveals increased expression of X-linked escape genes and antiviral and interferon-responsive genes, particularly in CD8+ T cells. Furthermore, Xist-deficient CD4+ and CD8+ antigen-experienced (CD44+CD11a+) T cells exhibit increased biallelic Cxcr3 expression, elevated pulmonary Cxcr3 protein levels, and enhanced IFN-{gamma} and TNF responses following ex vivo stimulation. Together, our findings reveal a previously unrecognized role for Xist RNA in regulating female antiviral T cell responses and demonstrate that enhanced T cell effector potential can accompany reduced infection-associated pulmonary injury.
items.abstract_zh: 抗病毒免疫中的性别差异已被充分确立，但 X 染色体失活（XCI）对感染期间 T 细胞反应的贡献尚不清楚。在这里，我们发现 Xist RNA 在塑造流感感染后的 T 细胞免疫和肺损伤中具有意想不到的作用。我们表明，肺部 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞中的失活 X 染色体（Xi）经历动态表观遗传重塑，表现为有限的 Xist RNA 定位、H3K27me3 和 H2AK119Ub 修饰的差异富集，以及免疫相关基因（包括 Il2rg 和 Cxcr3）的激活依赖性 XCI 逃逸。值得注意的是，T 细胞特异性 Xist 缺失可保护雌性小鼠免受流感诱导的体重减轻和肺部病理，尽管早期病毒载量相当。转录组分析揭示，X 连锁逃逸基因以及抗病毒和干扰素响应基因的表达增加，尤其是在 CD8+ T 细胞中。此外，Xist 缺陷的 CD4+ 和 CD8+ 抗原经验（CD44+CD11a+）T 细胞表现出双等位基因 Cxcr3 表达增加、肺部 Cxcr3 蛋白水平升高，以及离体刺激后增强的 IFN-{gamma} 和 TNF 反应。总之，我们的发现揭示了 Xist RNA 在调节雌性抗病毒 T 细胞反应中此前未被认识的作用，并证明增强的 T 细胞效应潜力可伴随感染相关肺损伤的减轻。

items.title_en: Full-chip constrained quantum annealing via self-calibrating spin-susceptibility control
items.title_zh: 基于自校准自旋磁化率控制的全芯片约束量子退火
items.abstract_en: Discrete optimization in finance, power grids, and logistics requires minimizing Ising Hamiltonians under coupled linear constraints. However, quadratic-penalty formulations generate dense cliques that exhaust the minor-embedding capacity of sparse superconducting processors at 128-176 spins, and first-order dual subgradient schemes diverge or stall under constraint coupling. Accordingly, this study proposes a closed-loop primal-dual scheme, designated as Self-Calibrating Quantum Susceptibility Quasi-Newton (SelfCal-QSQN), in which linear constraints are encoded in longitudinal fields and dual curvature is reconstructed from single-shot spin-fluctuation covariances. This scheme requires no penalty couplers, slack qubits, or perturbation queries. Evaluated over 891 runs on D-Wave Advantage (5,612 qubits) and Advantage2 (4,560 qubits), SelfCal-QSQN achieves 83.3% full-chip exact feasibility, reduces high-constraint error by 6.1-20.1-fold over $K$-scaled first-order updates (138.4-323.3-fold over fixed-gain curvature), outperforms time-matched mixed-integer programming at 256 spins, and attains 95.0%-96.7% feasibility on non-native and inequality benchmarks. Moreover, the scheme is robust toward shot noise and freeze-out drift.
items.abstract_zh: 金融、电网和物流中的离散优化需要在耦合线性约束下最小化 Ising 哈密顿量。然而，二次惩罚公式会产生稠密团，在 128–176 个自旋时耗尽稀疏超导处理器的次嵌入容量，而一阶对偶次梯度方案在约束耦合下发散或停滞。因此，本研究提出一种闭环原始-对偶方案，称为自校准量子磁化率拟牛顿（SelfCal-QSQN），其中线性约束编码于纵向场，对偶曲率由单次自旋涨落协方差重建。该方案无需惩罚耦合器、松弛量子比特或扰动查询。在 D-Wave Advantage（5,612 个量子比特）和 Advantage2（4,560 个量子比特）上的 891 次运行评估中，SelfCal-QSQN 实现 83.3% 的全芯片精确可行性，相比 $K$-缩放的一阶更新将高约束误差降低 6.1–20.1 倍（相比固定增益曲率降低 138.4–323.3 倍），在 256 个自旋时优于时间匹配的混合整数规划，并在非原生与不等式基准上达到 95.0%–96.7% 的可行性。此外，该方案对散粒噪声和冻结漂移具有鲁棒性。

items.title_en: Passivity Correction of the Thermistor Model in Bolometric Power Sensors and Its Dependence on Bead Temperature
items.title_zh: 辐射热功率传感器中热敏电阻模型的无源性校正及其对珠温的依赖性
items.abstract_en: This paper closes a series of works on thermistor bolometric power sensors, coaxial and waveguide, by treating what the two have in common. The per-state transformation m introduced in the waveguide work, which corrects the thermistor impedances of the model in each bridge state so that the two-port of the mount is passive, is analyzed on the eleven sensors of the preceding papers: the corrections are a few tenths of a percent in the coaxial mounts and one to two percent in the waveguide mounts, follow one pattern within each family, and the hottest state is the one whose efficiency departs most from the others. The transformation is tested by an independent measurement: the substituted powers of the three states, read with the manufacturer's procedure against a leveled source whose reflection is obtained from the closure of three Apollonius circles, give efficiency ratios of 0.999 +/- 0.016 and 0.997 +/- 0.008 (k = 2), which contain the values at the passivity floor (0.996, 0.998) and exclude those of the first pass (0.941, 1.023). Three sensors were swept in the bridge resistance, 23 and 31 states, and a fourth is treated apart: the correction reduces to one constant per state, the parallel resistance of the bead, represented by a law with one term scaling with the bridge resistance and one exponential in the bead temperature, with one thermal coefficient per family. The same property explains why the cross-ratio of four measured reflection coefficients, invariant under any state-independent two-port, departs from that of the four bridge resistances.
items.abstract_zh: 本文通过处理同轴与波导两类热敏电阻测辐射热功率传感器的共同点，为这一系列工作作结。波导工作中引入的逐状态变换 m 用于校正每个桥状态下模型的热敏电阻阻抗，使安装座的二端口无源；本文在前述论文的 11 个传感器上分析了该变换：同轴安装座中的校正为百分之零点几，波导安装座中为 1%–2%，在每个系列内遵循同一模式，且最热状态是效率偏离其他状态最大的状态。该变换通过独立测量进行检验：按照制造商程序，相对于一个经三个阿波罗尼奥斯圆闭合得到其反射的稳幅源，读取三个状态的替代功率，得到效率比 0.999 ± 0.016 和 0.997 ± 0.008（k = 2），这些区间包含无源性下限值（0.996, 0.998），并排除首轮值（0.941, 1.023）。对三个传感器进行了桥电阻扫描（分别为 23 和 31 个状态），第四个传感器单独处理：校正简化为每个状态一个常数，即珠体的并联电阻，由一项随桥电阻缩放、另一项为珠温指数的规律表示，每个系列有一个热系数。同一性质解释了为何四个实测反射系数的交比（在任何状态无关二端口下不变）会偏离四个桥电阻的交比。

items.title_en: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
items.title_zh: AutoMaster：通过使同一模型成为更好的教师实现自主后训练
items.abstract_en: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a student model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B student models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
items.abstract_zh: 仅凭任务成功并不能确定后训练应强化哪些行为。即使是成功的教师轨迹也可能包含无依据的假设、无效重复或表面化验证。我们提出 Skill-FT（Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning），它使用自然语言技能在教师 rollout 期间抑制不良习惯并引出代表性不足的有效行为，然后在所得轨迹上微调目标模型。我们提出 AutoMaster，一种自主后训练系统，其中 LLM 智能体通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及来自 rollout 和目标模型评估的反馈来开发这些干预。在使用 4B 和 9B 目标模型的 Terminal、Search 和软件工程任务中，在教师、任务池、训练集规模和 SFT 配方保持固定的情况下，AutoMaster 相较于在成功的无引导教师轨迹上进行 Vanilla SFT，将平均性能提高 1.42–8.99 个百分点。结合消融和轨迹分析，这些结果表明行为塑造可以使固定模型成为更有效的教师。我们进一步发现，在所有六种设置中，SFT 期间保留技能指令比移除它们获得更高的平均性能，尽管评估时这些指令不存在且监督输出相同。这些发现表明，将技能上下文保留为训练示范的一部分可以支持更好的行为内化。

items.title_en: GNetSS: Towards Learning GNSS Corrections without Ground Truth
items.title_zh: GNetSS：迈向无需真值学习 GNSS 校正
items.abstract_en: We present GNetSS, a self-supervised GNSS position correction framework that improves the robustness of single point positioning (SPP) without requiring ground-truth locations for training. GNetSS combines a transformer-based network with a deterministic differentiable positioning solver. The network predicts satellite-wise pseudorange corrections by modelling inter-satellite geometry and temporal context, while the solver converts these corrected measurements into receiver position corrections under GNSS geometry and optional motion constraints. Unlike supervised GNSS correction methods that rely on ground-truth, GNetSS derives its training signal directly from GNSS measurement consistency. Experimental results show that GNetSS improves robustness across open-sky, urban, and forested environments. The method is particularly effective at suppressing large-error outliers, reducing the maximum 3D positioning error by over 50% compared with SPP. These results demonstrate the potential of self-supervised pseudorange correction for scalable and robust GNSS positioning in real-world autonomy applications. Code and the in-house dataset will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 GNetSS，一种自监督 GNSS 位置校正框架，可在无需真值位置用于训练的情况下提高单点定位（SPP）的鲁棒性。GNetSS 将基于 transformer 的网络与确定性可微定位求解器相结合。该网络通过建模卫星间几何关系和时间上下文来预测逐卫星伪距校正，而求解器在 GNSS 几何和可选运动约束下将这些校正后的测量转换为接收机位置校正。与依赖真值的监督式 GNSS 校正方法不同，GNetSS 直接从 GNSS 测量一致性中获取训练信号。实验结果表明，GNetSS 在开阔天空、城市和森林环境中均提升了鲁棒性。该方法在抑制大误差离群值方面尤其有效，与 SPP 相比将最大三维定位误差降低超过 50%。这些结果展示了自监督伪距校正在真实世界自主应用中实现可扩展且鲁棒 GNSS 定位的潜力。代码和内部数据集将在录用后发布。

items.title_en: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.title_zh: 扩散 Transformer 中的强化学习后训练是激活引导
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练大幅提升扩散 Transformer 的视觉质量、文本渲染和组合准确性。由于渲染所要求的文本或组合多个对象等能力本质上依赖于提示，一个自然的假设是：改进这些能力需要学习复杂的、依赖输入的变换。为分离一个与输入无关的偏移能解释多少上述增益，我们用一种刻意简单的参数化来探测每个经 RL 调优的模型：一组固定的引导向量，加到冻结基座模型的模块输出上。在 SD3.5-M 上，这些向量的参数量比 RL 调优的 LoRA 少 65 倍（0.29M 对 18.8M）。我们拟合这些向量，使其匹配公开 RL 调优检查点的速度预测，目标函数中不含奖励。尽管这些向量对每个提示、token 和采样种子都相同，它们恢复了六个 RL 调优图像模型 90.0–96.3% 的奖励增益，并在两个 RL 调优视频模型上分别达到 89.8% 和 111.9%。以零初始化并用在线 RL 训练时，仅这些向量就在 SD3.5-M 的文本渲染（OCR）和人类偏好（PickScore）上超过基于权重的 RL 的奖励增益。因此，一个恒定偏移足以解释策略梯度 RL 后训练的大部分增益：无需新的依赖输入的变换，它就把预训练生成器引导向其已经能够计算的内容。

items.title_en: EPIC2: integrating single-cell chromatin accessibility with human genetics to identify trait-relevant cell types
items.title_zh: EPIC2：整合单细胞染色质可及性与人类遗传学以识别与性状相关的细胞类型
items.abstract_en: Summary: EPIC2 is a computational and statistical framework for prioritizing trait-relevant cellular contexts by integrating genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics with single-cell chromatin accessibility data. It accounts for linkage disequilibrium when testing for association between GWAS association strength and cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility at both SNP and regulatory-peak resolutions. The resulting P-values are combined using the Cauchy combination test. Availability and Implementation: The core workflow is implemented in R, with source code, vignettes, and reproducible test data freely available at https://github.com/LingxuanZ/EPIC2. Supplementary Information: Supplementary material accompanies this preprint.
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：EPIC2是一个计算与统计框架，通过整合全基因组关联研究（GWAS）汇总统计量与单细胞染色质可及性数据，对与性状相关的细胞背景进行优先排序。它在SNP和调控峰两种分辨率上检验GWAS关联强度与细胞类型特异性染色质可及性之间的关联时，考虑连锁不平衡。所得P值使用柯西组合检验进行合并。可用性与实现：核心工作流以R实现，源代码、vignettes和可复现测试数据可在 https://github.com/LingxuanZ/EPIC2 免费获取。补充信息：本预印本附有补充材料。

items.title_en: Monolithic ultraviolet-to- near infrared photodetection enabled by an aluminium oxide photonic platform
items.title_zh: 氧化铝光子平台实现的单片紫外至近红外光电探测
items.abstract_en: Broadband photonic integrated circuits require waveguide platforms that combine low optical loss across a wide spectral range with integrated photodetection. Here we demonstrate a monolithically integrated atomic-layer-deposited (ALD) aluminium oxide (Al$_2$O$_3$)-on-silicon platform enabling waveguide-coupled photodetection from the ultraviolet to the near-infrared. The architecture employs evanescent coupling between low-loss Al$_2$O$_3$ waveguides and silicon p-i-n photodiodes. The platform supports photodetection at 375, 658 and 780 nm, extending integrated silicon photodetection into the ultraviolet. The devices exhibit linear photocurrent scaling with optical power, dark currents of approximately 2 pA at 50 V reverse bias and nanosecond-scale temporal response. We further demonstrate centimetre-scale ultraviolet Mach-Zehnder interferometer circuits with integrated photodiodes. The same detector architecture is implemented with Si$_3$N$_4$ waveguides, whereas the lower ultraviolet propagation loss of Al$_2$O$_3$ enables an approximately 15-fold higher photodetection response at 375 nm. These results establish ALD Al$_2$O$_3$ as a broadband integrated photonics platform for sensing, spectroscopy and quantum technologies.
items.abstract_zh: 宽带光子集成电路需要能在宽光谱范围内兼具低光损耗与集成光电探测的波导平台。本文展示了一种单片集成的原子层沉积（ALD）氧化铝（Al$_2$O$_3$）-硅平台，可实现从紫外到近红外的波导耦合光电探测。该架构采用低损耗 Al$_2$O$_3$ 波导与硅 p-i-n 光电二极管之间的倏逝耦合。该平台支持 375、658 和 780 nm 的光电探测，将集成硅光电探测扩展到紫外。器件表现出光电流随光功率线性缩放、50 V 反偏下约 2 pA 的暗电流以及纳秒级时间响应。我们进一步展示了带有集成光电二极管的厘米级紫外马赫-曾德尔干涉仪电路。同一探测器架构也用 Si$_3$N$_4$ 波导实现，而 Al$_2$O$_3$ 更低的紫外传播损耗使 375 nm 处的光电探测响应提高约 15 倍。这些结果确立了 ALD Al$_2$O$_3$ 作为用于传感、光谱学和量子技术的宽带集成光子学平台。

items.title_en: Geometrical Estimation of Electromagnetic Degrees of Freedom in Reflecting Environments
items.title_zh: 反射环境中电磁自由度的几何估计
items.abstract_en: The number of spatial degrees of freedom (NDoF) of electromagnetic communication channels in reflecting environments is investigated using a full-vector formulation based on dyadic Green's functions and equivalent electric and magnetic surface currents. The channel correlation eigenproblem characterizes the electromagnetic communication modes and their coupling strengths, while the leading-order NDoF is estimated geometrically from the receiver-accessible phase space volume in the electrically large regime. By combining two geometrical projection Jacobians, the phase space volume is related to the mutual shadow area, establishing the equivalence between the two geometrical NDoF formulations and yielding a two-polarization estimate equal to twice the mutual shadow area divided by the squared wavelength. The free-space mutual shadow formulation is extended to perfect electric conductor (PEC) reflecting environments through image construction and phase space ray tracing, accounting for specular reflections and geometrical visibility constraints. The formulation is validated against the eigenvalue spectra of full-vector electromagnetic channels involving planar PEC reflectors, a parabolic reflector, a parallel-plate waveguide, and a non-line-of-sight L-shaped corridor. The geometrical predictions agree with the observed spectral transitions across configurations involving multiple reflections, focusing, and blockage.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究反射环境中电磁通信信道的空间自由度数目（NDoF），采用基于并矢格林函数及等效电磁表面电流的全矢量公式。信道相关特征值问题刻画电磁通信模式及其耦合强度，而在电大区，主导阶 NDoF 由接收方可及的相空间体积进行几何估计。通过组合两个几何投影雅可比，将相空间体积与互阴影面积相关联，建立两种几何 NDoF 公式之间的等价性，并给出等于两倍互阴影面积除以波长平方的双极化估计。自由空间互阴影公式通过镜像构造和相空间射线追踪扩展到理想电导体（PEC）反射环境，考虑镜面反射和几何可见性约束。该公式针对涉及平面 PEC 反射器、抛物面反射器、平行板波导和非视距 L 形走廊的全矢量电磁信道特征值谱进行了验证。几何预测与在涉及多次反射、聚焦和遮挡的配置中观测到的谱转变一致。

items.title_en: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
items.title_zh: AltRA-Test：一种无需共享标注者的 LLM 评判器替代标注者检验
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task. Since replacement is not always justified, we encourage researchers to test it for their task.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作评判器和评分器以替代人类标注者，这引出了何时这种替代在统计上合理的问题。为支持此类决策，替代标注者检验（Alt-Test）被提出用于所有条目均由同一批标注者标注的密集设置。然而，在许多大规模标注设置中，条目由不同的标注者子集标注。因此，我们提出带重采样标注的替代标注者检验（AltRA-Test），一种不要求所有条目均由同一批标注者标注的统计检验。AltRA-Test 使用对条目进行重采样的 bootstrap：为每个条目抽取 k 个人类标注，并用一个 LLM 标注替换其中一个。这产生配对的全人类面板和人类-LLM 混合面板。当混合面板的标注者间一致性（IAA）在统计上非劣于全人类面板的 IAA 时，即当 LLM 保留了人类标注者共享的信号时，支持替代。我们证明 AltRA-Test 是渐近水平为 alpha 的一致检验。随后我们通过仿真和真实世界实验评估它，在文本、图像、音频和视频的 20 个数据集上测试 18 个 LLM 和 5 种提示技术。在这些评估中，约 100 个条目通常足以进行该检验。在已知 LLM 是比人类更好还是更差标注者的仿真中，AltRA-Test 比现有基线做出更多正确的替代决策。在真实数据实验中，LLM 在约一半的设置中通过检验，主要取决于任务。由于替代并不总是合理，我们鼓励研究者针对其任务进行检验。
