items.title_en: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
items.title_zh: 结合环内几何前馈模型、面向稠密度量建图的立体视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种立体视觉里程计（SVO）框架，将用于稠密深度预测的几何前馈模型（GFM）与基于因子图的视觉里程计相结合，以实现准确定位和稠密度量建图。我们的核心思想是利用从立体和时间多视图观测中估计的稀疏但可靠的度量几何来校准 GFM 的稠密预测，同时保留基于模型的 SVO 的鲁棒性和效率。不是直接用可能含噪的立体深度为 GFM 提供条件，而是使用优化后的 3D 地标联合估计每个局部子图内所有关键帧上的尺度-平移变换，从而产生度量一致的稠密深度预测。为平衡准确性和计算效率，我们引入分层因子图架构。在局部层面，滑动窗口优化估计高频相机位姿和多视图细化的 3D 地标。稠密预测仅对选定的关键帧生成，并使用 SE(3) 广义 ICP 在每个子图内进行配准。连续子图进一步利用其共享几何在 Sim(3) 中对齐，从而允许校正残余的尺度不一致。这些子图内和子图间约束被纳入全局因子图，以产生一致的轨迹和稠密度量重建。在公开和自建数据集上的大量实验表明，所提框架相对于几何和基于学习的基线取得了有竞争力的里程计精度，同时提供准确的稠密度量重建，并提高了对学习深度预测失败的鲁棒性。

items.title_en: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
items.title_zh: 指令条件下的流程视频在线错误检测
items.abstract_en: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detectors do not use the instruction text, while instruction-conditioned methods operate offline. In this paper, we study online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric videos. Using only observed video, task instructions, and prior predictions, our model identifies and localizes completed action attempts and classifies them as correct, modified, slip, corrections, or additions; omitted steps are determined after the video ends. We compare a modular pipeline, with separate step identification, temporal localization, and execution verification, to a joint model that predicts all outputs in a single step. To support supervised learning from mistakes, we repartition EgoPER to include erroneous videos in all splits. The approaches achieve similar step-segmentation F1@0.5 (93.6% and 92.1%), while the joint model achieves higher binary mistake-detection F1@0.5 (84.1% vs. 80.7%), with its largest gain on slips (56.4% vs. 37.5%). Component-level analysis suggests that error propagation between stages contributes to the modular approach's lower detection score. On test videos containing mistakes, both designs outperform released AEM and ESTANet checkpoints under our evaluation protocol.
items.abstract_zh: 监测人员执行流程的助手在仍有时间纠正时检测到错误最为有用。这需要在视频展开过程中依据任务指令判断动作，识别所尝试的步骤，在时间上定位它，并评估其执行情况。现有的在线检测器不使用指令文本，而以指令为条件的方法以离线方式运行。在本文中，我们研究第一人称视频中的在线、以指令为条件的错误检测。仅使用观测到的视频、任务指令和先前的预测，我们的模型识别并定位已完成的动作尝试，并将其分类为正确、修改、失误、纠正或添加；遗漏步骤在视频结束后确定。我们将具有独立的步骤识别、时间定位和执行验证的模块化流水线与在单一步骤中预测所有输出的联合模型进行比较。为支持从错误中进行监督学习，我们重新划分 EgoPER，使所有划分中都包含错误视频。这些方法取得相似的步骤分割 F1@0.5（93.6% 和 92.1%），而联合模型取得更高的二值错误检测 F1@0.5（84.1% 对 80.7%），其在失误上的提升最大（56.4% 对 37.5%）。组件级分析表明，阶段之间的误差传播导致模块化方法的检测分数较低。在包含错误的测试视频上，两种设计在我们的评估协议下均优于已发布的 AEM 和 ESTANet 检查点。

items.title_en: Bryostatin-1 exploits a developmental signaling vulnerability in MEF2D-rearranged B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia
items.title_zh: Bryostatin-1 利用 MEF2D 重排 B 细胞前体急性淋巴细胞白血病中的发育信号脆弱性
items.abstract_en: MEF2D-rearranged (MEF2D-r) B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (BCP-ALL) is a rare molecular subtype associated with high-risk clinical features and frequent relapse and characterized by a distinctive pre-B-cell developmental state and dependence on pre-B-cell receptor (pre-BCR) signaling. Despite these distinctive biological features, MEF2D-r BCP-ALL lacks subtype-directed therapy. Here, we identify a pharmacologically actionable vulnerability to the diacylglycerol (DAG) mimetic bryostatin-1 (Bryo-1). Across 93 BCP-ALL cell lines, MEF2D-r models were enriched for Bryo-1 sensitivity, although responses varied within the subtype and extended to selected non-MEF2D models. Sensitive cells responded at low-nanomolar concentrations with rapid ERK activation followed by loss of pre-BCR-associated components, reduced proliferation, caspase activation and cell death. Pharmacological MEK inhibition markedly attenuated Bryo-1-induced loss of viability, supporting a functional involvement of MEK-ERK signaling. Time-resolved phosphoproteomic and proteomic analyses further revealed coordinated activation of DAG-responsive signaling and subsequent remodeling of the precursor B-cell state. Bryo-1 also altered immunotherapy-relevant surface antigens, including CD19, CD20 and CD22, as part of this broader cell-state transition. Importantly, low-nanomolar activity was reproduced ex vivo in MEF2D-r patient-derived xenograft cells. Together, these findings support pharmacological activation of a negative-selection-like developmental checkpoint as a potential therapeutic strategy in responsive MEF2D-r BCP-ALL and provide a framework for biomarker-guided functional patient selection.
items.abstract_zh: MEF2D 重排（MEF2D-r）B 细胞前体急性淋巴细胞白血病（BCP-ALL）是一种罕见的分子亚型，与高风险临床特征和频繁复发相关，并以独特的前 B 细胞发育状态和对前 B 细胞受体（pre-BCR）信号的依赖为特征。尽管具有这些独特生物学特征，MEF2D-r BCP-ALL 仍缺乏亚型导向治疗。在此，我们鉴定出对二酰甘油（DAG）模拟物 bryostatin-1（Bryo-1）的一种药理学上可干预的脆弱性。在 93 个 BCP-ALL 细胞系中，MEF2D-r 模型富集于 Bryo-1 敏感性，尽管亚型内反应存在差异，并扩展至部分非 MEF2D 模型。敏感细胞在低纳摩尔浓度下即产生反应：快速 ERK 激活，随后 pre-BCR 相关组分丢失、增殖减少、caspase 激活和细胞死亡。药理学 MEK 抑制显著减弱 Bryo-1 诱导的活力丧失，支持 MEK-ERK 信号的功能性参与。时间分辨磷酸化蛋白质组学和蛋白质组学分析进一步揭示 DAG 响应信号的协同激活以及随后前体 B 细胞状态的重塑。作为这一更广泛细胞状态转变的一部分，Bryo-1 还改变了免疫治疗相关表面抗原，包括 CD19、CD20 和 CD22。重要的是，低纳摩尔活性在 MEF2D-r 患者来源异种移植细胞中于离体条件下得到重现。总之，这些发现支持将类负选择发育检查点的药理学激活作为对 Bryo-1 有反应的 MEF2D-r BCP-ALL 的潜在治疗策略，并为生物标志物指导的功能性患者选择提供了框架。

items.title_en: Gap-label bounds and optical reconstruction of Landau-subband quantum geometry
items.title_zh: 朗道子带量子几何的能隙标记界与光学重构
items.abstract_en: We derive a magnetic gap-label lower bound on the internal quantum weight of Landau subbands that remains nonzero even when the occupied Chern number vanishes. Using the second fundamental forms of nested subbundles to decompose the quantum geometric tensor, we isolate the constraint imposed by the uniform parent curvature and show that the excess quantum weight above the bound equals twice the weaker circular transition weight. For a noninteracting parabolic band with a periodic scalar potential, Landau-level mixing preserves the integrated relative curvature while the occupied direct gap remains open. Nevertheless, uncorrected sub-cyclotron absorption need not satisfy the projected bound. Using exact circular-dipole relations, we reconstruct the low-frequency guiding-centre weight and signed dichroism from circularly polarized absorption. This reconstruction removes the first-order orbit-polarization contribution. For an insulating filling of an isolated lowest-Landau-level-derived cluster, a potential-gradient estimate bounds the omitted remote-transition weight quadratically at weak coupling. This yields a finite-window lower bound on reconstructed quantum weight and bounds the deviation of reconstructed dichroism from the integrated relative curvature.
items.abstract_zh: 我们推导了朗道子带内部量子权重的磁性能隙标记下界，即使占据陈数消失，该下界仍非零。利用嵌套子丛的第二基本形式分解量子几何张量，我们分离出均匀母曲率施加的约束，并证明高于该界的过量量子权重等于较弱的圆跃迁权重的两倍。对于具有周期标量势的无相互作用抛物线能带，朗道能级混合保持积分相对曲率，同时占据的直接能隙保持打开。然而，未校正的亚回旋吸收不必满足投影界。利用精确圆偶极关系，我们从圆偏振吸收中重构低频导心权重和带符号二色性。该重构消除了轨道极化的一阶贡献。对于孤立的最低朗道能级衍生簇的绝缘填充，势梯度估计在弱耦合下以二次方式界定被省略的远端跃迁权重。这给出了重构量子权重的有限窗口下界，并界定了重构二色性偏离积分相对曲率的程度。

items.title_en: Spiking Neural Networks Incrementally Track Firing-Rate Networks
items.title_zh: 脉冲神经网络增量跟踪发放率网络
items.abstract_en: Understanding how spiking neural networks (SNNs) efficiently process data streams is key to (i) studying how biological brains conserve energy for lifelong predictions and (ii) enabling efficient continuous AI inference. In this work, we propose a theory on how an SNN incrementally tracks its corresponding firing-rate network, a continuous-valued neural network (ANN). We prove that the output of a discrete SNN continuously tracks the instantaneous ANN output implicitly determined by the SNN input. Based on this principle, we develop LIF-Stream, a conversion framework for efficient SNN inference over unbounded data streams. It enables the converted SNN to reuse its prior activation state and compute only the activation updates between frames, thereby reducing the average number of time steps needed per frame. Specifically, LIF-Stream controls the SNN to continuously track the reference ANN output, which gives a high-accuracy prediction for every frame. Evaluation on three large-scale streaming inference benchmarks with distinct modalities shows that LIF-Stream achieves the best efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to high-accuracy SNN techniques.
items.abstract_zh: 理解脉冲神经网络（SNN）如何高效处理数据流，是（i）研究生物大脑如何为终身预测节省能量以及（ii）实现高效连续 AI 推理的关键。本文提出一种关于 SNN 如何增量跟踪其对应发放率网络（一种连续值神经网络，ANN）的理论。我们证明，离散 SNN 的输出连续跟踪由 SNN 输入隐式确定的瞬时 ANN 输出。基于这一原理，我们开发了 LIF-Stream，一种用于在无界数据流上进行高效 SNN 推理的转换框架。它使转换后的 SNN 能够复用其先前的激活状态，并且仅计算帧间的激活更新，从而减少每帧所需的平均时间步数。具体而言，LIF-Stream 控制 SNN 连续跟踪参考 ANN 输出，从而为每一帧给出高精度预测。在三个具有不同模态的大规模流式推理基准上的评估表明，与高精度 SNN 技术相比，LIF-Stream 实现了最佳效率-精度权衡。

items.title_en: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: MemOnce：面向大语言模型的可扩展记忆架构
items.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.
items.abstract_zh: 在长时程与持续交互中部署大语言模型（LLM）需要为未来推理维护可复用的记忆状态，这给现有架构带来了挑战。标准Transformer会累积逐层、词元级的KV缓存，随着上下文扩展，导致GPU内存线性增长和二次计算复杂度。相比之下，线性时间架构将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，但难以保留细粒度细节。我们提出MemOnce，一种为语言模型学习可扩展记忆状态的基础架构。MemOnce基于两个核心设计：（a）记忆编码器-解码器：它仅将最后一层隐藏状态的一小部分缓存为紧凑的记忆表示，并动态将其解码回注意力层的KV缓存；（b）记忆稀疏注意力：对于每个持续输入，MemOnce自适应地检索相关记忆表示，且稀疏索引仅在跨层计算一次。将这两种设计耦合起来，可实现高效的即时记忆加载和KV缓存解码，大幅降低GPU内存占用并实现线性时间复杂度。我们进行了大量实验，表明MemOnce在不同模型规模、上下文长度和训练范式（预训练与后训练适配）下均优于Transformer和其他架构。特别是，用MemOnce适配Qwen3.5-4B后，在1M上下文下将记忆状态缓存减少1313×、预填充延迟降低6.9×，并将吞吐量提高3.5×、整体记忆性能提高+5.77%。最后，MemOnce可零样本泛化到下游表示任务，与专用模型相比取得有竞争力的结果。

items.title_en: Interactive Semi-Parametric On-Track Learning for Vehicle Dynamics in Autonomous Racing
items.title_zh: 自动驾驶赛车中车辆动力学的交互式半参数赛道学习
items.abstract_en: Autonomous racing requires an accurate vehicle dynamics model near the limits of handling, yet a mismatch between the nominal and actual dynamics inevitably remains. To reduce this mismatch, existing methods learn from on-track data, i.e., data collected while the vehicle drives on the track under racing conditions, by adapting the physical parameters of the nominal model or by learning a residual that captures the remaining mismatch. However, these on-track learning methods typically handle either the physical parameters or the residual separately, which restricts their ability to resolve the mismatch. To address this limitation, we propose an interactive semi-parametric learning framework that learns both the physical parameters and the residual under a single shared prediction-error objective. Since updating one changes the learning target of the other, they are recursively updated in turn, each guided by the other's latest update. Each update is then accepted only if it does not increase the shared objective, so that the objective is guaranteed to be non-increasing and convergent over the recursion. Numerical simulations and hardware experiments show that the proposed framework outperforms the baselines. Compared with the nominal model, it reduces the one-step prediction errors of lateral velocity and yaw rate by 90.0% and 81.6% in simulation and by 54.0% and 59.4% on hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶赛车需要接近操控极限的精确车辆动力学模型，但标称动力学与实际动力学之间不可避免地仍存在失配。为减少这种失配，现有方法从赛道数据（即在赛车条件下车辆在赛道上行驶时收集的数据）中学习，通过调整标称模型的物理参数或学习捕获剩余失配的残差来实现。然而，这些赛道学习方法通常分别处理物理参数或残差，限制了其解决失配的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种交互式半参数学习框架，在单一共享预测误差目标下同时学习物理参数和残差。由于更新其中一个会改变另一个的学习目标，它们轮流递归更新，每次更新都以另一方的最新更新为指导。每次更新仅在不增加共享目标时才被接受，从而保证目标在递归过程中非增且收敛。数值仿真和硬件实验表明，所提框架优于基线。与标称模型相比，它在仿真中将横向速度和横摆角速度的一步预测误差分别降低90.0%和81.6%，在硬件上分别降低54.0%和59.4%。

items.title_en: Non-penetrating World Models
items.title_zh: 非穿透世界模型
items.abstract_en: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究交互式视频世界模型中防止物体穿透的新问题。为了解现有模型如何处理这一问题，我们引入NoPeBench，一个评估世界模型如何响应物理障碍的基准。我们的评估显示，没有一个开源模型能够可靠地防止此类失败。然而，令人惊讶的是，这些模型已经编码了预测此类违规所需的信息。我们发现，扩散Transformer（DiT）的隐藏状态可以预测候选动作是否会穿透障碍物。在此基础上，我们引入NoPeWorld，一个检测并防止穿透的轻量级框架。具体来说，我们在冻结DiT的隐藏状态之上训练一个小型预测头，以读出候选动作是否安全。然后，不安全动作被替换为最能保留原始意图的安全动作。尽管方法简单，NoPeWorld在六个视频世界模型上平均将物理违规率从74%大幅降低至16%。值得注意的是，我们的方法展现出对开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物的零样本泛化能力。我们公开代码、NoPeBench基准和模型权重。项目页面：https://nopeworld.github.io。

items.title_en: Weberian interval discrimination and temporal pattern generalization in Drosophila
items.title_zh: 果蝇中的韦伯式间隔辨别与时间模式泛化
items.abstract_en: Recognizing temporally structured signals, from human speech and music to the songs and calls of other animals, relies on comparing the durations of their elements. In vertebrates, interval discrimination often follows Weber's law: sensitivity depends on the ratio between intervals rather than their absolute difference. Such proportional scaling may enable efficient representation of a wide range of durations and support recognition of temporal patterns despite changes in their speed. Whether insect brains use the same computational principle, and which neural circuits support flexible temporal learning, remain unclear. Here, we developed an auditory learning paradigm in which fruit flies, Drosophila melanogaster, learn to associate temporal patterns of sound with a sugar reward. Flies discriminate tone durations ranging from subsecond to a few seconds and use this information to guide reward-seeking behavior. Their discrimination depends on the ratio between durations rather than their absolute difference, consistent with Weber's law. Flies also generalize learned temporal relationships to proportionally compressed durations and transfer them from auditory to visual stimuli, indicating a flexible representation of temporal structure. Finally, blocking mushroom body output impairs temporal pattern learning but leaves auditory pitch learning intact, identifying the mushroom body as a critical neural circuit for this form of learning. Together, these findings demonstrate that ratio-based and generalizable temporal computations can be implemented in a compact, genetically tractable brain, providing insight into the evolutionary origins of temporal cognition and establishing Drosophila as a powerful system for investigating its neural basis.
items.abstract_zh: 识别时间结构信号——从人类语音和音乐到其他动物的歌声和叫声——依赖于比较其各元素的持续时间。在脊椎动物中，间隔辨别通常遵循韦伯定律：敏感性取决于间隔之间的比值，而非其绝对差。这种比例缩放可能有助于高效表示广泛的持续时间范围，并在速度变化时支持时间模式识别。昆虫大脑是否使用相同的计算原理，以及哪些神经回路支持灵活的时间学习，仍不清楚。在这里，我们开发了一种听觉学习范式，使果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）学会将声音的时间模式与糖奖励相关联。果蝇能够辨别从亚秒到几秒的音调持续时间，并利用该信息引导寻奖行为。它们的辨别取决于持续时间之间的比值而非绝对差，符合韦伯定律。果蝇还能将学习到的时间关系泛化到按比例压缩的持续时间，并将其从听觉刺激迁移到视觉刺激，表明其具有灵活的时间结构表示。最后，阻断蘑菇体输出会损害时间模式学习，但不影响听觉音高学习，从而确定蘑菇体是这一学习形式的关键神经回路。总之，这些发现表明，基于比值的可泛化时间计算可以在一个紧凑、遗传可操作的大脑中实现，为时间认知的进化起源提供了见解，并使果蝇成为研究其神经基础的有力系统。

items.title_en: Galvanometer Mirror Based Femtosecond-Laser Volumetric Displays
items.title_zh: 基于振镜的飞秒激光体显示
items.abstract_en: Femtosecond-laser-induced plasma enables self-emissive voxels to be generated directly in air for drawing three-dimensional images. Galvanometer-mirror-based beam scanning provides a method for rapidly moving plasma voxels using a relatively simple optical configuration. However, the generated plasma voxels are not ideal points but luminous regions with finite lengths and widths. Variations in voxel shape and orientation caused by focusing and scanning conditions may therefore affect the appearance of rendered points and lines. Nevertheless, quantitative relationships between focusing and scanning conditions and plasma-voxel geometry remain insufficiently characterized in systems using a two-axis galvanometer mirror and a single focusing lens. Here, we quantitatively investigate how focal length and two-axis galvanometer scan angle affect the shape of plasma voxels and the projected inclination of their principal axes. For focal lengths ranging from 75 to 300 mm, the mean plasma length increased from 1.39 to 4.64 mm. These results indicate that increasing the focal length produces more elongated and anisotropic plasma voxels. The projected inclination of the plasma principal axis varied approximately linearly with the corresponding scan angle, although the response differed between the two scanning axes. These results provide quantitative design data for selecting focusing conditions and correcting voxel shape and orientation according to scanning conditions in galvanometer-mirror-based aerial volumetric displays.
items.abstract_zh: 飞秒激光诱导等离子体能够直接在空气中生成自发光体素，以绘制三维图像。基于振镜的光束扫描提供了一种利用相对简单光学配置快速移动等离子体体素的方法。然而，生成的等离子体体素并非理想点，而是具有有限长度和宽度的发光区域。因此，由聚焦和扫描条件引起的体素形状和取向变化可能影响所渲染点和线的外观。尽管如此，在使用两轴振镜和单个聚焦透镜的系统中，聚焦与扫描条件和等离子体体素几何形状之间的定量关系仍未得到充分表征。在此，我们定量研究了焦距和两轴振镜扫描角如何影响等离子体体素的形状及其主轴的投影倾角。对于75至300 mm的焦距，平均等离子体长度从1.39 mm增加到4.64 mm。这些结果表明，增加焦距会产生更细长且各向异性的等离子体体素。等离子体主轴的投影倾角随相应扫描角近似线性变化，尽管两个扫描轴之间的响应不同。这些结果为在基于振镜的空中体显示中选择聚焦条件以及根据扫描条件校正体素形状和取向提供了定量设计数据。

items.title_en: PepDeTech: Anonymous Occupancy Monitoring on a Battery-Powered 2.3k-Zone dToF LiDAR Node with On-Chip Processing and Bluetooth LE Reporting
items.title_zh: PepDeTech：基于电池供电的2.3k区dToF LiDAR节点、具备片上处理与蓝牙低功耗上报的匿名占用监测
items.abstract_en: As populations grow, society is increasingly required to shift towards systems of shared resources, which allow space, energy and time to be optimised. Facilitating this transition depends on data: how many people are present, when and where. From such information, schedules can be organised more efficiently and resources allocated where they matter. At the same time, privacy concerns and energy consumption limit deployment: cameras are frequently unacceptable, while simpler sensors miss people and cannot provide the full picture. This paper presents PepDeTech, a compact, battery-powered occupancy node that combines a 54 x 42-zone direct Time-of-Flight (dToF) Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) (VL53L9CX) with a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) System on Chip (SoC). Three deterministic algorithms, background subtraction, motion history and a track lifecycle, run on-chip and count the people simultaneously, providing real-time occupancy monitoring. No trained model is involved, and setup takes less than a minute. Over three scenarios, background subtraction reaches a per-frame +-1-person accuracy of 83.6 % (mean absolute error (MAE) 0.70 persons), tested with up to five people present. At a 30 s interval the node draws only 3.1 mW, lasting 60 d on a 1200 mA h cell. Several weeks of deployment on a single charge make the node usable as a survey instrument for facility management: a room can be characterised for a measurement campaign without cabling, network provisioning or a camera, and the resulting occupancy record is what ventilation, lighting, cleaning and space-allocation decisions are argued from, ultimately resulting in more efficient resource allocation.
items.abstract_zh: 随着人口增长，社会越来越需要转向共享资源系统，以优化空间、能源和时间。促进这一转变取决于数据：有多少人在场、何时在场以及在哪里。基于此类信息，可以更高效地组织日程，并将资源分配到重要之处。与此同时，隐私问题和能耗限制了部署：摄像头常常不可接受，而更简单的传感器会漏检人员，无法提供完整情况。本文提出PepDeTech，一种紧凑的电池供电占用节点，将54×42区直接飞行时间（dToF）激光雷达（LiDAR）（VL53L9CX）与蓝牙低功耗（BLE）片上系统（SoC）相结合。三种确定性算法——背景减除、运动历史和轨迹生命周期——在片上运行并同时计数人员，提供实时占用监测。不涉及训练模型，设置耗时不到一分钟。在三种场景中，背景减除在最多五人同时在场测试时达到每帧±1人准确率83.6%（平均绝对误差（MAE）0.70人）。在30 s间隔下，该节点仅消耗3.1 mW，在1200 mA h电池上可持续60 d。单次充电可部署数周，使该节点可用作设施管理的调查仪器：无需布线、网络配置或摄像头，即可为测量活动表征一个房间，而所得的占用记录可用于论证通风、照明、清洁和空间分配决策，最终实现更高效的资源分配。

items.title_en: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
items.title_zh: 重复的批评：大语言模型时代同行评审在主张层面的同质化
items.abstract_en: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.
items.abstract_zh: 同行评审依赖于多位审稿人发现不同的问题。我们测量会议和期刊评审中的批评重叠度。在ICLR，来自评审流程同一阶段的评审中，测得的重叠度从2026年的12.0%上升到2027年的21.3%，NeurIPS、ICML以及F1000和PLOS期刊也出现同比上升。2027年，一篇论文的第三篇ICLR评审相较另外两篇增加了5.46个新问题，而2026年为6.12个。我们将LLM生成文本检测器MELD应用于所有评审。在一篇论文内，被MELD标记的两篇评审比两篇未被标记的评审重叠更多：2024-2025年ICLR高3.0个百分点，2026-2027年高4.5个百分点，五个期刊来源中高5.4个百分点。这些结果提供证据表明，同一篇论文中被LLM标记的评审彼此之间不如未被标记的评审那样有区分度，并提示单篇论文各评审之间批评的多样性正在下降。

items.title_en: Generalist Action Critic: Harnessing Frontier Models in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: Generalist Action Critic：在自动驾驶中利用前沿模型
items.abstract_en: Frontier models have demonstrated remarkable general-purpose reasoning capabilities, opening new possibilities for intelligent decision making in the physical world. In autonomous driving, many recent approaches seek to leverage these capabilities through additional adaptation for action output, particularly in scenarios where existing models underperform. We introduce Generalist Action Critic (GAC), a zero-shot framework that combines frontier models' general-purpose reasoning with the planning competence of specialized driving models through an inference-time harness. In GAC, specialized planners generate multiple candidate trajectories and make an initial selection, while a frozen frontier model serves as an action critic that assesses the selected trajectory against scene evidence and either retains it or reselects from the available candidates. The harness combines camera images with spatial overlays, provides driving context and reasoning principles through textual instructions, and regulates the information available at each stage to support trajectory assessment and reselection. On HUGSIM, GAC raises DrivoR's HD-Score to 43.2, achieving state-of-the-art performance among methods trained without additional simulation data. GAC also consistently improves closed-loop driving safety across three planners, with relative HD-Score gains of up to 32.1%. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 further reveal how GAC improves planning performance by correcting up to 52.13% of eligible unsafe trajectory selections while introducing new failures in only 0.67% of originally high-quality selections. These results demonstrate the potential of harnessing frontier models to improve driving safety through inference-time cooperation with specialized planners.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿模型已展现出卓越的通用推理能力，为物理世界中的智能决策开辟了新可能。在自动驾驶中，许多近期方法试图通过对动作输出进行额外适配来利用这些能力，尤其是在现有模型表现不佳的场景中。我们提出 Generalist Action Critic（GAC），一个零样本框架，通过推理时框架将前沿模型的通用推理与专用驾驶模型的规划能力相结合。在 GAC 中，专用规划器生成多个候选轨迹并做出初始选择，而一个冻结的前沿模型充当动作评论器，根据场景证据评估所选轨迹，并保留该轨迹或从可用候选中重新选择。该框架将相机图像与空间叠加层结合，通过文本指令提供驾驶上下文和推理原则，并调节每个阶段可用的信息，以支持轨迹评估和重新选择。在 HUGSIM 上，GAC 将 DrivoR 的 HD-Score 提升到 43.2，在未使用额外仿真数据训练的方法中达到最先进性能。GAC 还在三个规划器上持续提升闭环驾驶安全性，相对 HD-Score 增益最高达 32.1%。在 NAVSIM v1 上的实验进一步揭示，GAC 通过纠正最多 52.13% 的符合条件的不安全轨迹选择来提升规划性能，同时仅在 0.67% 的原始高质量选择中引入新的失败。这些结果展示了利用前沿模型通过与专用规划器在推理时协作来提升驾驶安全的潜力。

items.title_en: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
items.title_zh: 为LLM驱动的权重空间编程训练视觉模型
items.abstract_en: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with label smoothing, gradient-based editable training, and our Edit-Ready Training (ERT), a novel method that rehearses the direct, closed-form weight edits LLMs perform. We show that preparing networks for editing raises the success of LLM edits substantially where standard networks are hard to edit. ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines. We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores. Project page: https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp
items.abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，在某些设置下，大语言模型可以执行权重空间编程，直接修改神经网络的权重。然而，尚不清楚对这些网络进行专门训练如何能促进权重空间编程的成功。我们提出了一个在视觉模型上进行LLM驱动权重空间编程的基准，其中五个LLM在Waterbirds、CIFAR-100、PACS和Entity-30上的重标记和纠错任务中编辑卷积网络和视觉Transformer。我们报告了超过2,600次此类编辑过程，其中每次编辑都在留出图像上就成功性、副作用和准确率损失进行评分。我们比较了标准训练、标签平滑、基于梯度的可编辑训练，以及我们的Edit-Ready Training（ERT），这是一种新方法，会排练LLM执行的直接、闭式权重编辑。我们表明，在标准网络难以编辑的情况下，为编辑准备网络大幅提高了LLM编辑的成功率。在所有评估的基线中，ERT还为GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5取得了最高的平均分。我们将发布我们的LLM测试框架以及所有任务、编辑轨迹和分数。项目页面：https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为视觉与成像，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Millimeter-Scale Malignant Territories and Immune Exclusion patterns in Human Salivary Gland Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 高分辨率空间转录组学揭示人涎腺腺样囊性癌中的毫米级恶性区域和免疫排斥模式
items.abstract_en: Background/Objectives: Adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC) of the salivary gland (SGACC) is a rare malignancy with frequent late recurrence and limited response to systemic and immune therapies. Bulk and single-cell sequencing do not preserve tissue architecture, so the spatial organization of its MYB-driven myoepithelial and luminal tumor cells, stroma, and immune cells remains poorly defined. This study aimed to map the SGACC tumor microenvironment at near-cellular resolution. Methods: Visium HD based spatial transcriptomics was performed on four SGACC tissue sections from three patients with tubulo-cribriform tumor form in stage III - IV. Bins of 10 x 10 {micro}m were annotated and deconvolved with cell2location using an integrated single-cell reference of 119,189 cells from 20 donors. Pseudobulk differential expression, spatial autocorrelation, potency and spatial trajectory inference, permutation-based territory analysis, Hotspot module detection, and marker-based immune profiling were applied. Results: MYB-expressing luminal (LECs-MYB) and myoepithelial (MECs-MYB) epithelial cells occupied 55.7% of bins on average. The MECs-MYB to LECs-MYB ratio increased from the nest interior toward the tumor edge, where cancer-associated fibroblasts rose sharply. Potency and trajectory analyses placed MECs-MYB upstream of LECs-MYB. Malignant states formed territories of up to 38.0 mm2 that persisted over 1.5 mm in three sections and contained spatially restricted programs. Hypoxic stressed territories also showed mTORC1, unfolded protein response, and cell-cycle programs. T/NK, myeloid, MHC class I and II, and plasma cell signatures were 1.4- to 5.7-fold higher in stroma than in tumor nests, whereas VTCN1 (B7-H4) was the only B7 family ligand enriched within nests. Conclusions: SGACC shows an ordered arrangement of malignant lineages, millimeter-scale malignant territories, MHC class - I and II enriched stroma, and immune-excluded nests enriched for B7-H4. These features provide evidence to be validated in larger cohorts with protein-level and clinical data.
items.abstract_zh: 背景/目的：涎腺腺样囊性癌（SGACC）是一种罕见恶性肿瘤，常出现晚期复发，对全身治疗和免疫治疗反应有限。批量测序和单细胞测序不保留组织结构，因此其由 MYB 驱动的肌上皮和腔面肿瘤细胞、基质及免疫细胞的空间组织仍定义不清。本研究旨在以接近细胞的分辨率绘制 SGACC 肿瘤微环境。方法：对来自三名 III–IV 期管状-筛状肿瘤型患者的四份 SGACC 组织切片进行基于 Visium HD 的空间转录组学。对 10 x 10 μm 的 bin 进行注释，并使用来自 20 名供者的 119,189 个细胞的整合单细胞参考，通过 cell2location 进行解卷积。应用了伪批量差异表达、空间自相关、潜能与空间轨迹推断、基于置换的区域分析、Hotspot 模块检测以及基于标志物的免疫分析。结果：表达 MYB 的腔面上皮细胞（LECs-MYB）和肌上皮上皮细胞（MECs-MYB）平均占据 55.7% 的 bin。MECs-MYB 与 LECs-MYB 的比例从巢内部向肿瘤边缘增加，在肿瘤边缘癌症相关成纤维细胞急剧上升。潜能与轨迹分析将 MECs-MYB 置于 LECs-MYB 上游。恶性状态形成了面积达 38.0 mm2 的区域，在三个切片中持续超过 1.5 mm，并包含空间受限的程序。缺氧应激区域还显示出 mTORC1、未折叠蛋白反应和细胞周期程序。T/NK、髓系、MHC I 类和 II 类以及浆细胞特征在基质中比在肿瘤巢中高 1.4 至 5.7 倍，而 VTCN1（B7-H4）是唯一在巢内富集的 B7 家族配体。结论：SGACC 显示出恶性谱系的有序排列、毫米级恶性区域、MHC I 类和 II 类富集的基质，以及富集 B7-H4 的免疫排斥巢。这些特征提供了有待在更大队列中通过蛋白水平和临床数据验证的证据。

items.title_en: Fractional Charge at Dislocations from Band-Inversion Cancellation
items.title_zh: 能带反转相消产生的位错分数电荷
items.abstract_en: Band inversions with opposite Chern numbers cancel in the Hall response and yield counterpropagating boundary modes that can gap out. However, a bulk probe of the topology that survives such a cancellation is lacking. We here show that dislocations in inversion-symmetric two-band crystals with cancelling band inversions bind a half-integer charge, which reveals the quantized bulk polarization of the bond-centered obstructed atomic limit realized by such crystals. To demonstrate this, we continuously deform a broad class of two-band lattice models into decoupled chains, without closing the bulk gap or breaking the inversion symmetry, where the dislocation charge follows from a count of occupied bonds. Notably, the fractional part of this charge is insensitive to local perturbations of the dislocation core, and it therefore persists after the in-gap core state is removed, as we show analytically in the chain limit and numerically away from it. In the Weyl-semimetal counterpart, the response to a magnetic flux separates this crystalline charge from the charge set by the Chern number of each momentum slice. We propose that a half-integer core charge that persists after the in-gap peak disappears from the local spectrum can be detected in artificial electronic and optical lattices, with metamaterials providing complementary access to the core modes.
items.abstract_zh: 具有相反陈数的能带反转在霍尔响应中相消，并产生可打开能隙的反向传播边界模式。然而，缺乏对这种相消后仍存拓扑的体探测。我们在此表明，在具有相消能带反转的反演对称双能带晶体中，位错束缚一个半整数电荷，这揭示了此类晶体所实现的键中心受阻原子极限的量子化体极化。为证明这一点，我们将一大类双能带晶格模型连续变形为解耦链，而不关闭体能隙或破坏反演对称性；在位错处，电荷由占据键的计数得出。值得注意的是，该电荷的分数部分对位错芯的局域扰动不敏感，因此即使在能隙内芯态被移除后仍然存在；我们在链极限下解析地、并在远离该极限时数值地展示了这一点。在Weyl半金属对应体系中，对磁通量的响应将这种晶格电荷与由每个动量切片的陈数设定的电荷区分开来。我们提出，一种在能隙内峰从局域谱中消失后仍持续存在的半整数芯电荷，可在人工电子和光学晶格中检测到，而超材料为芯模提供了互补的访问途径。

items.title_en: Structural Agreement Indicates Prediction Accuracy For Protein-Ligand Co-Folding
items.title_zh: 结构一致性指示蛋白质-配体共折叠的预测准确性
items.abstract_en: Co-folding models predict the structures of proteins and their bound ligands, but their accuracy varies across targets. Their usefulness therefore depends on knowing which predictions a user can trust. Confidence scores are intended to guide that choice. However, across seven co-folding models, we show that confidence-based selection offers little improvement over choosing a prediction at random. For approximately three-quarters of structures, predictions are either exclusively correct or incorrect, leaving no opportunity for ranking to change the outcome. Moreover, high confidence does not reliably discriminate correct top-ranked predictions from incorrect ones. We find that structural agreement among predictions is a more accurate measure of likely success than current confidence scores. We capture this with the Concentration of Repeated Ensembles (CORE) Score, which combines cluster tightness with ensemble support. CORE Score discriminates top-1 success and oracle success, achieving mean ROC AUCs of 0.866 and 0.838, compared to 0.757 and 0.759 for ipTM. CORE Score also outperforms training set similarity measures, including ligand Tanimoto, protein sequence, and Runs N' Poses similarity, despite requiring no experimental ligand pose. Structural agreement is therefore a practical indicator of reliability and a baseline for evaluating future confidence estimators, without requiring an additional trained uncertainty estimator.
items.abstract_zh: 共折叠模型预测蛋白质及其结合配体的结构，但其准确性因靶标而异。因此，其实用性取决于知道用户可以信任哪些预测。置信度分数旨在指导这一选择。然而，在七个共折叠模型中，我们表明基于置信度的选择相较于随机选择预测几乎没有改进。对于大约四分之三的结构，预测要么全部正确，要么全部错误，排名没有机会改变结果。此外，高置信度不能可靠地区分正确的最高排名预测与错误预测。我们发现，预测之间的结构一致性比当前置信度分数更能准确衡量可能成功。我们用重复集成集中度（Concentration of Repeated Ensembles，CORE）分数来刻画这一点，它结合了簇紧密度与集成支持度。CORE 分数可区分 top-1 成功和 oracle 成功，平均 ROC AUC 分别为 0.866 和 0.838，而 ipTM 为 0.757 和 0.759。CORE 分数还优于训练集相似性度量，包括配体 Tanimoto、蛋白质序列和 Runs N' Poses 相似性，尽管不需要实验配体姿态。因此，结构一致性是可靠性的实用指标，也是评估未来置信度估计器的基线，且不需要额外训练的不确定性估计器。

items.title_en: From Novel Combinations to Informative Absence: Structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice in language learning
items.title_zh: 从新异组合到信息性缺失：语言学习中的结构许可、交际机会与形式选择
items.abstract_en: Language learners must infer which novel expressions are grammatically licensed and when continued absence is evidence against them. Our generative theory unites these capacities via counterfactual expression opportunities, decomposing utterance generation into structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice. First, shared predictive continuations recover structural permission for unseen word-construction pairings across 30 artificial grammars (mean AUC 0.945 after 120 sentences). Second, under hierarchical uncertainty, we derive a joint evidence law linking omissions to context diversity and within-context repetition, and an exact finite-sample context-refinement inequality. Thus, observing related expressions calibrates expected use to sharpen negative evidence, and higher expected use can drive steeper posterior declines for stronger-permission candidates (reversing initial order after six omissions in a fixed-rate example). Third, we prove that while raw counts confound semantic availability and form selection, scene-level opportunity observations identify both. Empirically, reanalyzing adult and child artificial-language experiments shows meaning-conditioned restriction; judgments of restricted combinations improve held-out production predictions across 399 participants (+0.036 nats/production). Naturalistic child-directed and child speech (11 families, six corpora) shows pervasive source-level usage clustering beyond lexical, number, and dependency-role controls, grounding hierarchical rate uncertainty. Finally, modeling causative judgments across five languages shows that structural compatibility and calibrated usage probabilities draw on distinct distributional, semantic, and discriminative cues. Together, these findings show how the organization and calibration of communicative opportunities govern the evidential value of linguistic absence.
items.abstract_zh: 语言学习者必须推断哪些新异表达在语法上被许可，以及何时持续缺失可作为反对它们的证据。我们的生成理论通过反事实表达机会将这两种能力统一起来，将话语生成分解为结构许可、交际机会和形式选择。第一，共享预测续接在30个人工语法中恢复未见词-构式配对的结构许可（120句后平均AUC 0.945）。第二，在层级不确定性下，我们推导出一个联合证据规律，将省略与上下文多样性和上下文内重复联系起来，并给出精确的有限样本上下文细化不等式。因此，观察相关表达会校准预期使用，以增强负证据；更高的预期使用可导致更强许可候选的后验下降更陡（在一个固定速率示例中，六次省略后逆转初始顺序）。第三，我们证明，尽管原始计数会混淆语义可用性与形式选择，场景级机会观察能够同时识别二者。在实证上，重新分析成人和儿童人工语言实验显示出意义条件限制；对受限组合的判断改善了399名参与者的留出产出预测（+0.036 nats/产出）。自然情境的儿童导向语料和儿童语音（11个家庭、六个语料库）显示出超越词汇、数和依存角色控制的普遍来源级使用聚类，为层级速率不确定性提供依据。最后，对五种语言的致使判断建模表明，结构兼容性和校准的使用概率依赖于不同的分布、语义和判别线索。总之，这些发现表明交际机会的组织与校准如何支配语言缺失的证据价值。

items.title_en: Synthesizing Expressive Human-Object Interactions via Test-time Latent Adaptation
items.title_zh: 通过测试时潜在适应合成富有表现力的人-物交互
items.abstract_en: When interacting with objects of unknown physical properties, humans sometimes probe, over-exert, stagger, and adjust through iterative adaptation instead of succeeding immediately. We argue that this process is an expressive but largely overlooked aspect of human-object interaction in motion synthesis. Both kinematic data-driven methods and physics-based controllers tend to produce flawlessly executed motions: the former lack sufficient data for learning fine-grained adaptation, while the latter use reinforcement learning (RL) and privileged object dynamics to learn robust, deterministic behaviors. We propose ExpHOI (Expressive Human-Object Interaction), a test-time latent adaptation framework built on an RL-trained physics-based control policy. During policy training, we encode diverse object dynamics contexts into a structured latent space. At test time, Advantage-Weighted Regression (AWR) iteratively optimizes the latent code for an object with unknown physical properties. Temporary mismatches between this code and the true object dynamics produce an expressive progression from tentative, error-prone trials to proficient interaction. Adaptation behaviors inevitably come with occasional failures, so a high-level planner is introduced to handle failed cases to maintain full, consistent animations. We demonstrate our framework's effectiveness on a large-object transportation task, where such adaptation is especially pronounced. To train our framework, we introduce a mass-diverse object dataset with rich physical-property annotations. Across carrying and push-pull, our method pairs over 90% success with markedly higher posture diversity, and is rated the most lifelike in our user study on animation liveliness.
items.abstract_zh: 当与物理属性未知的物体交互时，人类有时会通过迭代适应进行试探、过度用力、踉跄和调整，而不是立即成功。我们认为，这一过程是运动合成中人-物交互一个富有表现力但很大程度上被忽视的方面。运动学数据驱动方法和基于物理的控制器都倾向于产生完美执行的运动：前者缺乏足够数据来学习细粒度适应，而后者使用强化学习（RL）和特权物体动力学来学习稳健的确定性行为。我们提出 ExpHOI（Expressive Human-Object Interaction），一个基于 RL 训练的物理控制策略构建的测试时潜在适应框架。在策略训练期间，我们将多样的物体动力学上下文编码到一个结构化潜在空间中。在测试时，优势加权回归（AWR）针对物理属性未知的物体迭代优化潜在编码。该编码与真实物体动力学之间的暂时不匹配，会产生从试探性、易出错的尝试到熟练交互的富有表现力进展。适应行为不可避免地偶尔失败，因此引入高层规划器来处理失败情况，以保持完整、一致的动画。我们在大型物体运输任务上展示了该框架的有效性，此类适应在该任务中尤其明显。为了训练我们的框架，我们引入了一个质量多样化、具有丰富物理属性标注的物体数据集。在搬运和推拉任务中，我们的方法在超过90%成功率的同时具有显著更高的姿态多样性，并在关于动画生动性的用户研究中被评为最逼真。

items.title_en: Receptor Abundance Alone Underpredicts Red Blood Cell Adhesion in Gaucher Disease
items.title_zh: 仅受体丰度会低估戈谢病中的红细胞黏附
items.abstract_en: Red blood cells (RBCs) in Gaucher disease (GD) adhere abnormally to vessel walls and carry more Lutheran/basal cell adhesion molecule (Lu/BCAM), a laminin receptor. Whether receptor abundance sets this adhesion is untested. We simulated RBCs carrying stochastic Lu/BCAM-laminin bonds, calibrated a population on control donors, and predicted GD adhesion from the 1.3-fold receptor rise. On laminin and endothelium the data exceed the prediction 1.6- to 1.7-fold. Matching them requires 2.4- and 4.6-fold more binding-competent receptors, compatible with the estimated 5.7-fold rise in phosphorylated receptors. Neither a stiffer membrane nor higher bond affinity removes the shortfall at high shear stress. In sickle cell disease, given active-receptor counts, the model predicts the fall in adhesion under hydroxyurea within 1.4-fold, while total receptors rise. Adhesion likely follows receptor state more than abundance. Stiffening instead retains cells at a splenic slit.
items.abstract_zh: 戈谢病（GD）中的红细胞（RBC）异常黏附于血管壁，并携带更多 Lutheran/基底细胞黏附分子（Lu/BCAM），这是一种层粘连蛋白受体。受体丰度是否决定这种黏附尚未被检验。我们模拟了携带随机 Lu/BCAM-层粘连蛋白键的红细胞，在对照供体上校准了一个群体，并根据受体增加1.3倍预测 GD 黏附。在层粘连蛋白和内皮上，数据超出预测1.6至1.7倍。要匹配这些数据，需要分别多2.4倍和4.6倍的具有结合能力的受体，这与磷酸化受体估计增加5.7倍相符。更硬的膜或更高的键亲和力都不能消除高剪切应力下的不足。在镰状细胞病中，给定活性受体计数，模型预测羟基脲治疗下黏附下降在1.4倍以内，而总受体上升。黏附可能更多取决于受体状态而非丰度。而硬化反而使细胞滞留在脾裂隙处。

items.title_en: High GPX4 Expression Marks an Oxidative-Metabolic, PD-L1/CD47-Low and Stroma-Poor Tumor State in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
items.title_zh: GPX4 高表达标志肝细胞癌中一种氧化代谢型、PD-L1/CD47 低表达且间质贫乏的肿瘤状态
items.abstract_en: Background: Glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) protects cancer cells from ferroptosis and is a candidate therapeutic target in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). How GPX4 expression relates to the immune and metabolic features of patient tumors is not well characterized. Methods: We analyzed RNA-sequencing data from 366 primary tumors of the TCGA-LIHC PanCancer Atlas cohort (365 with survival data). Associations between GPX4 and ten immune and stress-response markers were tested by Spearman correlation with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, then re-estimated after adjustment for consensus tumor purity, CTNNB1 and TP53 mutation, age and sex. A T-cell-inflamed profile, a CD8 T-cell score and an NRF2 target-gene score, gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) of GPX4-high versus GPX4-low tumors, and Cox models were added as further tests. Results: Higher GPX4 expression was associated with lower expression of PD-L1 (CD274; rho = -0.34, 95% CI -0.43 to -0.24, p = 2.4 x 10^-11), CD47 (rho = -0.21), the macrophage marker CD163 (rho = -0.17) and a fibroblast/extracellular-matrix score (rho = -0.22). These associations persisted after adjustment (CD274 rho = -0.37 in the fully adjusted model). GSEA showed enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial, fatty-acid, xenobiotic and glutathione metabolism programs and depletion of extracellular-matrix, TGF-beta and cell-adhesion programs in GPX4-high tumors. GPX4 was not associated with a T-cell-inflamed profile (rho = -0.07), a CD8 T-cell score (rho = -0.03), cytolytic activity (rho = 0.04) or an NRF2 target-gene score (rho = 0.03), although NFE2L2 mRNA was inversely correlated with GPX4 (rho = -0.32). GPX4 expression was not associated with overall survival (stage-adjusted hazard ratio per SD 1.09, 95% CI 0.91-1.29). Conclusions: In TCGA-LIHC, high GPX4 expression marks a metabolically active, PD-L1/CD47-low and matrix-poor tumor state, with no evidence of T-cell exclusion, NRF2 pathway activation or prognostic value. These correlative findings come from a single cohort and require external validation and functional testing. Keywords: hepatocellular carcinoma; ferroptosis; GPX4; PD-L1; CD47; tumor microenvironment; NRF2; gene set enrichment analysis; TCGA
items.abstract_zh: 背景：谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶 4（GPX4）保护癌细胞免于铁死亡，是肝细胞癌（HCC）的候选治疗靶点。GPX4 表达与患者肿瘤的免疫和代谢特征之间的关系尚未得到充分表征。方法：我们分析了 TCGA-LIHC PanCancer Atlas 队列中 366 个原发肿瘤的 RNA 测序数据（365 个有生存数据）。GPX4 与十种免疫和应激反应标志物之间的关联通过 Spearman 相关进行检验，并采用 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正，然后在调整共识肿瘤纯度、CTNNB1 和 TP53 突变、年龄和性别后重新估计。还加入了 T 细胞炎症特征、CD8 T 细胞评分和 NRF2 靶基因评分、GPX4 高表达与 GPX4 低表达肿瘤的基因集富集分析（GSEA）以及 Cox 模型作为进一步检验。结果：较高的 GPX4 表达与较低的 PD-L1（CD274；rho = -0.34，95% CI -0.43 至 -0.24，p = 2.4 x 10^-11）、CD47（rho = -0.21）、巨噬细胞标志物 CD163（rho = -0.17）以及成纤维细胞/细胞外基质评分（rho = -0.22）表达相关。这些关联在调整后仍然存在（在完全调整模型中 CD274 rho = -0.37）。GSEA 显示，在 GPX4 高表达肿瘤中，氧化磷酸化、线粒体、脂肪酸、外源物质和谷胱甘肽代谢程序富集，而细胞外基质、TGF-beta 和细胞黏附程序耗竭。GPX4 与 T 细胞炎症特征（rho = -0.07）、CD8 T 细胞评分（rho = -0.03）、溶细胞活性（rho = 0.04）或 NRF2 靶基因评分（rho = 0.03）无关，尽管 NFE2L2 mRNA 与 GPX4 呈负相关（rho = -0.32）。GPX4 表达与总生存期无关（按分期调整后每 SD 的风险比 1.09，95% CI 0.91-1.29）。结论：在 TCGA-LIHC 中，GPX4 高表达标志一种代谢活跃、PD-L1/CD47 低表达且基质贫乏的肿瘤状态，没有证据表明存在 T 细胞排斥、NRF2 通路激活或预后价值。这些相关性发现来自单一队列，需要外部验证和功能测试。关键词：肝细胞癌；铁死亡；GPX4；PD-L1；CD47；肿瘤微环境；NRF2；基因集富集分析；TCGA

items.title_en: Magnon high-harmonic generation by nonlinearities of spin torque driven by phonon-mediated crossing of many-body energy levels of bright and dark excitons
items.title_zh: 由声子介导的亮激子与暗激子多体能级交叉所驱动的自旋力矩非线性实现磁振子高次谐波产生
items.abstract_en: Recent intense experimental focus on CrSBr, a two-dimensional (2D) antiferromagnetic semiconductor, has revealed numerous surprises in its response to ultrafast optical drive. We demonstrate that a single microscopic mechanism accounts for two of them---high-harmonic generation of magnons and persistence of magnon oscillations over \mbox{$\sim 1$ ns} time scale that is much longer than the femtosecond laser pulse (fsLP) pump duration. This mechanism arises from an unusually complex interplay of four different fundamental quasiparticles of condensed matter physics: magnons, optically bright and dark excitons, and phonons. By viewing magnons as the system and the other three quasiparticles as a quantum many-body bath, we derive an extended Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (eLLG) equation. Its new term generated by the bath is spatially nonlocal and time-dependent, as well as strongly {\em nonlinear} when the {\em crossing of many-body energy levels} of bright and dark excitons occurs via phonon mediation. It also resembles the so-called field-like spin-transfer torque (STT) in spintronics, but STT is driven there with current pulses, so it explains the microscopic origin of the recently experimentally conjectured {\em excitonic STT}. Since dark excitons supply energy to magnons long after the fsLP is switched off, such a reservoir opens avenues for its engineering and applications in optospintronics and optomagnonics, neuromorphic computing, and quantum transduction.
items.abstract_zh: 近期针对二维（2D）反铁磁半导体 CrSBr 的大量实验研究，在其对超快光驱动的响应中揭示了诸多意外现象。我们证明，单一微观机制可解释其中两个现象——磁振子的高次谐波产生，以及磁振子振荡在约 1 ns 时间尺度上的持续存在，该时间尺度远长于飞秒激光脉冲（fsLP）泵浦持续时间。该机制源于凝聚态物理中四种不同基本准粒子的异常复杂相互作用：磁振子、光学亮激子和暗激子以及声子。通过将磁振子视为系统、将另外三种准粒子视为量子多体浴，我们推导出扩展的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（eLLG）方程。由该浴产生的新项具有空间非局域性和时间依赖性，并且当亮激子和暗激子的多体能级通过声子介导发生交叉时，该项呈强非线性。它还类似于自旋电子学中所谓的类场自旋转移矩（STT），但那里的 STT 由电流脉冲驱动，因此它解释了最近实验上推测的激子 STT 的微观起源。由于暗激子在 fsLP 关闭后很长时间仍向磁振子供给能量，这种储库为其工程化以及在光自旋电子学和光磁子学、神经形态计算和量子转导中的应用开辟了途径。

items.title_en: Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
items.title_zh: 使用 STL 衍生图和零件级描述符预测激光粉末床熔融零件的表面位移场
items.abstract_en: Predicting part distortion before fabrication remains challenging in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), while thermomechanical simulation is computationally expensive for repeated design evaluations. This study presents a two-branch graph attention network (GAT) to predict three-dimensional surface displacement directly from STL-derived graphs. The first branch learns geometric relationships among connected vertices of a densified STL surface mesh, while the second incorporates 12 part-level descriptors of mass distribution, build-plate contact, overhang, size, and shape. Displacement labels from ANSYS Additive Print simulations are mapped onto STL vertices using Gaussian-kernel weighted averaging. Evaluated on 117 parts using five-fold cross-validation split by part, the model achieves an R^2 of 0.946 and a mean absolute error of 0.0178 mm for displacement magnitude. Relative to a node-wise multilayer perceptron, GAT improves R^2 from 0.913 to 0.946; for build-direction displacement, R^2 increases from 0.903 to 0.939. GAT also outperforms GraphSAGE (R^2 = 0.936) and a graph convolutional network (R^2 = 0.934) across all five folds. Ablation experiments show that removing mass-distribution descriptors reduces magnitude R^2 to 0.900, while removing build-plate contact and overhang descriptors reduces it to 0.920. These results demonstrate the value of combining local mesh connectivity with global geometric descriptors to predict LPBF distortion, enabling faster design iteration and earlier identification of distortion-prone geometries.
items.abstract_zh: 在激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）中，制造前预测零件变形仍具有挑战性，而热机械仿真对于重复的设计评估而言计算成本高昂。本研究提出一种双分支图注意力网络（GAT），直接根据 STL 衍生图预测三维表面位移。第一个分支学习致密化 STL 表面网格中相连顶点之间的几何关系，第二个分支纳入 12 个零件级描述符，涉及质量分布、构建板接触、悬垂、尺寸和形状。将来自 ANSYS Additive Print 仿真的位移标签使用高斯核加权平均映射到 STL 顶点。在 117 个零件上使用按零件划分的五折交叉验证进行评估，模型在位移幅值上达到 R^2 为 0.946，平均绝对误差为 0.0178 mm。相对于逐节点多层感知机，GAT 将 R^2 从 0.913 提高到 0.946；对于构建方向位移，R^2 从 0.903 提高到 0.939。GAT 在所有五折中也优于 GraphSAGE（R^2 = 0.936）和图卷积网络（R^2 = 0.934）。消融实验表明，移除质量分布描述符会使幅值 R^2 降至 0.900，而移除构建板接触和悬垂描述符会使其降至 0.920。这些结果证明了将局部网格连通性与全局几何描述符相结合来预测 LPBF 变形的价值，从而能够加快设计迭代并更早识别易变形几何。

items.title_en: Typhoon OCR 2: From Thai Document Transcription to Multilingual, Multi-Task OCR
items.title_zh: Typhoon OCR 2：从泰语文档转录到多语言、多任务 OCR
items.abstract_en: Typhoon OCR 1.5 focused on reading Thai documents. However, in real-world workflows, users often need to extract specific information or preserve the structure of an entire page for further processing. Typhoon OCR 2 handles both tasks in a single model, with prompt-driven extraction and structured full-page parsing. Full-page parsing covers Thai, English, and Chinese. We release compact 2B and 0.8B models adapted from open document parsers through supervised fine-tuning on curated Thai and public multilingual data, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task rewards and a rule penalizing unfinished responses. Among evaluated open models, Typhoon OCR 2 2B scores highest on Thai MDPBench (80.7 versus 68.9 for Typhoon OCR 1.5) and on ThaiOCRBench (59.91 versus 40.45), which covers recognition, extraction, and document understanding. The 2B model remains close to its base on English olmOCR-bench (84.7 versus 84.4) and on OmniDocBench, which evaluates English and Chinese together (90.97 versus 91.03). On MDPBench, GRPO reduces the mean share of pages with repetition loops for the 2B model from 3.2% to 0.7%, with a smaller and statistically uncertain score gain for the 0.8B model. We release the model weights, Python package, and evaluation suite.
items.abstract_zh: Typhoon OCR 1.5 专注于读取泰语文档。然而，在真实工作流中，用户经常需要提取特定信息或保留整页结构以供进一步处理。Typhoon OCR 2 在单一模型中处理这两类任务，支持提示驱动的提取和结构化的整页解析。整页解析覆盖泰语、英语和中文。我们发布紧凑的 2B 和 0.8B 模型，这些模型从开放文档解析器适配而来，先在精选泰语和公开多语言数据上进行监督微调，随后使用带任务奖励和惩罚未完成响应规则的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。在受评估的开放模型中，Typhoon OCR 2 2B 在 Thai MDPBench 上得分最高（80.7，对比 Typhoon OCR 1.5 的 68.9），在 ThaiOCRBench 上也最高（59.91，对比 40.45），后者涵盖识别、提取和文档理解。2B 模型在英语 olmOCR-bench 上（84.7 对 84.4）以及同时评估英语和中文的 OmniDocBench 上（90.97 对 91.03）与其基座模型保持接近。在 MDPBench 上，GRPO 将 2B 模型出现重复循环的页面平均比例从 3.2% 降至 0.7%，而 0.8B 模型的分数提升较小且统计上不确定。我们发布模型权重、Python 包和评估套件。

items.title_en: Joint Optimization of Fleet Size, Localization Infrastructure, and Trajectories for Multi-AUV Persistent Monitoring
items.title_zh: 多AUV持续监测中机队规模、定位基础设施与轨迹的联合优化
items.abstract_en: Persistent monitoring of large-scale subsea infrastructure, such as offshore wind farm foundations, export cables, and inspection corridors, remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous underwater systems. The problem is not solely spatial coverage, but rather temporal coverage: ensuring that all relevant regions of interest are revisited within bounded time intervals under limited sensing, navigation uncertainty, and constrained vehicle resources. We compare three classes of trajectory strategies: (1) deterministic lane-based coverage (lawnmower patterns), (2) stochastic exploration (biased random walk with boundary constraints), and (3) coordinated partition-based strategies (Voronoi tessellation). Rather than seeking a universally superior method, we evaluate how varying levels of localization accuracy impact temporal coverage across two distinct operational profiles: persistent monitoring of the entire operational workspace versus targeted inspection of critical infrastructure. We present a simulation-based, quantitatively grounded study of temporal coverage in multi-AUV persistent monitoring, disentangling three interacting design dimensions: (i) trajectory generation strategy, (ii) fleet size, and (iii) localization accuracy provided by fixed acoustic beacon infrastructure. We introduce a cost-aware evaluation framework combining fleet size, number of beacons, and mission energy expenditure into a unified cost function. Results demonstrate that beyond a certain accuracy threshold, improvements in localization yield diminishing returns compared to coordinated trajectory design, an effect often obscured in integrated navigation-planning approaches. Coordinated-partition trajectories enable a reduced fleet size to achieve superior temporal coverage at a 39-46% lower overall life-cycle cost than rigid deterministic paths unoptimized for the localization infrastructure.
items.abstract_zh: 对大规模海底基础设施（如海上风电场基础、外送电缆和巡检走廊）的持续监测，仍是自主水下系统面临的根本性挑战。该问题不仅是空间覆盖，更是时间覆盖：在有限感知、导航不确定性和受限航行器资源下，确保所有相关感兴趣区域在有界时间间隔内被重新访问。我们比较三类轨迹策略：(1) 确定性车道式覆盖（割草机模式）；(2) 随机探索（带边界约束的偏置随机游走）；(3) 协调分区策略（Voronoi 划分）。我们不寻求普遍更优的方法，而是评估不同定位精度水平如何在两种不同操作模式下影响时间覆盖：对整个操作工作空间的持续监测与对关键基础设施的针对性检查。我们提出一项基于仿真的、定量有据的多AUV持续监测时间覆盖研究，厘清三个相互作用的设计维度：(i) 轨迹生成策略，(ii) 机队规模，(iii) 固定声学信标基础设施提供的定位精度。我们引入一个成本感知评估框架，将机队规模、信标数量和任务能量消耗组合为统一成本函数。结果表明，超过某一精度阈值后，与协调轨迹设计相比，定位改进带来的收益递减；这一效应在集成导航-规划方法中常被掩盖。与未针对定位基础设施优化的刚性确定性路径相比，协调分区轨迹使缩减后的机队规模能够实现更优的时间覆盖，同时总体生命周期成本降低39-46%。

items.title_en: Points, Not Pixels: Keypoints, Masks and Oblique Geometry for Floating-Roof Tank Fill Estimation from Overhead Imagery
items.title_zh: 点而非像素：面向俯视图像浮顶罐填充估计的关键点、掩码与斜视几何
items.abstract_en: The floating roof of an oil storage tank rests on the stored liquid, so its depth below the rim measures how full the tank is. In optical overhead imagery, this depth appears only as the crescent shadow the rim casts on the roof, often a few pixels wide. Thin shadows are difficult to measure at overhead-image resolution, and nadir-based height conversions introduce errors in oblique views. Under a local affine camera, roof depth determines the rim-to-shadow displacement through the sun and camera geometry. We regress the boundaries as sub-pixel keypoints and invert this relation with a closed-form estimator that models oblique views. Available public tank datasets do not label roof position, so we introduce SynTank-25k, 24,987 physically based renders with exact roof, shadow and camera geometry. Using the oblique estimator, the keypoint pipeline reduces fill error by $22\%$ relative to the segmentation baseline on SynTank-25k. On shadows narrower than $6\text{ px}$, its error is also lower than that obtained by converting true binary masks. Our oblique estimator reduces the error of the nadir formula elevenfold at the steepest views. On 6,558 real NAIP tank crops defined by bounding boxes, about half of the fill estimates pass internal consistency checks; NAIP has no fill labels. Data and code will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 储油罐的浮顶浮于储存液体之上，因此其低于罐缘的深度衡量了罐的充满程度。在光学俯视图像中，该深度仅表现为罐缘投射在浮顶上的新月形阴影，通常只有几个像素宽。细窄阴影在俯视图像分辨率下难以测量，而基于天底的高度转换在斜视视角中会引入误差。在局部仿射相机下，浮顶深度通过太阳与相机几何决定罐缘到阴影的位移。我们将边界回归为亚像素关键点，并用一个对斜视建模的闭式估计器反演该关系。现有公开储罐数据集未标注浮顶位置，因此我们引入 SynTank-25k，包含 24,987 个基于物理的渲染，具有精确的浮顶、阴影和相机几何。在 SynTank-25k 上，使用斜视估计器，关键点流水线相对于分割基线将填充误差降低 22%。对于窄于 6 像素的阴影，其误差也低于通过转换真实二值掩码所获得的误差。我们的斜视估计器在最陡视角下将天底公式的误差降至原来的十一分之一。在 6,558 个由边界框定义的真实 NAIP 储罐裁剪图像上，约一半的填充估计通过内部一致性检查；NAIP 没有填充标签。数据和代码将发布。

items.title_en: Phenotypic, ecological and genomic divergence support independent evolutionary trajectories in the Meganesian masked owls (Tyto novaehollandiae)
items.title_zh: 表型、生态与基因组分化支持 Meganesian 面罩鸮（Tyto novaehollandiae）的独立进化轨迹
items.abstract_en: Understanding how phenotypic, ecological, and genomic divergence accumulates during lineage differentiation remains a central challenge in evolutionary biology. Insular populations provide valuable opportunities to investigate this process because geographic isolation can restrict gene flow and promote divergence. Mainland Australia and Tasmania form an ideal natural system for studying these mechanisms. The Australian masked owl (Tyto novaehollandiae) occurs across diverse habitats on mainland Australia and Tasmania. Among its recognized subspecies, the Tasmanian masked owl (T. n. castanops) is notable for its larger body size and distinctive plumage compared with Australian T. n. novaehollandiae. Here, we combined phenotypic measurements, ecological niche analyses, and whole-genome sequencing to assess divergence between Australian and Tasmanian masked owls. Tasmanian masked owls were consistently larger and darker reddish in coloration than mainland individuals and occupied a distinct climatic niche. These phenotypic and ecological differences were matched by genomic structure separating individuals by geographic origin. Despite this differentiation, genome-wide genetic divergence remained moderate (FST = 0.086; DXY = 0.087%), indicating that phenotypic and ecological divergence accumulated more rapidly than genomic differentiation. Genomic analyses also revealed higher inbreeding levels in Tasmanian populations based on runs of homozygosity (FROH). This pattern was driven mainly by short tracts, suggesting long-term isolation rather than recent inbreeding. Genome scans identified several differentiated regions, although no significant enrichment of functional pathways was detected. Overall, our results support the recognition of Australian and Tasmanian masked owls as independently evolving lineages and demonstrate that substantial phenotypic and ecological differentiation can arise before pronounced genome-wide divergence accumulates.
items.abstract_zh: 理解表型、生态和基因组分化在谱系分化过程中如何累积，仍是进化生物学的核心挑战。岛屿种群为研究这一过程提供了宝贵机会，因为地理隔离可限制基因流并促进分化。澳大利亚大陆和塔斯马尼亚构成了研究这些机制的理想自然系统。澳大利亚面罩鸮（Tyto novaehollandiae）分布于澳大利亚大陆和塔斯马尼亚的多样生境中。在其已确认的亚种中，塔斯马尼亚面罩鸮（T. n. castanops）以体型更大和羽色独特而显著，与澳大利亚的 T. n. novaehollandiae 相比。在此，我们结合表型测量、生态位分析和全基因组测序，评估澳大利亚与塔斯马尼亚面罩鸮之间的分化。塔斯马尼亚面罩鸮始终比大陆个体更大，且呈更深的偏红色，并占据独特的气候生态位。这些表型和生态差异与按地理来源区分个体的基因组结构相匹配。尽管存在这种分化，全基因组遗传分化仍为中等水平（FST = 0.086；DXY = 0.087%），表明表型和生态分化比基因组分化积累得更快。基因组分析还基于纯合片段（FROH）揭示塔斯马尼亚种群具有更高的近交水平。该模式主要由短片段驱动，表明长期隔离而非近期近交。基因组扫描识别出若干分化区域，但未检测到功能通路的显著富集。总体而言，我们的结果支持将澳大利亚面罩鸮和塔斯马尼亚面罩鸮认定为独立进化的谱系，并表明在显著的全基因组分化积累之前，即可出现相当大的表型和生态分化。

items.title_en: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
items.title_zh: 纳米结构中热输运的智能成像
items.abstract_en: The ability to measure thermal properties and visualize heat transport processes with high spatial resolution is becoming increasingly important for materials discovery, next-generation electronics, and advanced manufacturing. As critical dimensions and architectures of novel materials and high performance electronics shrink and become more heterogeneous, thermal transport is no longer governed by bulk material properties alone, but by local variations in microstructure, such as interfaces and defects, while the operating conditions can also play a role. With the development of non-contact pump-probe thermoreflectance techniques, specific heat, thermal conductivity, and interface conductance can be mapped either through wide-field thermos-reflectance images or by scanning technique. However, key challenges remain such as the balance between imaging throughput and measurement accuracy, the extraction of multiple parameters with high confidence, and non-intrusive subsurface characterization, etc. This Review highlights recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI)-assistance in high-throughput data processing, visualizing interfacial thermal transport, and nonintrusive subsurface analysis, and offers outlooks for future research directions such as spectral mapping of heat carriers, three-dimensional property mapping, and AI-agentic experimental designs. We anticipate this Review will motivate future efforts in combining AI with experimental techniques to achieve unprecedented capabilities for thermal characterization of nanoscale materials and device characterization, facilitating materials discovery and electronics revolution.
items.abstract_zh: 以高空间分辨率测量热性质并可视化热输运过程的能力，对于材料发现、下一代电子学和先进制造正变得越来越重要。随着新型材料和高性能电子学的关键尺寸与架构不断缩小并变得更加异质，热输运不再仅由块体材料性质决定，而是由微观结构中的局部变化（如界面和缺陷）决定，同时工作条件也可能发挥作用。随着非接触泵浦-探测热反射技术的发展，比热、热导率和界面热导可以通过宽场热反射图像或扫描技术进行映射。然而，关键挑战仍然存在，例如成像通量与测量精度之间的平衡、以高置信度提取多个参数，以及非侵入式亚表面表征等。本综述重点介绍人工智能（AI）辅助在高通量数据处理、可视化界面热输运和非侵入式亚表面分析方面的最新进展，并对未来研究方向提供展望，例如热载流子的光谱映射、三维性质映射和 AI 代理式实验设计。我们预期本综述将推动未来将 AI 与实验技术相结合的努力，以实现纳米级材料热表征和器件表征的前所未有能力，促进材料发现和电子学革命。

items.title_en: Optimal Linear Regression Without a Variance
items.title_zh: 无方差条件下的最优线性回归
items.abstract_en: We study high-probability linear regression in the infinite variance regime, wherecthe regression noise has only a finite conditional $α$-moment $ν$ for some unknown $α\in(1,2)$, and the covariates may only have finite moments up to a given order (e.g., 4th moment). We give a black-box reduction that converts finite-variance regression procedures into weak-moment procedures. The reduction is based on empirical residual pruning and is agnostic to the moment exponent, the noise scale, the covariance, and the design moment. Under a finite fourth-moment condition on the covariates, any finite-variance subroutine attaining the sub-Gaussian rate yields the following when the number of samples $n$ is above a suitably defined threshold: Without knowing $α$ or $ν$, we have with probability at least $1-δ$ that $ \|\widehatθ-θ^*\|_Σ \lesssim_α ν^{1/α} \big(\frac{d+\log(1/δ)}{n}\big)^{\frac{α-1}α}, $ where $d$ is the dimension, $Σ$ is the covariate covariance matrix, and $\|v\|_Σ:=(v^\topΣv)^{1/2}$. We further prove a matching minimax lower bound that holds under the same conditions. The reduction is computationally efficient whenever the finite-variance subroutine is. We also obtain a distribution-free prediction guarantee under a bounded raw $α$-moment assumption on the response, and give an analogous $α$-agnostic reduction for mean estimation.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究无限方差情形下的高概率线性回归，其中回归噪声仅具有有限的条件 α 阶矩 ν，α∈(1,2) 未知，且协变量可能仅具有直到给定阶（例如四阶）的有限矩。我们给出一种黑盒归约，将有限方差回归过程转换为弱矩过程。该归约基于经验残差剪枝，并且不依赖于矩指数、噪声尺度、协方差和设计矩。在协变量满足有限四阶矩条件下，当样本数 n 高于适当定义的阈值时，任何达到次高斯速率的有限方差子程序会产生以下结果：在不知道 α 或 ν 的情况下，我们以至少 1−δ 的概率有 ‖θ̂−θ*‖_Σ ≲_α ν^{1/α} ((d+log(1/δ))/n)^{(α−1)/α}，其中 d 是维度，Σ 是协变量协方差矩阵，且 ‖v‖_Σ := (v^T Σ v)^{1/2}。我们进一步证明在相同条件下成立的匹配极小极大下界。只要有限方差子程序计算高效，该归约也计算高效。我们还在响应变量具有有界原始 α 阶矩假设下获得无分布预测保证，并给出用于均值估计的类似不依赖 α 的归约。

items.title_en: Efficient Natural Language to Temporal Logic Translation for Real-Time Physical AI
items.title_zh: 面向实时 Physical AI 的高效自然语言到时序逻辑翻译
items.abstract_en: Robots can be controlled to perform tasks with guaranteed correctness when the task instructions are stated in a formal language. Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used to allow users to provide such instructions in natural language (NL), by translating NL into formal language. When deploying such translators on a robot, however, we face limited computing and energy resources, while offloading computation or data to the cloud may be infeasible or undesirable. Yet an LLM is a general-purpose text generator, whereas a formula in a fixed formal language fragment follows a well-defined syntax. We therefore ask whether text generation is needed at all. For the formal language of linear temporal logic (LTL), we show that this translation can instead be broken down into answering a set of questions with pre-defined answers. We then construct a System-One model, a recent class of NL-based classifier, to provide such answers and enable us to translate a natural language instruction into an LTL instruction. On three benchmarks, our translator matches or exceeds the accuracy of the best local LLMs available, at up to one order of magnitude lower runtime and energy consumption. We show that it generalizes to unseen atomic propositions and temporal patterns.
items.abstract_zh: 当任务指令以形式语言表述时，机器人可被控制以执行具有正确性保证的任务。大型语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用于允许用户以自然语言（NL）提供此类指令，方法是将 NL 翻译为形式语言。然而，在机器人上部署此类翻译器时，我们面临有限的计算和能量资源，而将计算或数据卸载到云端可能不可行或不可取。然而，LLM 是通用文本生成器，而固定形式语言片段中的公式遵循明确定义的语法。因此我们提出疑问：是否根本需要文本生成。对于线性时序逻辑（LTL）这一形式语言，我们表明该翻译可以改为分解为回答一组具有预定义答案的问题。然后我们构建一个 System-One 模型——一类近期的基于 NL 的分类器——来提供此类答案，并使我们能够将自然语言指令翻译为 LTL 指令。在三个基准上，我们的翻译器达到或超过现有最佳本地 LLM 的准确率，同时运行时和能耗最多低一个数量级。我们表明其可泛化到未见过的原子命题和时序模式。

items.title_en: AnyBodyCodec: A Shared Native Interface for Body-Model Conversion, Extension, and Humanoid Control
items.title_zh: AnyBodyCodec：用于身体模型转换、扩展与人形控制的共享原生接口
items.abstract_en: Parametric body models expose incompatible pose and shape controls, tying humanoid policies to particular input formats. AnyBodyCodec learns a shared representation through native conversion, then reuses it for new body models and control with its core frozen. Encoders map MHR, SMPL-X, and SOMA to aligned slots; native decoders recover target controls. The 1.090M-parameter converter covers nine routes and reaches 16.801 mm input-reference MPJPE across six cross routes: the 2.887M Transformer bank reaches 16.390 mm and its parameter-matched version 18.866 mm. Three measured routes take 7.43-7.67 ms on an RTX 4090. Adding ANNY shows that comparable conversion accuracy can accompany different action consistency under one frozen controller. Under a matched PPO budget, aligned slots support 60.78% full-action success across three formats. Separate 160-hour training reaches 66.10% source-weighted validation success, and the controller is deployed qualitatively on a physical G1 through three visual front ends. Together, these results establish reuse through both native geometric fidelity and downstream policy compatibility.
items.abstract_zh: 参数化身体模型暴露不兼容的姿态和形状控制，将人形策略绑定到特定输入格式。AnyBodyCodec 通过原生转换学习共享表示，然后在其核心冻结的情况下将其复用于新的身体模型和控制。编码器将 MHR、SMPL-X 和 SOMA 映射到对齐槽位；原生解码器恢复目标控制。1.090M 参数的转换器覆盖九条路径，并在六条交叉路径上达到 16.801 mm 的输入-参考 MPJPE：2.887M 的 Transformer 组达到 16.390 mm，其参数匹配版本为 18.866 mm。在 RTX 4090 上，三条实测路径耗时 7.43–7.67 ms。加入 ANNY 表明，在同一个冻结控制器下，可比的转换精度可以伴随不同的动作一致性。在匹配的 PPO 预算下，对齐槽位在三种格式上支持 60.78% 的全动作成功率。单独的 160 小时训练达到 66.10% 的源加权验证成功率，并且控制器通过三个视觉前端在物理 G1 上进行了定性部署。这些结果共同确立了通过原生几何保真度和下游策略兼容性实现的复用。

items.title_en: Cecilia: Towards Layout-Inclusive Optical Music Recognition
items.title_zh: Cecilia：迈向包含版面信息的光学音乐识别
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing an editable music score requires musical events, sung text and the instructions that organise them on the page. Existing recognition targets often omit part of this information, while direct MusicXML prediction repeats substantial structural markup. We introduce Cecilia, a compact representation of canonicalised MusicXML that retains musical content, lyric attachments and layout instructions. Cecilia-OMR predicts this representation through metadata and measure-bounded music segments from shared visual memory. A learned count head determines the number of output segments. Across paired complete scores under a common tokeniser, the ratio of mean MusicXML to Cecilia sequence lengths is 27.73. Cecilia-OMR outperforms Legato 2 on Camera String Quartets and both Lieder conditions, with a four-condition OpenScore macro normalised edit distance of 0.2232 against 0.2998. Separate evaluations of lyrics, notation trees and rendered layout reveal complementary aspects of reconstruction and quantify the contribution of layout instructions. Training-stage, reward and candidate-selection studies further examine how recognition changes across model adaptation and decoding.
items.abstract_zh: 重构可编辑乐谱需要音乐事件、演唱文本以及在页面上组织它们的指令。现有识别目标常常遗漏其中部分信息，而直接预测 MusicXML 会重复大量结构标记。我们提出 Cecilia，一种对规范化 MusicXML 的紧凑表示，保留音乐内容、歌词关联和版面指令。Cecilia-OMR 通过元数据以及来自共享视觉记忆的、以小节为界的音乐片段来预测该表示。一个学习得到的计数头确定输出片段的数量。在共同分词器下，对成对的完整乐谱，平均 MusicXML 与 Cecilia 序列长度之比为 27.73。Cecilia-OMR 在 Camera String Quartets 和两种 Lieder 条件下均优于 Legato 2，在四种条件下的 OpenScore 宏平均归一化编辑距离为 0.2232，而对比为 0.2998。对歌词、记谱树和渲染版面的分别评估揭示了重构的互补方面，并量化了版面指令的贡献。训练阶段、奖励和候选选择研究进一步考察了识别结果如何随模型适配和解码而变化。

items.title_en: Astrocyte-secreted Cathepsin D regulates hippocampal memory through extracellular matrix remodeling
items.title_zh: 星形胶质细胞分泌的组织蛋白酶D通过细胞外基质重塑调节海马记忆
items.abstract_en: Astrocytes contribute to hippocampal cognitive functions, but how astrocyte-derived factors regulate memory formation remains unclear. Here, we identify astrocyte-secreted Cathepsin D (CtsD) as a regulator of hippocampal learning and memory. Proteomic profiling of hippocampal astrocytes upon learning identified candidates predicted to be secreted, among which we focused on CtsD, whose extracellular brain functions are unknown. Neutralizing extracellular CtsD or astrocyte-selective CtsD knockdown (aCtsD-KD) impaired hippocampal long term potentiation (LTP) and memory acquisition, suggesting an extracellular role for astrocytic CtsD. In aCtsD-KD mice, these deficits were accompanied by alterations in excitatory transmission and synaptic structures. aCtsD-KD also caused abnormal extracellular matrix (ECM) accumulation, and its partial digestion by chondroitinase ABC rescued the memory deficit, indicating that astrocytic CtsD-dependent ECM degradation contributes to hippocampal memory. Together, our findings suggest a CtsD-dependent astrocyte-matrix-synapse axis regulating hippocampal memory.
items.abstract_zh: 星形胶质细胞参与海马认知功能，但星形胶质细胞来源因子如何调节记忆形成仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定星形胶质细胞分泌的组织蛋白酶D（CtsD）是海马学习与记忆的调节因子。对学习后海马星形胶质细胞的蛋白质组分析识别出预测可分泌的候选蛋白，其中我们聚焦于CtsD，其细胞外脑功能尚不清楚。中和细胞外CtsD或星形胶质细胞选择性CtsD敲低（aCtsD-KD）损害海马长时程增强（LTP）和记忆获取，表明星形胶质细胞CtsD具有细胞外作用。在aCtsD-KD小鼠中，这些缺陷伴随兴奋性传递和突触结构的改变。aCtsD-KD还导致异常的细胞外基质（ECM）积累，而用软骨素酶ABC对其部分消化可挽救记忆缺陷，表明星形胶质细胞CtsD依赖的ECM降解有助于海马记忆。总之，我们的发现提示存在一条依赖CtsD的星形胶质细胞-基质-突触轴调节海马记忆。

items.title_en: Agentic MLIR-to-QIR Translation with Dual-Backend Testing: A Hybrid Deterministic and LLM Approach
items.title_zh: 带双后端测试的智能体式MLIR到QIR翻译：确定性方法与LLM相结合的混合方案
items.abstract_en: Quantum frameworks each define their own Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) dialect, so porting a circuit to a Quantum Intermediate Representation (QIR) runtime needs a hand-written pass per dialect. Our translator selects among three paths: a deterministic compiler path for known grammars (Catalyst and Quake), a large language model (LLM) agentic path for unseen dialects, and a repair path invoked when deterministic output fails testing. A dual-backend pipeline executes the source MLIR and generated QIR on independent simulators, comparing output distributions by total variation distance (TVD). For smaller open-weight models we replace retrieval-augmented generation with inline context engineering and add a guardrail-assembler that rebuilds valid QIR from incomplete output. Across 41 circuits spanning three dialects and 1-100 qubits, the deterministic path is gate-exact on all 70 circuit-dialect pairs, averaging above 95% TVD similarity (1-TVD). On an unseen fault-tolerant (FTQC) dialect, four of six models produce valid logical-level QIR on the first iteration.
items.abstract_zh: 各量子框架各自定义自己的多级中间表示（MLIR）方言，因此将电路移植到量子中间表示（QIR）运行时需要为每种方言手写一个 pass。我们的翻译器在三条路径中选择：针对已知语法（Catalyst 和 Quake）的确定性编译器路径、针对未见过方言的大语言模型（LLM）智能体路径，以及在确定性输出未通过测试时调用的修复路径。双后端流水线在独立的模拟器上执行源 MLIR 和生成的 QIR，通过全变差距离（TVD）比较输出分布。对于较小的开放权重模型，我们用内联上下文工程替代检索增强生成，并加入一个护栏汇编器，从残缺输出中重建有效的 QIR。在涵盖三种方言和 1–100 量子比特的 41 个电路上，确定性路径在所有 70 个电路-方言对上均门级精确，平均 TVD 相似度（1-TVD）高于 95%。在一种未见过的容错（FTQC）方言上，六个模型中有四个在第一次迭代即生成有效的逻辑级 QIR。

items.title_en: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
items.title_zh: 拓扑枢纽最优传输：以 Flash 速度消除长上下文稀释
items.abstract_en: Long-context models use sparse or structured attention to avoid quadratic cost, yet retrieving a small set of relevant facts embedded among hundreds of thousands of distractors degrades as normalization mass disperses with length. Hub-and-spoke optimal transport (OT) replaces the dense $L \times L$ matrix with a linear-size graph over local windows and $K$ shared hubs balanced by Sinkhorn scaling. Building on block-wise tail refinement and fixed-support transport topology (arXiv:2605.08123, arXiv:2609.07954), we introduce Topology Hub Optimal Transport (THOT): (1) bounded-support capacity gating via simplex sparsemax ($O(L\log L)$) or sorting-free token-local thresholded ReLU ($O(L)$), driving excess distractor mass to zero; (2) a three-sweep $1+2$ annealed row-closed Sinkhorn schedule that damps bipartite residuals; (3) an exact rank-$(D+2R+1)$ One-Reference-Tile adjoint in batched split-factor Triton kernels (BF16 Tensor Cores, FP32 potentials); and (4) a chunked exclusive-prefix causal variant with verified zero future leakage. On NVIDIA L4, sparsemax THOT trained at $L=128$ reaches 97.40% zero-shot recall of fixed bindings at $L=262{,}144$ under pure task loss ($α=0$) and 98.83% at $α=0.05$ (matched by $O(L)$ thresholded ReLU at $α=0.05$, vs. 80.60% at $α=0$), while softmax-gated hub OT drops to 3.52%. In bidirectional operator microbenchmarks, our kernel runs forward+VJP in 100.1 ms at $H=8, D=64, L=262\mathrm{K}$ (2.2x faster with 4.0x smaller compiler temporaries than latent softmax) and 1.34 ms vs. 4.37 ms for cuDNN FlashAttention at $L=4{,}096$; multi-layer LM runs use the unfused path. Zero-shot WikiText-103 multi-needle retrieval hits 100.00% (128/128 queries at $L=65\mathrm{K}$) vs. 0.78% for short-trained RoPE FlashAttention, and compact 4-layer WikiText-4K runs show modest causal and masked LM gains.
items.abstract_zh: 长上下文模型使用稀疏或结构化注意力来避免二次成本，但当归一化质量随长度分散时，从数十万个干扰项中检索少量相关事实会退化。枢纽-辐条最优传输（OT）用局部窗口和 K 个共享枢纽上的线性规模图取代稠密 L×L 矩阵，并通过 Sinkhorn 缩放进行平衡。在分块尾部细化与固定支撑传输拓扑（arXiv:2605.08123，arXiv:2609.07954）的基础上，我们提出 Topology Hub Optimal Transport（THOT）：（1）通过单纯形 sparsemax（O(L log L)）或无排序的 token 局部阈值 ReLU（O(L)）进行有界支撑容量门控，将过量干扰项质量驱至零；（2）一种三遍扫描的 1+2 退火行闭 Sinkhorn 调度，抑制二分残差；（3）在批处理拆分因子 Triton 核（BF16 Tensor Cores，FP32 potentials）中的精确秩 (D+2R+1) One-Reference-Tile 伴随；（4）一种分块独占前缀因果变体，已验证零未来泄漏。在 NVIDIA L4 上，在 L=128 训练的 sparsemax THOT 在纯任务损失（α=0）下，于 L=262,144 时对固定绑定达到 97.40% 零样本召回；在 α=0.05 时达到 98.83%（在 α=0.05 时由 O(L) 阈值 ReLU 达到同等水平；而 α=0 时为 80.60%），而 softmax 门控枢纽 OT 降至 3.52%。在双向算子微基准中，我们的核在 H=8、D=64、L=262K 时前向+VJP 运行 100.1 ms（比 latent softmax 快 2.2 倍，且编译器临时变量小 4.0 倍），在 L=4,096 时为 1.34 ms，而 cuDNN FlashAttention 为 4.37 ms；多层 LM 运行使用未融合路径。零样本 WikiText-103 多针检索达到 100.00%（L=65K 时 128/128 个查询），而短训练 RoPE FlashAttention 为 0.78%；紧凑的 4 层 WikiText-4K 运行显示出适度的因果与掩码 LM 增益。

items.title_en: How Far Does Lossless Re-tokenization Move an RLVR Update?
items.title_zh: 无损重分词会使 RLVR 更新偏移多远？
items.abstract_en: Language models assign different probabilities to token sequences that decode to the same string. In reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), a trainer that re-encodes sampled text may train on a different token sequence with the same reward. We ask how far this moves a training update, and whether the movement has a consistent direction. From one checkpoint, we compare updates on the same rollouts, canonical and with selected tokens split into two pieces, against an update on a different batch. On Qwen2.5-0.5B with three-digit addition, splitting about one token in 25 moves the update 0.556 times as far as replacing the batch. The ratio rises with the fraction split in four models and depends on which tokens are split; within a checkpoint, the displacements share a direction across batches. In a tabular model with one table per tokenization and a single sampled string, we prove that whenever two strings below an unsampled prefix differ in probability, only the zero full-gradient step agrees across tokenizations, however it is weighted. In an audit that decodes and re-encodes resampled rollouts, re-encoding touches up to 5.2% of rollouts but at most 0.08% of tokens, far below the split fractions we test. Training on fixed rollouts, the canonical arm finishes ahead in 14 of 18 pre-registered pairs; the interval for the mean accuracy difference includes zero over all pairs and excludes it only under the registered exclusion rule, which favours the canonical arm.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型对解码为同一字符串的不同 token 序列赋予不同概率。在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，对采样文本重新编码的训练器可能在相同奖励下训练于不同的 token 序列。我们探究这会使一次训练更新偏移多远，以及这种偏移是否具有一致方向。从一个检查点出发，我们在相同 rollout 上比较更新：规范更新，以及将选定 token 拆分为两段的更新，并与在另一个批次上的更新对照。在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 的三位数加法任务上，约每 25 个 token 拆分 1 个，会使更新的移动距离为替换批次的 0.556 倍。该比例在四个模型中随拆分比例上升，并取决于拆分哪些 token；在同一检查点内，不同批次间的位移共享一个方向。在一种每个分词对应一张表、且仅采样单个字符串的表格模型中，我们证明：只要未采样前缀之下的两个字符串概率不同，无论权重如何，只有零全梯度步在两种分词间一致。在一项对重采样 rollout 进行解码和重新编码的审计中，重新编码涉及最多 5.2% 的 rollout，但最多 0.08% 的 token，远低于我们测试的拆分比例。在固定 rollout 上训练时，规范分支在 18 个预注册配对中的 14 个中领先；平均准确率差的区间在所有配对上包含零，仅在注册的排除规则下排除零，而该规则有利于规范分支。
